5.270.s:
sūta uvāca..
athānyadapi tatrāsti supuṇyaṃ liṃgasaptakam..
yenārcitena dṛṣṭena pūjitena viśeṣataḥ..1..
5.270.d:
सूत उवाच..
अथान्यदपि तत्रास्ति सुपुण्यं लिंगसप्तकम्..
येनार्चितेन दृष्टेन पूजितेन विशेषतः..1..
5.270.m:
Sūta said:
"Now, there is also another very meritorious group of seven liṅgas there,
by worshipping, seeing, and especially honoring which,

5.270.s:
dīrghāyurjāyate martyaḥ sarvarogavivarjitaḥ..
mārkaṇḍeśvara ityuktastatra devo maheśvaraḥ..2..
5.270.d:
दीर्घायुर्जायते मर्त्यः सर्वरोगविवर्जितः..
मार्कण्डेश्वर इत्युक्तस्तत्र देवो महेश्वरः..2..
5.270.m:
a mortal becomes long-lived and free of all diseases.
The god Maheśvara there is called Mārkaṇḍeśvara;

5.270.s:
indradyumneśvaro'nyastu sarvapāpaharo haraḥ..
pāleśvarastathā caiva sarvavyādhivināśanaḥ..3..
5.270.d:
इन्द्रद्युम्नेश्वरोऽन्यस्तु सर्वपापहरो हरः..
पालेश्वरस्तथा चैव सर्वव्याधिविनाशनः..3..
5.270.m:
another is Indradyumneśvara, Hara who removes all sins;
and likewise Pāleśvara, who destroys all afflictions;

5.270.s:
tato ghaṃṭaśivaḥ khyāto yo ghaṃṭena pratiṣṭhitaḥ..
kalaśeśvarasaṃjñastu vānareśvarasaṃyutaḥ..4..
5.270.d:
ततो घंटशिवः ख्यातो यो घंटेन प्रतिष्ठितः..
कलशेश्वरसंज्ञस्तु वानरेश्वरसंयुतः..4..
5.270.m:
then the well-known Ghaṇṭaśiva, who was established by Ghaṇṭa;
and the one named Kalaśeśvara, together with Vānareśvara;

5.270.s:
īśāna śiva ityuktastatra kṣetreśvareśvaraḥ..
pūjito mānavairbhaktyā kāmānyacchatyamānuṣān..5..
5.270.d:
ईशान शिव इत्युक्तस्तत्र क्षेत्रेश्वरेश्वरः..
पूजितो मानवैर्भक्त्या कामान्यच्छत्यमानुषान्..5..
5.270.m:
[and] Īśāna Śiva, who is the lord of lords of that sacred field.
Worshipped by men with devotion, he grants desires beyond human reach,

5.270.s: vāṃchitānmanasā sarvānkalikāle'pi saṃsthite..6..
5.270.d: वांछितान्मनसा सर्वान्कलिकालेऽपि संस्थिते..6..
5.270.m: all things wished for in the mind, even while the Kali age persists."

5.270.s:
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ..
ko'yaṃ mārkaṃḍasaṃjñastu yena liṃgaṃ pratiṣṭhitam..
indradyumno mahīpālaḥ katamo vada sūtaja..7..
5.270.d:
ऋषय ऊचुः..
कोऽयं मार्कंडसंज्ञस्तु येन लिंगं प्रतिष्ठितम्..
इन्द्रद्युम्नो महीपालः कतमो वद सूतज..7..
5.270.m:
The seers said:
"Who is this one named Mārkaṇḍa by whom the liṅga was installed?
Who was King Indradyumna? Tell us, O son of Sūta!

5.270.s:
tathā pālakanāmā ca yenāyaṃ sthāpito haraḥ..
tathā yo ghaṇṭasaṃjñastu kasmiñjātaḥ sa cānvaye..8..
5.270.d:
तथा पालकनामा च येनायं स्थापितो हरः..
तथा यो घण्टसंज्ञस्तु कस्मिञ्जातः स चान्वये..8..
5.270.m:
And likewise the one named Pālaka, by whom this Hara was established?
And the one named Ghaṇṭa—in what lineage was he born?

5.270.s:
kalaśākhyastu yaḥ khyāto vānareṇa samanvitaḥ..
īśānopyakhilaṃ brūhi paraṃ naḥkautukaṃ sthitam.. 9.
5.270.d:
कलशाख्यस्तु यः ख्यातो वानरेण समन्वितः..
ईशानोप्यखिलं ब्रूहि परं नःकौतुकं स्थितम्.. 9.
5.270.m: And he who is known as Kalaśa, accompanied by a monkey, / and Īśāna as well: tell it all! Our great curiosity remains.

5.270.s:
yato'tra jāyate śreyaḥ punaḥ puṃsāṃ prakīrtaya..
yairetaiḥ sthāpitā devāḥ kṣetre'sminmānavottamaiḥ..6.271.10..
5.270.d:
यतोऽत्र जायते श्रेयः पुनः पुंसां प्रकीर्तय..
यैरेतैः स्थापिता देवाः क्षेत्रेऽस्मिन्मानवोत्तमैः..6.271.10..
5.270.m: Proclaim it again, for from it good fortune arises for men; / [tell of] these gods who were installed in this sacred field by the best of men,

5.270.s:
tathā teṣāṃ samācāraṃ prabhāvaṃ caiva sūtaja..
dānaṃ vāpi yathākālaṃ maṃtrāṃśca vistarādvada..11..
5.270.d:
तथा तेषां समाचारं प्रभावं चैव सूतज..
दानं वापि यथाकालं मंत्रांश्च विस्तराद्वद..11..
5.270.m: and likewise their conduct and power, O Sūta's son, / and the giving at the proper time, and the mantras in full detail!

5.270.s:
sūta uvāca..
ahaṃ vaḥ kīrtayiṣyāmi kathāmetāṃ purātanīm..
kathitāṃ bhartṛyajñena ānartādhipateḥ svayam..12..
5.270.d:
सूत उवाच..
अहं वः कीर्तयिष्यामि कथामेतां पुरातनीम्..
कथितां भर्तृयज्ञेन आनर्ताधिपतेः स्वयम्..12..
5.270.m: Sūta said: / I shall recite to you this ancient tale / told in person by Bhartṛyajña to the lord of Ānarta,

5.270.s:
śrutayāpi yayā martyo dīrghāyurjāyatenaraḥ..
nāpamṛtyumavāpnoti kathaṃcittatprabhāvataḥ..13..
5.270.d:
श्रुतयापि यया मर्त्यो दीर्घायुर्जायतेनरः..
नापमृत्युमवाप्नोति कथंचित्तत्प्रभावतः..13..
5.270.m: by merely hearing which a mortal man becomes long-lived, / and in no way meets untimely death through its power.

5.270.s:
yo mārkaṃḍa iti khyātaḥ prathamaṃ parikīrtitaḥ.
saṃbhūtistasya saṃproktā yuṣmākaṃ pāpanāśinī..14..
5.270.d:
यो मार्कंड इति ख्यातः प्रथमं परिकीर्तितः.
संभूतिस्तस्य संप्रोक्ता युष्माकं पापनाशिनी..14..
5.270.m: He who was renowned as Mārkaṇḍa was celebrated first; / his origin has been related to you, which destroys sins.

5.270.s:
iṃdradyumnaṃ pravakṣyāmi sāṃprataṃ munisattamāḥ..
yadvaṃśo yatprabhāvaśca sarvabhūpālamānitaḥ..15..
iṃdradyumno mahīpāla āsītpūrvaṃ dvijottamāḥ..
brāhmaṇyaśca śaraṇyaśca sādhulokaprapālakaḥ..
yajvā dānapatirdakṣaḥ sarvabhūtahite rataḥ..16.
5.270.d:
इंद्रद्युम्नं प्रवक्ष्यामि सांप्रतं मुनिसत्तमाः..
यद्वंशो यत्प्रभावश्च सर्वभूपालमानितः..15..
इंद्रद्युम्नो महीपाल आसीत्पूर्वं द्विजोत्तमाः..
ब्राह्मण्यश्च शरण्यश्च साधुलोकप्रपालकः..
यज्वा दानपतिर्दक्षः सर्वभूतहिते रतः..16.
5.270.m: Now I shall tell of Indradyumna, O best of sages: / of what lineage he was, and of what power, honored by all rulers of the earth. / In earlier times, O best of brahmins, there was a king named Indradyumna, / devoted to brahmins, a refuge, a protector of virtuous folk, / a sacrificer, a master of giving, capable, and devoted to the welfare of all beings.

5.270.s:
na durbhikṣaṃ na ca vyādhirna ca caurakṛtaṃ bhayam..
tasmiñchāsati dharmajñe āsīllokasya kasyacit..17..
5.270.d:
न दुर्भिक्षं न च व्याधिर्न च चौरकृतं भयम्..
तस्मिञ्छासति धर्मज्ञे आसील्लोकस्य कस्यचित्..17..
5.270.m: Neither famine nor disease, nor fear caused by thieves / befell anyone among the people while that knower of dharma ruled.

5.270.s:
yathaiva varṣato dhārā yathā vā divi tārakāḥ..
gaṃgāyāṃ sikatā yadvatsaṃkhyayā parivarjitāḥ..18..
5.270.d:
यथैव वर्षतो धारा यथा वा दिवि तारकाः..
गंगायां सिकता यद्वत्संख्यया परिवर्जिताः..18..
5.270.m: Just like the torrents of rain, or like the stars in heaven, / or like the sands in the Gaṅgā, beyond counting,

5.270.s:
tadvattena kṛtā yajñāḥ sarve saṃpūrṇadakṣiṇāḥ..
agniṣṭomo'tirātraśca ukthaḥ ṣoḍaśikāstathā..19..
5.270.d:
तद्वत्तेन कृता यज्ञाः सर्वे संपूर्णदक्षिणाः..
अग्निष्टोमोऽतिरात्रश्च उक्थः षोडशिकास्तथा..19..
5.270.m: so were the sacrifices performed by him, all with complete sacrificial fees: / the Agniṣṭoma, the Atirātra, the Uktha, and the Ṣoḍaśins,

5.270.s:
sautrāmaṇyā'tha paśavaścāturmāsyā dvijottamāḥ..
vājapeyāśvamedhāśca rājasūyā viśeṣataḥ..6.271.20..
5.270.d:
सौत्रामण्याऽथ पशवश्चातुर्मास्या द्विजोत्तमाः..
वाजपेयाश्वमेधाश्च राजसूया विशेषतः..6.271.20..
5.270.m: the Sautrāmaṇī, the animal sacrifices, and the Cāturmāsyas, O best of brahmins, / the Vājapeyas, the horse sacrifices, and especially the Rājasūyas,

5.270.s: pauṇḍarīkāstathaivānye śraddhāpūtena cetasā..21.
5.270.d: पौण्डरीकास्तथैवान्ये श्रद्धापूतेन चेतसा..21.
5.270.m: and likewise other Pauṇḍarīka sacrifices, with a mind purified by faith.

5.270.s:
tena dānāni dattāni tīrtheṣu ca viśeṣataḥ..
miṣṭānnāni dvijeṃdrāṇāṃ dakṣiṇāsahitāni ca..22..
5.270.d:
तेन दानानि दत्तानि तीर्थेषु च विशेषतः..
मिष्टान्नानि द्विजेंद्राणां दक्षिणासहितानि च..22..
5.270.m: He gave gifts, especially at the sacred fords: / sweet foods to the lords of brahmins, along with sacrificial fees.

5.270.s:
na tadasti dharāpṛṣṭhe nagaraṃ pattanaṃ tathā..
tīrthaṃ vā yatra no tasya vidyate tridaśālayaḥ..23..
5.270.d:
न तदस्ति धरापृष्ठे नगरं पत्तनं तथा..
तीर्थं वा यत्र नो तस्य विद्यते त्रिदशालयः..23..
5.270.m: There was no city or town on the face of the earth, / nor any sacred ford where he did not have an abode of the gods.

5.270.s:
tena kanyāsahasrāṇi acyutānyarbudāni ca..
brāhamaṇebhyaḥ pradattāni brāhmaṇānāṃ dhanārthinām..24..
5.270.d:
तेन कन्यासहस्राणि अच्युतान्यर्बुदानि च..
ब्राहमणेभ्यः प्रदत्तानि ब्राह्मणानां धनार्थिनाम्..24..
5.270.m: He gave thousands—untold hundreds of millions—of maidens / to brahmins, to brahmins desiring wealth.

5.270.s:
daśamīdivase tasya rātrau ca gajapṛṣṭhigaḥ..
dundubhistāḍyamānastu babhrāma sakalaṃ puram.. 25..
5.270.d:
दशमीदिवसे तस्य रात्रौ च गजपृष्ठिगः..
दुन्दुभिस्ताड्यमानस्तु बभ्राम सकलं पुरम्.. 25..
5.270.m: On the tenth day, at night, a kettledrum beaten / on the back of an elephant went through the entire city:

5.270.s:
pratyūṣe vaiṣṇavaṃ bhāvi pāpahāri ca vāsaram..
upavāsaḥ prakarttavyo muktvā vṛddhaṃ ca bālakam..
anyathā nigrahiṣyāmi bhojanaṃ yaḥ kariṣyati..26..
5.270.d:
प्रत्यूषे वैष्णवं भावि पापहारि च वासरम्..
उपवासः प्रकर्त्तव्यो मुक्त्वा वृद्धं च बालकम्..
अन्यथा निग्रहिष्यामि भोजनं यः करिष्यति..26..
5.270.m: “At daybreak will be the Vaiṣṇava day that removes sin. / A fast must be observed, except by the old and the young; / otherwise I shall punish whoever takes food.”

5.270.s:
iṃdradyumnaḥ sa rājarṣistadā viṣṇoḥ prasādataḥ..
tenaiva svaśarīreṇa brahmalokaṃ tadā gataḥ..27..
5.270.d:
इंद्रद्युम्नः स राजर्षिस्तदा विष्णोः प्रसादतः..
तेनैव स्वशरीरेण ब्रह्मलोकं तदा गतः..27..
5.270.m: Then, by the grace of Viṣṇu, that royal sage Indradyumna / went to the world of Brahmā in that very body of his.

5.270.s:
tatra kalpasahasrāṃte sa prokto brahmaṇā svayam..
iṃdradyumna dharāṃ gaccha na sthātavyaṃ tvayā'dhunā..28..
5.270.d:
तत्र कल्पसहस्रांते स प्रोक्तो ब्रह्मणा स्वयम्..
इंद्रद्युम्न धरां गच्छ न स्थातव्यं त्वयाऽधुना..28..
5.270.m: There, at the end of a thousand kalpas, he was told by Brahmā himself: / “Indradyumna, go to earth; you may not remain here any longer.”

5.270.s:
iṃdradyumna uvāca.
kasmāccyāvayase brahmannijalokāddrutaṃ hi mām..
apāpamapi deveśa tathā me vada kāraṇam..29..
5.270.d:
इंद्रद्युम्न उवाच.
कस्माच्च्यावयसे ब्रह्मन्निजलोकाद्द्रुतं हि माम्..
अपापमपि देवेश तथा मे वद कारणम्..29..
5.270.m: Indradyumna said: / “Why do you cast me down swiftly from your world, O Brahmā? / For I am free from sin, O lord of gods; so tell me the reason!”

5.270.s:
śrībrahmovāca..
tava kīrtisamucchedaḥ saṃjāto'dya dharātale..
yāvatkīrtirdharāpṛṣṭhe tāvatsvarge vasennaraḥ..6.271.30..
5.270.d:
श्रीब्रह्मोवाच..
तव कीर्तिसमुच्छेदः संजातोऽद्य धरातले..
यावत्कीर्तिर्धरापृष्ठे तावत्स्वर्गे वसेन्नरः..6.271.30..
5.270.m: The venerable Brahmā said: / “The extinction of your fame has taken place today on the face of the earth. / As long as one's fame remains on earth's surface, so long may a person dwell in heaven.

5.270.s:
etasmātkāraṇāllokāḥ svanāmāṃkāni cakrire..
vāpīkūpataḍāgāni devatāyatanāni ca..31..
5.270.d:
एतस्मात्कारणाल्लोकाः स्वनामांकानि चक्रिरे..
वापीकूपतडागानि देवतायतनानि च..31..
5.270.m: For this reason people make stepped wells, wells, tanks, / and temples of the deities marked with their own names.

5.270.s:
tasmādgaccha dharāpṛṣṭhaṃ svāṃ kīrtiṃ nūtanāṃ kuru..
yadi vāṃchasi loke'sminmāmake vasatiṃ ciram.. 32..
5.270.d:
तस्माद्गच्छ धरापृष्ठं स्वां कीर्तिं नूतनां कुरु..
यदि वांछसि लोकेऽस्मिन्मामके वसतिं चिरम्.. 32..
5.270.m: Therefore go to the surface of the earth and make your fame anew, / if you wish to dwell in this world of mine for a long time.”

5.270.s:
athātmānaṃ sa rājeṃdro yāvatpaśyati tatkṣaṇāt..
tāvatprāptaṃ dharāpṛṣṭhe kāṃpilya nagaraṃ prati..33..
5.270.d:
अथात्मानं स राजेंद्रो यावत्पश्यति तत्क्षणात्..
तावत्प्राप्तं धरापृष्ठे कांपिल्य नगरं प्रति..33..
5.270.m: Then, as soon as that king of kings looked at himself that very moment, / he found himself arrived upon the face of the earth, facing the city of Kāmpilya.

5.270.s:
atha papraccha lokānsa kimetannagaraṃ smṛtam..
ko'yaṃ deśaḥ ko'tra rājā kiṃ puraṃ nagaraṃ ca kim..34..
5.270.d:
अथ पप्रच्छ लोकान्स किमेतन्नगरं स्मृतम्..
कोऽयं देशः कोऽत्र राजा किं पुरं नगरं च किम्..34..
5.270.m: Then he asked the people: “What is this city called? / What is this land? Who is the king here? What is this town, and what city is this?”

5.270.s:
te tamūcuḥ paraṃ caitatkāṃpilyamiti viśrutam..
ānartanāmā deśo'yaṃ rājātra pṛthivījayaḥ..35..
5.270.d:
ते तमूचुः परं चैतत्कांपिल्यमिति विश्रुतम्..
आनर्तनामा देशोऽयं राजात्र पृथिवीजयः..35..
5.270.m: They said to him: “This is the great and famous city called Kāmpilya; / this land is named Ānarta, and the king here is Pṛthivījaya.

5.270.s: ko bhavānkimihāyātaḥ kiṃcitkāryaṃ vadasva naḥ..36..
5.270.d: को भवान्किमिहायातः किंचित्कार्यं वदस्व नः..36..
5.270.m: Who are you? Why have you come here? Tell us if there is some business.”

5.270.s:
iṃdradyumna uvāca.. iṃdradyumno mahīpālaḥ purāsīdrocake pure..
deśe vaijaruke pūrvaṃ sa deśaḥ kva ca tatpuram.. 37..
5.270.d:
इंद्रद्युम्न उवाच.. इंद्रद्युम्नो महीपालः पुरासीद्रोचके पुरे..
देशे वैजरुके पूर्वं स देशः क्व च तत्पुरम्.. 37..
5.270.m: Indradyumna said: / “Formerly there was a king named Indradyumna in the city of Rocaka, / in the land of Vaijaruka in days of old. Where is that land, and where is that city?”

5.270.s:
janā ūcuḥ..
na vayaṃ tatpuraṃ vidmo na deśaṃ na ca bhūpatim..
indradyumnābhidhānaṃ ca yaṃ tvaṃ pṛcchasi bhadraka..38..
5.270.d:
जना ऊचुः..
न वयं तत्पुरं विद्मो न देशं न च भूपतिम्..
इन्द्रद्युम्नाभिधानं च यं त्वं पृच्छसि भद्रक..38..
5.270.m: The people said: / “We know neither that city nor the land, nor the king / named Indradyumna whom you ask about, good sir.”

5.270.s:
iṃdradyumna uvāca..
cirāyurasti ko'pyatra yastaṃ vetti mahīpatim..
deśaṃ vā tatpuraṃ vāpi tanme vadatha mā ciram..39..
5.270.d:
इंद्रद्युम्न उवाच..
चिरायुरस्ति कोऽप्यत्र यस्तं वेत्ति महीपतिम्..
देशं वा तत्पुरं वापि तन्मे वदथ मा चिरम्..39..
5.270.m: Indradyumna said: / “Is there anyone long-lived here who knows that king, / or the land, or that city? Tell me that without delay!”

5.270.s:
janā ūcuḥ..
saptakalpasmaro nāma mārkaṃḍeyo mahāmuniḥ..
śrūyate naimiṣāraṇye taṃ gatvā pṛccha vetsyasi..6.271.40..
5.270.d:
जना ऊचुः..
सप्तकल्पस्मरो नाम मार्कंडेयो महामुनिः..
श्रूयते नैमिषारण्ये तं गत्वा पृच्छ वेत्स्यसि..6.271.40..
5.270.m: The people said: / “There is the great sage Mārkaṇḍeya, known as the rememberer of seven kalpas; / he is heard to dwell in Naimiṣāraṇya. Go to him, ask, and you will know.”

5.270.s:
athāsau satvaraṃ gatvā vyomamārgeṇa taṃ munim..
papraccha praṇipatyoccairnaimiṣāraṇyamāśritam..41..
5.270.d:
अथासौ सत्वरं गत्वा व्योममार्गेण तं मुनिम्..
पप्रच्छ प्रणिपत्योच्चैर्नैमिषारण्यमाश्रितम्..41..
5.270.m: Then he, going swiftly through the sky, / bowed down low and questioned that sage residing in Naimiṣāraṇya:

5.270.s:
iṃdradyumneti vai bhūpastvayā dṛṣṭaḥ śruto'tha vā..
cirāyustvaṃ śruto'smābhiḥ pṛcchāmastena sanmune..42..
5.270.d:
इंद्रद्युम्नेति वै भूपस्त्वया दृष्टः श्रुतोऽथ वा..
चिरायुस्त्वं श्रुतोऽस्माभिः पृच्छामस्तेन सन्मुने..42..
5.270.m: “Has the king named Indradyumna ever been seen or heard of by you? / We have heard that you are long-lived; therefore we ask, O good sage.”

5.270.s:
śrīmārkaṃḍeya uvāca.. saptakalpāṃtare bhūpo na dṛṣṭo na mayā śrutaḥ..
iṃdradyumnābhidhāno'tra tatra kiṃ nu vadāmi te..43..
5.270.d:
श्रीमार्कंडेय उवाच.. सप्तकल्पांतरे भूपो न दृष्टो न मया श्रुतः..
इंद्रद्युम्नाभिधानोऽत्र तत्र किं नु वदामि ते..43..
5.270.m: The venerable Mārkaṇḍeya said: / “Within seven kalpas, no king named Indradyumna / has been seen or heard of by me here; what then can I say to you?”

5.270.s:
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā nirāśaḥ sa mahīpatiḥ..
vairāgyaṃ paramaṃ gatvā maraṇe kṛtaniścayaḥ..44..
5.270.d:
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा निराशः स महीपतिः..
वैराग्यं परमं गत्वा मरणे कृतनिश्चयः..44..
5.270.m: Hearing those words of his, that ruler of the earth became hopeless; / having attained supreme dispassion, he resolved upon death.

5.270.s:
tena cānīya dārūṇi prajvālya ca hutāśanam..
praveṣṭukāmaḥ sa prokta indradyumno mahīpatiḥ..45..
5.270.d:
तेन चानीय दारूणि प्रज्वाल्य च हुताशनम्..
प्रवेष्टुकामः स प्रोक्त इन्द्रद्युम्नो महीपतिः..45..
5.270.m: He brought pieces of wood, lit a fire, / and wished to enter it, when King Indradyumna was addressed [by the sage]:

5.270.s:
tvayā cātra na kartavyamahaṃ te mitratāṃ gataḥ..
nāśayiṣyāmi te mṛtyuṃ yadyapi syānmahattaram..46..
5.270.d:
त्वया चात्र न कर्तव्यमहं ते मित्रतां गतः..
नाशयिष्यामि ते मृत्युं यद्यपि स्यान्महत्तरम्..46..
5.270.m: “You must not do this here! I have become your friend; / I will avert your death, even if it be very grave.

5.270.s:
nīrogo'si subhavyo'si kasmānmṛtyuṃ pravāṃchasi..
vada me kāraṇaṃ mṛtyoḥ pratīkāraṃ karomi te..47..
5.270.d:
नीरोगोऽसि सुभव्योऽसि कस्मान्मृत्युं प्रवांछसि..
वद मे कारणं मृत्योः प्रतीकारं करोमि ते..47..
5.270.m: You are free from illness, you are very handsome; why do you desire death? / Tell me the reason for your death; I shall remedy it for you.”

5.270.s:
iṃdradyumna uvāca..
cirāyurme bhavānproktaḥ kāṃpilyapuravāsibhiḥ ..
tenāhaṃ tava pārśve'tra samāyāto mahāmune..48..
5.270.d:
इंद्रद्युम्न उवाच..
चिरायुर्मे भवान्प्रोक्तः कांपिल्यपुरवासिभिः ..
तेनाहं तव पार्श्वेऽत्र समायातो महामुने..48..
5.270.m: Indradyumna said: / “You were spoken of to me as long-lived by the residents of Kāmpilya city; / therefore I have come to your side here, O great sage.

5.270.s:
iṃdradyumnodbhavāṃ vārtāṃ tvaṃ vadiṣyasi sanmune..
matkīrtirna parijñātā tato mṛtyuṃ vrajāmyaham..49..
5.270.d:
इंद्रद्युम्नोद्भवां वार्तां त्वं वदिष्यसि सन्मुने..
मत्कीर्तिर्न परिज्ञाता ततो मृत्युं व्रजाम्यहम्..49..
5.270.m: You, O good sage, might speak news concerning Indradyumna, [I thought]; / my fame is unknown, so I am going to death.”

5.270.s:
sūta uvāca..
tasya taṃ niścayaṃ jñātvā dayāvānsa munīśvaraḥ..
vṛthāśramaṃ ca taṃ jñātvā dākṣiṇyādidamabravīt..6.271.50..
5.270.d:
सूत उवाच..
तस्य तं निश्चयं ज्ञात्वा दयावान्स मुनीश्वरः..
वृथाश्रमं च तं ज्ञात्वा दाक्षिण्यादिदमब्रवीत्..6.271.50..
5.270.m: Sūta said: / Knowing that resolve of his, that lord of sages, being compassionate / and knowing that his effort had been in vain, spoke this out of courtesy:

5.270.s:
yadyevaṃ mā viśāgniṃ tvamahaṃ jñāsyāmi taṃ nṛpam..
nāḍījaṃgho bako nāma mamāsti paramaḥ suhṛt..51..
5.270.d:
यद्येवं मा विशाग्निं त्वमहं ज्ञास्यामि तं नृपम्..
नाडीजंघो बको नाम ममास्ति परमः सुहृत्..51..
5.270.m: “If that is so, do not enter the fire! I shall find out about that king; / I have a supreme friend, a crane named Nāḍījaṅgha.”

5.270.s:
ciraṃtanaśca so'smākaṃ nūnaṃ jñāsyati taṃ nṛpam..
tasmādāgaccha gacchāvastasya pārśve himācale..52..
5.270.d:
चिरंतनश्च सोऽस्माकं नूनं ज्ञास्यति तं नृपम्..
तस्मादागच्छ गच्छावस्तस्य पार्श्वे हिमाचले..52..
5.270.m: And he is ancient; he will surely know that king. / Therefore come, let the two of us go to his presence on the Himālaya.52.

5.270.s: sādhūnāṃ darśanaṃ jātu na vṛthā jāyate kvacit..53..
5.270.d: साधूनां दर्शनं जातु न वृथा जायते क्वचित्..53..
5.270.m: The darśana of good people is never in vain anywhere.53.

5.270.s:
evamuktvā tatastau tu prasthitau munipārthivau..
vyomamārgeṇa saṃtuṣṭau bakaṃ prati himācale..54..
5.270.d:
एवमुक्त्वा ततस्तौ तु प्रस्थितौ मुनिपार्थिवौ..
व्योममार्गेण संतुष्टौ बकं प्रति हिमाचले..54..
5.270.m: Having spoken thus, the sage and the king departed, / delighted, through the path of the sky toward the crane on the Himālaya.54.

5.270.s:
bako'pi taṃ samālokya mārkaṇḍeyaṃ samāgatam..
saṃmukhaḥ prayayau tuṣṭaḥ svāgatenābhyapūjayat..55..
5.270.d:
बकोऽपि तं समालोक्य मार्कण्डेयं समागतम्..
संमुखः प्रययौ तुष्टः स्वागतेनाभ्यपूजयत्..55..
5.270.m: The crane, too, seeing Mārkaṇḍeya arrive, / went to meet him, pleased, and honoured him with a welcome.55.

5.270.s:
dhanyo'haṃ kṛtapuṇyo'haṃ yasya me tvatsamāgamaḥ..
bho bho brahmavidāṃ śreṣṭha ātithyaṃ te karomi kim..56..
5.270.d:
धन्योऽहं कृतपुण्योऽहं यस्य मे त्वत्समागमः..
भो भो ब्रह्मविदां श्रेष्ठ आतिथ्यं ते करोमि किम्..56..
5.270.m: Blessed am I! Fortunate am I, whose meeting with you has occurred! / O best of knowers of the Absolute, what hospitality may I offer you?56.

5.270.s:
śrīmārkaṃḍeya uvāca..
mattopi tvaṃ cirāyuśca yato mitraṃ vyavasthitaḥ..
indradyumno mahīpālastvayā dṛṣṭaḥ śruto'thavā..57..
5.270.d:
श्रीमार्कंडेय उवाच..
मत्तोपि त्वं चिरायुश्च यतो मित्रं व्यवस्थितः..
इन्द्रद्युम्नो महीपालस्त्वया दृष्टः श्रुतोऽथवा..57..
5.270.m: The venerable Mārkaṇḍeya said: / You are longer-lived even than I, because you are established as a friend. / Was King Indradyumna seen or heard of by you?57.

5.270.s:
etasya mama mitrasya tena dṛṣṭena kāraṇam..
anyathā jāyate mṛtyustato'haṃ tvāṃ samāgataḥ..58..
5.270.d:
एतस्य मम मित्रस्य तेन दृष्टेन कारणम्..
अन्यथा जायते मृत्युस्ततोऽहं त्वां समागतः..58..
5.270.m: This friend of mine has a purpose in seeing him; / otherwise his death will occur. Therefore have I come to you.58.

5.270.s:
baka uvāca.. saptadviguṇitānkalpānsmarāmyahamasaṃśayam..
na smarāmi kathāmeva iṃdradyumnasamudbhavām..59..
5.270.d:
बक उवाच.. सप्तद्विगुणितान्कल्पान्स्मराम्यहमसंशयम्..
न स्मरामि कथामेव इंद्रद्युम्नसमुद्भवाम्..59..
5.270.m: The crane said: / I remember without doubt seven kalpas multiplied by two; / yet I do not recall even a mention arising about Indradyumna.59.

5.270.s: āstāṃ hi darśanaṃ tāvatsatyametanmayodim..6.271.60..
5.270.d: आस्तां हि दर्शनं तावत्सत्यमेतन्मयोदिम्..6.271.60..
5.270.m: Let alone his darśana! This is the truth spoken by me.6.271.60.

5.270.s:
iṃdradyumna uvāca..
tapasaḥ kiṃ prabhāvo'yaṃ dānasya niyamasya ca..
yadāyurīdṛśaṃ jātaṃ bakatve'pi vadasva naḥ..61..
5.270.d:
इंद्रद्युम्न उवाच..
तपसः किं प्रभावोऽयं दानस्य नियमस्य च..
यदायुरीदृशं जातं बकत्वेऽपि वदस्व नः..61..
5.270.m: Indradyumna said: / Is this the power of austerity, of gift, or of religious observance, / by which such a lifespan has come about even in the state of a crane? Tell us!61.

5.270.s:
baka uvāca.. ghṛtakaṃbalamāhātmyāddevadevasya śūlinaḥ..
mamāyurīdṛśaṃ jātaṃ bakatvaṃ muniśāpataḥ..62..
5.270.d:
बक उवाच.. घृतकंबलमाहात्म्याद्देवदेवस्य शूलिनः..
ममायुरीदृशं जातं बकत्वं मुनिशापतः..62..
5.270.m: The crane said: / From the māhātmya of the ghee blanket [offered] to the trident-bearing God of gods, / such a lifespan has come to me; the state of a crane [came] from a sage’s curse.62.

5.270.s:
ahamāsaṃ purā bālo brāhmaṇasya niveśane..
camatkārapure ramye pārāśaryasya dhīmataḥ..64..
nāmnā ca viśvarūpākhyo nāmnā 'nyena baka smṛtaḥ..
atīva capalatvena saṃyuktaḥ pitṛvallabhaḥ..64..
5.270.d:
अहमासं पुरा बालो ब्राह्मणस्य निवेशने..
चमत्कारपुरे रम्ये पाराशर्यस्य धीमतः..64..
नाम्ना च विश्वरूपाख्यो नाम्ना ऽन्येन बक स्मृतः..
अतीव चपलत्वेन संयुक्तः पितृवल्लभः..64..
5.270.m:
Long ago, I was a boy in the dwelling of a brahmin, / the wise son of Parāśara, in delightful Camatkārapura.64.
By name I was called Viśvarūpa, and by another name I was known as Baka; / endowed with extreme restlessness, yet beloved of my father.64.

5.270.s:
kasyacittvatha kālasya saṃkrāṃtau makarasya bhoḥ..
saṃprāpyātīva cāpalyālliṃgaṃ jāgeśvaraṃ mayā..
ghṛtakumbhe parikṣiptaṃ pūjitaṃ janakena yat..65..
5.270.d:
कस्यचित्त्वथ कालस्य संक्रांतौ मकरस्य भोः..
संप्राप्यातीव चापल्याल्लिंगं जागेश्वरं मया..
घृतकुम्भे परिक्षिप्तं पूजितं जनकेन यत्..65..
5.270.m: Then at a certain time, upon the solstice into Capricorn, O lord, / having obtained out of extreme restlessness the Jāgeśvara liṅga / that was worshipped by my father, it was thrown by me into a jar of ghee.65.

5.270.s:
atha rātryāṃ vyatītāyāṃ pṛṣṭo'haṃ janakena ca..
tvayā putra parikṣiptaṃ nūnaṃ jāgeśvaraṃ kvacit..
tasmādvada prayacchāmi tena te bhakṣyamuttamam..66..
5.270.d:
अथ रात्र्यां व्यतीतायां पृष्टोऽहं जनकेन च..
त्वया पुत्र परिक्षिप्तं नूनं जागेश्वरं क्वचित्..
तस्माद्वद प्रयच्छामि तेन ते भक्ष्यमुत्तमम्..66..
5.270.m: Then, when the night had passed, I was asked by my father: / 'My son, have you indeed cast away Jāgeśvara somewhere? / Therefore tell me; by that, I will give you excellent food.'66.

5.270.s:
tato mayājyakumbhācca tasmādādāya satvaram..
bhakṣyalaulyātpiturhaste vinyastaṃ ghṛtasaṃplutam..67..
5.270.d:
ततो मयाज्यकुम्भाच्च तस्मादादाय सत्वरम्..
भक्ष्यलौल्यात्पितुर्हस्ते विन्यस्तं घृतसंप्लुतम्..67..
5.270.m: Then, having quickly taken it from that jar of ghee, / out of greed for food I placed it, drenched in ghee, into my father’s hand.67.

5.270.s:
kasyacittvatha kālasya paṃcatvaṃ ca samāgataḥ..
jātismarastato jātastatprabhāvānnṛpālaye..68..
5.270.d:
कस्यचित्त्वथ कालस्य पंचत्वं च समागतः..
जातिस्मरस्ततो जातस्तत्प्रभावान्नृपालये..68..
5.270.m: Then at a certain time I met with death, / and from that power was born in a king’s palace, remembering my past lives.68.

5.270.s:
ānartādhipaterharmye nāmnā khyātastvahaṃ bakaḥ..
camatkārapure devo haraḥ saṃsthāpito mayā..69..
5.270.d:
आनर्ताधिपतेर्हर्म्ये नाम्ना ख्यातस्त्वहं बकः..
चमत्कारपुरे देवो हरः संस्थापितो मया..69..
5.270.m: In the mansion of the lord of Ānarta, I was known by the name Baka. / The god Hara was installed by me in Camatkārapura.69.

5.270.s: tatprabhāveṇa vipreṃdra prāptaḥ paitāmahaṃ padam..6.271.70..
5.270.d: तत्प्रभावेण विप्रेंद्र प्राप्तः पैतामहं पदम्..6.271.70..
5.270.m: Through that power, O best of brahmins, the realm of the Grandfather was attained.6.271.70.

5.270.s:
tato yāni dharāpṛṣṭhe suliṃgāni sthitāni ca..
ghṛtenacchādayāmyeva makarasthe divākare..
mayā yatsthāpitaṃ liṃgaṃ camatkārapure śubham..71..
5.270.d:
ततो यानि धरापृष्ठे सुलिंगानि स्थितानि च..
घृतेनच्छादयाम्येव मकरस्थे दिवाकरे..
मया यत्स्थापितं लिंगं चमत्कारपुरे शुभम्..71..
5.270.m: Then, whatever auspicious liṅgas stood upon the surface of the earth, / I covered them with ghee when the sun entered Capricorn. / The auspicious liṅga that was installed by me in Camatkārapura71.

5.270.s:
ārādhitaṃ divā naktaṃ rājye saṃsthāpya putrakam..
niyojya sarvato bhṛtyāndhanavastrasamanvitān..72..
5.270.d:
आराधितं दिवा नक्तं राज्ये संस्थाप्य पुत्रकम्..
नियोज्य सर्वतो भृत्यान्धनवस्त्रसमन्वितान्..72..
5.270.m: was worshipped day and night, after having installed my son in the kingdom / and having appointed attendants everywhere, provided with wealth and garments.72.

5.270.s:
tataḥkālena mahatā tuṣṭo me bhagavāñchivaḥ..
matsamīpaṃ samāsādya vākyametaduvāca saḥ..73..
5.270.d:
ततःकालेन महता तुष्टो मे भगवाञ्छिवः..
मत्समीपं समासाद्य वाक्यमेतदुवाच सः..73..
5.270.m: Then after a long time the blessed Śiva was pleased with me; / having approached my presence, he spoke this word:73.

5.270.s:
parituṣṭo'smi bhadraṃ te tava pārthivasattama..
ghṛtakaṃbaladānena saṃkhyayā rahitena ca.. 74..
5.270.d:
परितुष्टोऽस्मि भद्रं ते तव पार्थिवसत्तम..
घृतकंबलदानेन संख्यया रहितेन च.. 74..
5.270.m: 'I am thoroughly pleased, auspiciousness to you, O best of kings, / by your gift of blankets of ghee beyond counting.74.

5.270.s:
tasmādvaraya bhadraṃ te varaṃ yanmanasi sthitam..
adeyamapi dāsyāmi yadyapi syātsudurlabham..75..
5.270.d:
तस्माद्वरय भद्रं ते वरं यन्मनसि स्थितम्..
अदेयमपि दास्यामि यद्यपि स्यात्सुदुर्लभम्..75..
5.270.m: Therefore choose, auspiciousness to you, the boon that rests in your mind. / Even what should not be given I will give, even if it be very hard to attain.'75.

5.270.s:
tato mayā haraḥ prokto yadi tuṣṭo'si me prabho..
kuruṣva māṃ gaṇaṃ deva nānyatkiṃcidvṛṇomyaham..76..
5.270.d:
ततो मया हरः प्रोक्तो यदि तुष्टोऽसि मे प्रभो..
कुरुष्व मां गणं देव नान्यत्किंचिद्वृणोम्यहम्..76..
5.270.m: Then Hara was addressed by me: 'If you are pleased with me, O Lord, / make me your gaṇa, O God; I choose nothing else.'76.

5.270.s:
śrībhagavānuvāca..
bakaihi tvaṃ mahābhāga kailāsaṃ parvatottamam..
mayā sārdhamanenaiva śarīreṇa gaṇo bhava..77..
5.270.d:
श्रीभगवानुवाच..
बकैहि त्वं महाभाग कैलासं पर्वतोत्तमम्..
मया सार्धमनेनैव शरीरेण गणो भव..77..
5.270.m: The Blessed One said: / 'Come, O highly fortunate Baka, to Kailāsa, the highest mountain; / with me, in this very body, become a gaṇa!77.

5.270.s:
anyo'pi martyaloketra yaḥ kariṣyati mānavaḥ..
makarasthe ravau mahyaṃ saṃkrāṃtau rajanīmukhe.
sa nūnaṃ madgaṇo bhāvī sakṛtkṛtvā'tha kaṃbalam..78..
5.270.d:
अन्योऽपि मर्त्यलोकेत्र यः करिष्यति मानवः..
मकरस्थे रवौ मह्यं संक्रांतौ रजनीमुखे.
स नूनं मद्गणो भावी सकृत्कृत्वाऽथ कंबलम्..78..
5.270.m: And whatever other human being in this mortal world shall make [it] for me / when the sun enters Capricorn, at the beginning of the night, / having offered the blanket even once, shall surely become my gaṇa.78.

5.270.s:
tvaṃ punarmāmakaṃ liṃgaṃ samaṃ kurvanbhaviṣyasi..
dharmaseneti vikhyāto vikṛtyā parivarjitaḥ..79..
5.270.d:
त्वं पुनर्मामकं लिंगं समं कुर्वन्भविष्यसि..
धर्मसेनेति विख्यातो विकृत्या परिवर्जितः..79..
5.270.m: And you, making yourself equal to my liṅga, shall become / renowned as Dharmasena, free from any deformity.'79.

5.270.s:
evamuktvā sa bhagavānmāmādāya tataḥ param..
kailāsaṃ parvataṃ gatvā gaṇakoṭīśatāmadāt..6.271.80..
5.270.d:
एवमुक्त्वा स भगवान्मामादाय ततः परम्..
कैलासं पर्वतं गत्वा गणकोटीशतामदात्..6.271.80..
5.270.m: Having spoken thus, the Blessed One took me from there; / having gone to Mount Kailāsa, he gave me command of a hundred crores of gaṇas.6.271.80.

5.270.s:
kasyacittvatha kālasya bhramamāṇo yadṛcchayā..
gato'haṃ parvataśreṣṭhaṃ himavaṃtaṃ mahāgirim..81..
yatrāste gālavo nāma sadaiva tapasi sthitaḥ..
tasya bhāryā viśālākṣī sarvalakṣaṇalakṣitā.. 82..
5.270.d:
कस्यचित्त्वथ कालस्य भ्रममाणो यदृच्छया..
गतोऽहं पर्वतश्रेष्ठं हिमवंतं महागिरिम्..81..
यत्रास्ते गालवो नाम सदैव तपसि स्थितः..
तस्य भार्या विशालाक्षी सर्वलक्षणलक्षिता.. 82..
5.270.m: Then at a certain time, wandering at will, / I went to the highest mountain, the great mountain Himavat,81. / where Gālava resides, constantly established in austerity. / His wife was large-eyed, marked with all auspicious marks,82.

5.270.s:
saptaraktā trigaṃbhīrā gūḍhagulphā kṛśodarī..
tāṃ dṛṣṭvā manmathāviṣṭaḥ saṃjāto'haṃ munīśvara..83..
5.270.d:
सप्तरक्ता त्रिगंभीरा गूढगुल्फा कृशोदरी..
तां दृष्ट्वा मन्मथाविष्टः संजातोऽहं मुनीश्वर..83..
5.270.m: red in seven places, deep in three, with hidden ankles and a slender waist. / Seeing her, I became overcome with passion, O best of sages.83.

5.270.s:
ciṃtitaṃ ca mayā citte kathametāṃ harāmyaham..
tasmācchiṣyatvamāsādya bhaktimasya karomyaham..84..
5.270.d:
चिंतितं च मया चित्ते कथमेतां हराम्यहम्..
तस्माच्छिष्यत्वमासाद्य भक्तिमस्य करोम्यहम्..84..
5.270.m: And it was thought by me in my mind: 'How can I abduct her? / Therefore, having attained discipleship, I will show devotion to him.84.

5.270.s: śuśrūṣānirato bhūtvā yena prāpnomi bhāminīm..85..
5.270.d: शुश्रूषानिरतो भूत्वा येन प्राप्नोमि भामिनीम्..85..
5.270.m: Having become devoted to his service, I might thereby obtain the lady.'85.

5.270.s:
tato baṭukarūpeṇa saṃprāpto gālavo mayā..
saṃsārasya virakto'haṃ kariṣyāmi mahttapaḥ..86..
5.270.d:
ततो बटुकरूपेण संप्राप्तो गालवो मया..
संसारस्य विरक्तोऽहं करिष्यामि मह्त्तपः..86..
5.270.m: Then, in the form of a young ascetic student, Gālava was approached by me: / 'Detached from worldly existence, I will perform great austerity.86.

5.270.s: dīkṣāṃ yaccha vibho mahyaṃ yena śiṣyo bhavāmi te..87..
5.270.d: दीक्षां यच्छ विभो मह्यं येन शिष्यो भवामि ते..87..
5.270.m: Grant initiation to me, O lord, so that I may become your disciple.87.

5.270.s:
āhariṣyāmyahaṃ darbhāṃstathā sumanasaḥ sadā..
samidhaśca sadaivāhaṃ phalāni jalameva ca..88..
5.270.d:
आहरिष्याम्यहं दर्भांस्तथा सुमनसः सदा..
समिधश्च सदैवाहं फलानि जलमेव च..88..
5.270.m: I will always fetch darbha grass and flowers, / and always firewood, fruits, and water.'88.

5.270.s:
sa māṃ vinayasaṃpannaṃ jñātvā brāhmaṇarūpiṇam..
dadau dīkṣāṃ tato mahyaṃ śāstradṛṣṭena karmaṇā..89..
5.270.d:
स मां विनयसंपन्नं ज्ञात्वा ब्राह्मणरूपिणम्..
ददौ दीक्षां ततो मह्यं शास्त्रदृष्टेन कर्मणा..89..
5.270.m: Recognising me to be endowed with humility and in the form of a brahmin, / he then gave me initiation according to the rite seen in the scriptures.89.

5.270.s:
atha dīkṣāṃ samāsādya toṣayāmi dinedine ..
taṃ caiva tasya patnīṃ tāṃ yathoktaparicaryayā..
aśuddhenāpi cittena chidrānveṣaṇatatparaḥ..6.271.90..
5.270.d:
अथ दीक्षां समासाद्य तोषयामि दिनेदिने ..
तं चैव तस्य पत्नीं तां यथोक्तपरिचर्यया..
अशुद्धेनापि चित्तेन छिद्रान्वेषणतत्परः..6.271.90..
5.270.m: Then, having obtained initiation, day after day I pleased / him and also that wife of his by service as prescribed, / though with an impure mind, intent on seeking a weak point.6.271.90.

5.270.s:
anyasmindivase prāpte sā strīdharmasamanvitā..
uṭajaṃ dūratastyaktvā rātrau suptā manasvinī..91..
so'haṃ rūpaṃ mahatkṛtvā tāmādāya tapasvinīm..
sukhasuptāṃ suviśrabdhāṃ prasthito dakṣiṇāmukhaḥ..92..
5.270.d:
अन्यस्मिन्दिवसे प्राप्ते सा स्त्रीधर्मसमन्विता..
उटजं दूरतस्त्यक्त्वा रात्रौ सुप्ता मनस्विनी..91..
सोऽहं रूपं महत्कृत्वा तामादाय तपस्विनीम्..
सुखसुप्तां सुविश्रब्धां प्रस्थितो दक्षिणामुखः..92..
5.270.m: When another day arrived, that resolute woman, experiencing her menstrual course, / stayed far from the hut and slept at night.91. / I, assuming a great form and seizing that ascetic woman / who was sleeping comfortably and unsuspectingly, set out facing south.92.

5.270.s:
athāsau saṃparityaktā saṃsparśānmama nidrayā..
caurarūpaṃ parijñāya māṃ śiṣyaṃ praruroda ha..93..
5.270.d:
अथासौ संपरित्यक्ता संस्पर्शान्मम निद्रया..
चौररूपं परिज्ञाय मां शिष्यं प्ररुरोद ह..93..
5.270.m: Then, awakened from sleep by my touch / and recognising me, the disciple, in the guise of a thief, she cried out.93.

5.270.s:
sābravīcca svabhartāraṃ gālavaṃ munisattamam..
eṣa śiṣyo durācāro harate māmitaḥ prabho..94..
5.270.d:
साब्रवीच्च स्वभर्तारं गालवं मुनिसत्तमम्..
एष शिष्यो दुराचारो हरते मामितः प्रभो..94..
5.270.m: And she said to her husband, Gālava, the best of sages: / 'This wicked disciple is abducting me from here, O lord!94.

5.270.s: tasmādrakṣa mahābhāga yāvaddūraṃ na gacchati..95..
5.270.d: तस्माद्रक्ष महाभाग यावद्दूरं न गच्छति..95..
5.270.m: Therefore protect me, O highly fortunate one, before he goes far away!'95.

5.270.s:
tacchrutvā gālavaḥ prāha tiṣṭhatiṣṭheti cāsakṛt..
pāpācāra suduṣṭātmangatiste staṃbhitā mayā..96..
5.270.d:
तच्छ्रुत्वा गालवः प्राह तिष्ठतिष्ठेति चासकृत्..
पापाचार सुदुष्टात्मन्गतिस्ते स्तंभिता मया..96..
5.270.m: Hearing that, Gālava said repeatedly, 'Halt! Halt! / O evil-doer! O very wicked soul, your movement has been paralysed by me!'96.

5.270.s:
tasya vākyāttato mahyaṃ gatistaṃbho vyajāyata..
yadvallikhita evāhaṃ pratiṣṭhāmi suniścalaḥ..97..
5.270.d:
तस्य वाक्यात्ततो मह्यं गतिस्तंभो व्यजायत..
यद्वल्लिखित एवाहं प्रतिष्ठामि सुनिश्चलः..97..
5.270.m: Then, because of his words, the arrest of my movement came about, / so that I stood completely motionless, just like a painted figure.

5.270.s:
tatastena ca śapto'haṃ gālavena mahātmanā..
vaṃcito'haṃ tvayā yasmādbako bhava sudurmate..98..
5.270.d:
ततस्तेन च शप्तोऽहं गालवेन महात्मना..
वंचितोऽहं त्वया यस्माद्बको भव सुदुर्मते..98..
5.270.m: Then I was cursed by that noble Gālava: / 'Since I was deceived by you, become a crane, O wicked-minded one!'

5.270.s:
tataḥ paśyāmi cātmānaṃ sahasā bakarūpiṇam..
bakatve'pi na me naṣṭā yā smṛtiḥ pūrvasaṃbhavā..99.
5.270.d:
ततः पश्यामि चात्मानं सहसा बकरूपिणम्..
बकत्वेऽपि न मे नष्टा या स्मृतिः पूर्वसंभवा..99.
5.270.m: Then I saw myself suddenly in the form of a crane; / even in crane-hood, my memory arising from my previous existence was not lost.

5.270.s:
tataḥ sā'pi ca tatpatnī sacailaṃ snānamāśritā..
matsparśāduḥkhitāṃgī ca śāpāya samupasthitā..6.271.100..
5.270.d:
ततः साऽपि च तत्पत्नी सचैलं स्नानमाश्रिता..
मत्स्पर्शादुःखितांगी च शापाय समुपस्थिता..6.271.100..
5.270.m: Then his wife also, having undergone a bath with her clothes on, / her limbs suffering from my touch, stood ready to utter a curse:

5.270.s:
yasmātpāpa tvayā spṛṣṭā prasuptāhaṃ rajasvalā..
bakadharmaṃ samāśritya bharttā me vaṃcitastvayā..
anyarūpaṃ samāsthāya tasmātsatyaṃ bako bhava..101..
5.270.d:
यस्मात्पाप त्वया स्पृष्टा प्रसुप्ताहं रजस्वला..
बकधर्मं समाश्रित्य भर्त्ता मे वंचितस्त्वया..
अन्यरूपं समास्थाय तस्मात्सत्यं बको भव..101..
5.270.m: 'Because, O sinner, I was touched by you while asleep and menstruating, / and taking on the conduct of a crane, my husband was deceived by you / assuming another form, therefore truly become a crane!'

5.270.s:
evaṃ śaptastato dvābhyāṃ tābhyāṃ vai duḥkhasaṃyutaḥ..
caraṇābhyāṃ pralagnastu gālavasya mahātmanaḥ..102..
5.270.d:
एवं शप्तस्ततो द्वाभ्यां ताभ्यां वै दुःखसंयुतः..
चरणाभ्यां प्रलग्नस्तु गालवस्य महात्मनः..102..
5.270.m: Thus cursed then by both of them, full of grief indeed, / I clung to the feet of the noble Gālava:

5.270.s:
gaṇo'haṃ devadevasya trinetrasya mahātmanaḥ..
pālaketi ca vikhyāto gaṇakoṭiprabhuḥ sthitaḥ..103..
5.270.d:
गणोऽहं देवदेवस्य त्रिनेत्रस्य महात्मनः..
पालकेति च विख्यातो गणकोटिप्रभुः स्थितः..103..
5.270.m: 'I am a gaṇa of the god of gods, the three-eyed noble lord; / renowned as Pālaka, I am the master of ten million gaṇas.

5.270.s:
so'hamatra samāyātaḥ prabhoḥ kāryeṇa kenacit..
tava bhāryāṃ samālokya kāmadevavaśaṃ gataḥ..104..
5.270.d:
सोऽहमत्र समायातः प्रभोः कार्येण केनचित्..
तव भार्यां समालोक्य कामदेववशं गतः..104..
5.270.m: I came here on some business of the Lord. / Beholding your wife, I fell under the power of the god of love.

5.270.s:
kṣamāparādhaṃ tvaṃ mahyamevaṃ jñātvā munīśvara..
durvinītaḥ śriyaṃ prāpya vidyāmaiśvaryameva ca..105..
5.270.d:
क्षमापराधं त्वं मह्यमेवं ज्ञात्वा मुनीश्वर..
दुर्विनीतः श्रियं प्राप्य विद्यामैश्वर्यमेव च..105..
5.270.m: Knowing this, forgive my transgression, O lord of sages! / A person ill-mannered upon obtaining fortune, knowledge, and sovereignty,

5.270.s:
na tiṣṭhati ciraṃ sthāne yathāhaṃ madagarvitaḥ..
śiṣyarūpaṃ samāsthāya tataḥ prāptastavāṃtikam..106..
5.270.d:
न तिष्ठति चिरं स्थाने यथाहं मदगर्वितः..
शिष्यरूपं समास्थाय ततः प्राप्तस्तवांतिकम्..106..
5.270.m: does not stay long in his position, just as I, arrogant with pride, / assuming the form of a disciple, came near you

5.270.s:
asyā haraṇahetośca mahāsatyā munīśvara..
tasmātkuru prasādaṃ me dīnasya praṇatasya ca..107..
5.270.d:
अस्या हरणहेतोश्च महासत्या मुनीश्वर..
तस्मात्कुरु प्रसादं मे दीनस्य प्रणतस्य च..107..
5.270.m: for the sake of abducting this great chaste woman, O lord of sages. / Therefore show favour to me, who am wretched and prostrate,

5.270.s:
anugrahapradānena kṣamā yasmāttapasvinām..
kokilānāṃ svaro rūpaṃ nārīrūpaṃ pativratā..
vidyā rūpaṃ kurūpāṇāṃ kṣamā rūpaṃ tapasvinām..108..
5.270.d:
अनुग्रहप्रदानेन क्षमा यस्मात्तपस्विनाम्..
कोकिलानां स्वरो रूपं नारीरूपं पतिव्रता..
विद्या रूपं कुरूपाणां क्षमा रूपं तपस्विनाम्..108..
5.270.m: by granting a blessing, since forbearance belongs to ascetics. / Voice is the beauty of cuckoos; devotion to the husband is the beauty of women; / knowledge is the beauty of the ugly; forbearance is the beauty of ascetics.'

5.270.s:
sūta uvāca..
tasya tatkṛpaṇaṃ śrutvā sopi māheśvaro muniḥ..
jñātvā taṃ bāṃdhavasthāne dayāṃ kṛtvā'bravīdvacaḥ..109..
5.270.d:
सूत उवाच..
तस्य तत्कृपणं श्रुत्वा सोपि माहेश्वरो मुनिः..
ज्ञात्वा तं बांधवस्थाने दयां कृत्वाऽब्रवीद्वचः..109..
5.270.m: Sūta said: / Hearing that pitiful speech of his, that sage devoted to Maheśvara, / recognizing him in the role of a kin, took pity and spoke these words:

5.270.s: satyavāktiṣṭhate vipraścamatkārapure śubhe..6.271.110..
5.270.d: सत्यवाक्तिष्ठते विप्रश्चमत्कारपुरे शुभे..6.271.110..
5.270.m: 'A truthful brahmin lives in auspicious Camatkārapura,

5.270.s:
bharttṛyajña iti khyātastadā tasyopadeśataḥ..
bakatvaṃ yāsyate nūnaṃ mama vākyādasaṃśayam..111..
5.270.d:
भर्त्तृयज्ञ इति ख्यातस्तदा तस्योपदेशतः..
बकत्वं यास्यते नूनं मम वाक्यादसंशयम्..111..
5.270.m: renowned as Bhartṛyajña. Then, by his instruction, / your crane-hood will surely come to an end by my words, without doubt.'

5.270.s: tataḥ paśyāmi cātmānaṃ bakatvena samāśritam..112..
5.270.d: ततः पश्यामि चात्मानं बकत्वेन समाश्रितम्..112..
5.270.m: Then I saw myself reduced to the state of a crane.

5.270.s:
evaṃ me dīrghamāyuṣyaṃ saṃjātaṃ śivabhaktitaḥ..
ghṛtakambalamāhātmyādbakatvaṃ muniśāpataḥ.. 113..
5.270.d:
एवं मे दीर्घमायुष्यं संजातं शिवभक्तितः..
घृतकम्बलमाहात्म्याद्बकत्वं मुनिशापतः.. 113..
5.270.m: Thus my long life came about through devotion to Śiva / and the māhātmya of the Ghṛtakambala, and the crane-hood through the sage's curse."

5.270.s:
iṃdradyumna uvāca.. etadarthaṃ samānītastvatsakāśaṃ vihaṃgama..
iṃdradyumnasya vārtārthaṃ maraṇe kṛtaniścayaḥ..114..
5.270.d:
इंद्रद्युम्न उवाच.. एतदर्थं समानीतस्त्वत्सकाशं विहंगम..
इंद्रद्युम्नस्य वार्तार्थं मरणे कृतनिश्चयः..114..
5.270.m: Indradyumna said: / "For this purpose I was brought to your presence, O bird, / for news of Indradyumna, having resolved upon death.

5.270.s:
sā tvayā naiva vijñātā mamābhāgyairvihaṃgama..
sevayiṣyāmyahaṃ tasmātpradīptaṃ havyavāhanam..115..
5.270.d:
सा त्वया नैव विज्ञाता ममाभाग्यैर्विहंगम..
सेवयिष्याम्यहं तस्मात्प्रदीप्तं हव्यवाहनम्..115..
5.270.m: He was not recognized by you due to my misfortunes, O bird; / therefore I shall resort to the blazing bearer of oblations.

5.270.s:
pratijñātaṃ mayā pūrvametanniścitya cetasi..
iṃdradyumne hyavijñāte saṃsevyaḥ pāvako mayā..116..
5.270.d:
प्रतिज्ञातं मया पूर्वमेतन्निश्चित्य चेतसि..
इंद्रद्युम्ने ह्यविज्ञाते संसेव्यः पावको मया..116..
5.270.m: This was previously vowed by me, having resolved it in mind: / 'If Indradyumna is not known, I must resort to fire.'

5.270.s:
tasmāddehi mamādeśaṃ mārkaṃḍeyasamanvitaḥ..
praviśāmi yathā vahniṃ bhraṣṭakīrtirahaṃ baka..117..
5.270.d:
तस्माद्देहि ममादेशं मार्कंडेयसमन्वितः..
प्रविशामि यथा वह्निं भ्रष्टकीर्तिरहं बक..117..
5.270.m: Therefore give me permission, accompanied by Mārkaṇḍeya, / so that I may enter the fire, O crane, my renown having fallen."

5.270.s:
mārkaṃḍeya uvāca..
vetsi cānyaṃ naraṃ kañcidvayasā cātmano'dhikam..
pṛcchāmi yena taṃ gatvā kṛte hyasya mahātmanaḥ.. 118..
5.270.d:
मार्कंडेय उवाच..
वेत्सि चान्यं नरं कञ्चिद्वयसा चात्मनोऽधिकम्..
पृच्छामि येन तं गत्वा कृते ह्यस्य महात्मनः.. 118..
5.270.m: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / "Do you know any other person older in age than yourself, / so that I, having gone to him, may ask for the sake of this noble soul?

5.270.s:
śraddhayā parayā yuktaḥ saṃprāpto'yaṃ mayā saha..
tatkathaṃ tyajati prāṇānsahāye mayi saṃsthite..119..
5.270.d:
श्रद्धया परया युक्तः संप्राप्तोऽयं मया सह..
तत्कथं त्यजति प्राणान्सहाये मयि संस्थिते..119..
5.270.m: Endowed with supreme faith, he has arrived with me; / so how can he abandon his life while I stand by as his companion?

5.270.s:
aparaṃ ca kṣamaṃ vākyaṃ yattvāṃ vacmi vihaṃgama..
ayaṃ duḥkhena saṃyuktaḥ sādhayiṣyati pāvakam..
ahamenamanuddhṛtya kasmādgacchāmi cāśramam..6.271.120..
5.270.d:
अपरं च क्षमं वाक्यं यत्त्वां वच्मि विहंगम..
अयं दुःखेन संयुक्तः साधयिष्यति पावकम्..
अहमेनमनुद्धृत्य कस्माद्गच्छामि चाश्रमम्..6.271.120..
5.270.m: And another fitting word which I say to you, O bird: / this man, joined with sorrow, will accomplish [death by] fire; / not having saved him, how could I go back to the hermitage?"

5.270.s:
sūta uvāca..
tayostaṃ niścayaṃ jñātvā bakaḥ paramadurmanā..
suciraṃ ciṃtayāmāsa kathaṃ syādetayoḥ sukham..121..
5.270.d:
सूत उवाच..
तयोस्तं निश्चयं ज्ञात्वा बकः परमदुर्मना..
सुचिरं चिंतयामास कथं स्यादेतयोः सुखम्..121..
5.270.m: Sūta said: / Knowing that resolve of the two, the crane, deeply dejected in mind, / thought for a long time: 'How can there be happiness for these two?'

5.270.s:
tato rājā muniścaiva dārūṇyāhṛtya pāvakam..
praveṣṭukāmau tau dṛṣṭvā bako vacanamabravīt..122..
5.270.d:
ततो राजा मुनिश्चैव दारूण्याहृत्य पावकम्..
प्रवेष्टुकामौ तौ दृष्ट्वा बको वचनमब्रवीत्..122..
5.270.m: Then the king and the sage gathered wood, / and seeing the two wishing to enter the fire, the crane spoke these words:

5.270.s:
mama vākyaṃ kuru prājña yadi jīvitumicchasi..
jñātaḥ so'dya mayā vyaktamindradyumnaṃ narādhipam..123..
5.270.d:
मम वाक्यं कुरु प्राज्ञ यदि जीवितुमिच्छसि..
ज्ञातः सोऽद्य मया व्यक्तमिन्द्रद्युम्नं नराधिपम्..123..
5.270.m: "Heed my word, O wise one, if you wish to live. / That King Indradyumna has indeed been made clear to me today.

5.270.s:
yo jñāsyati mama jyeṣṭhaḥ sarvaśāstravicakṣaṇaḥ..
tattvamenaṃ samādāya maraṇe kṛtaniścayam.. 124..
5.270.d:
यो ज्ञास्यति मम ज्येष्ठः सर्वशास्त्रविचक्षणः..
तत्त्वमेनं समादाय मरणे कृतनिश्चयम्.. 124..
5.270.m: He who will know [him] is my elder, expert in all scriptures. / Taking this man, who is resolved upon death,

5.270.s:
niśvasantaṃ yathā nāgaṃ bāṣpavyākulalocanam..
samāgaccha mayā sārdhaṃ kailāsaṃ parvataṃ prati..125..
5.270.d:
निश्वसन्तं यथा नागं बाष्पव्याकुललोचनम्..
समागच्छ मया सार्धं कैलासं पर्वतं प्रति..125..
5.270.m: sighing like a serpent, his eyes agitated with tears, / come with me to Mount Kailāsa,

5.270.s:
yatrāsti dayito mahyamulūkaścirajīvabhāk..
sa nūnaṃ jñāsyate taṃ hi mā vṛthā maraṇaṃ kṛthāḥ.. 126..
5.270.d:
यत्रास्ति दयितो मह्यमुलूकश्चिरजीवभाक्..
स नूनं ज्ञास्यते तं हि मा वृथा मरणं कृथाः.. 126..
5.270.m: where there is my beloved owl who enjoys long life. / He will surely know him; do not bring about death in vain."

5.270.s:
tato'sau tena saṃyukto bakena sumahātmanā..
mārkaṃḍeyena saṃprāptaḥ kailāsaṃ parvatottamam..127..
5.270.d:
ततोऽसौ तेन संयुक्तो बकेन सुमहात्मना..
मार्कंडेयेन संप्राप्तः कैलासं पर्वतोत्तमम्..127..
5.270.m: Then, joined with that noble crane, / he arrived with Mārkaṇḍeya at Mount Kailāsa, best of mountains.

5.270.s:
so'pi dṛṣṭvā bakaṃ prāptaṃ mitraṃ paramasaṃmatam..
samāgacchadasau hṛṣṭaḥ svāgatenābhyanandayat..128..
5.270.d:
सोऽपि दृष्ट्वा बकं प्राप्तं मित्रं परमसंमतम्..
समागच्छदसौ हृष्टः स्वागतेनाभ्यनन्दयत्..128..
5.270.m: He too, seeing that the crane, his deeply esteemed friend, had arrived, / came forward delighted and welcomed him with greetings.

5.270.s:
atha taṃ caiva viśrāntaṃ samāliṅgya muhurmuhuḥ..
prākāravarṇanāmāsau vākyametaduvāca ha..129..
5.270.d:
अथ तं चैव विश्रान्तं समालिङ्ग्य मुहुर्मुहुः..
प्राकारवर्णनामासौ वाक्यमेतदुवाच ह..129..
5.270.m: Then, having embraced him again and again as he rested, / after inquiring about his welfare, he uttered this speech:

5.270.s:
svāgataṃ te dvijaśreṣṭha bhūpa susvāgataṃ ca te..
sakhye'dya yacca te kāryaṃ vadāgamanakāraṇam..6.271.130..
5.270.d:
स्वागतं ते द्विजश्रेष्ठ भूप सुस्वागतं च ते..
सख्येऽद्य यच्च ते कार्यं वदागमनकारणम्..6.271.130..
5.270.m: "Welcome to you, O best of birds; O king, a warm welcome to you! / Tell me today, friend, the purpose of your coming.

5.270.s:
kāvetau puruṣau prāptau tvayā sārdhaṃ mamāṃtikam..
divyarūpau mahābhāgau tejasā parivāritau..131..
5.270.d:
कावेतौ पुरुषौ प्राप्तौ त्वया सार्धं ममांतिकम्..
दिव्यरूपौ महाभागौ तेजसा परिवारितौ..131..
5.270.m: Who are these two men who have arrived with you near me, / divine in form, highly fortunate, surrounded with splendour?"

5.270.s:
baka uvāca..
eṣa mārkaṃḍasaṃjño'tra prasiddho bhuvanatraye..
maheśvaraprasādena saṃsiddhiṃ paramāṃ gataḥ..
dvitīyo'sau suhṛccāsya kaścinno vedmi tattvataḥ..
mārkaṃḍena samāyātaḥ suhṛdā va mamāṃtikam..132..
5.270.d:
बक उवाच..
एष मार्कंडसंज्ञोऽत्र प्रसिद्धो भुवनत्रये..
महेश्वरप्रसादेन संसिद्धिं परमां गतः..
द्वितीयोऽसौ सुहृच्चास्य कश्चिन्नो वेद्मि तत्त्वतः..
मार्कंडेन समायातः सुहृदा व ममांतिकम्..132..
5.270.m: The crane said: / "This one here is named Mārkaṇḍa, renowned in the three worlds; / by the grace of Maheśvara he attained the supreme perfection. / The second is his friend, whom I do not know in truth; / he has come near me with his friend Mārkaṇḍa.

5.270.s:
yadi jānāsi taṃ bhūpamindradyumnaṃ mahāmate..
tattvaṃ kīrtaya yenāsau maraṇādvinivartate..135..
5.270.d:
यदि जानासि तं भूपमिन्द्रद्युम्नं महामते..
तत्त्वं कीर्तय येनासौ मरणाद्विनिवर्तते..135..
5.270.m: If you know that King Indradyumna, O wise one, / declare the truth, so that he may turn back from death.

5.270.s: cirāyustvaṃ mayā jñāto hyataḥ prāpto'smi teṃ'tikam..136..
5.270.d: चिरायुस्त्वं मया ज्ञातो ह्यतः प्राप्तोऽस्मि तेंऽतिकम्..136..
5.270.m: You are known by me to be long-lived; for this reason I have come near you."

5.270.s:
ulūka uvāca..
aṣṭāviṃśatpramāṇena kalpā jātasya me sthitāḥ..
na dṛṣṭo na śrutaḥ kaścidiṃdradyumno mahīpatiḥ..137..
5.270.d:
उलूक उवाच..
अष्टाविंशत्प्रमाणेन कल्पा जातस्य मे स्थिताः..
न दृष्टो न श्रुतः कश्चिदिंद्रद्युम्नो महीपतिः..137..
5.270.m: The owl said: / "Twenty-eight kalpas have passed since I was born; / no King Indradyumna was ever seen or heard of."

5.270.s:
iṃdradyumna uvāca..
tava kasmādulūkatvaṃ śīghraṃ tanme prakīrtaya..
etanme kautukaṃ bhāvi yatte hyāyuranantakam..
ulūkatvaṃ ca saṃjātaṃ raudraṃ lokavigarhitam..138..
5.270.d:
इंद्रद्युम्न उवाच..
तव कस्मादुलूकत्वं शीघ्रं तन्मे प्रकीर्तय..
एतन्मे कौतुकं भावि यत्ते ह्यायुरनन्तकम्..
उलूकत्वं च संजातं रौद्रं लोकविगर्हितम्..138..
5.270.m: Indradyumna said: / "Why is there owl-hood for you? Proclaim that to me quickly! / This is a wonder to me, that you have endless lifespan, / yet owl-hood has arisen, dreadful and censured by the world."

5.270.s:
ulūka uvāca..
śṛṇu te'haṃ pravakṣyāmi dīrghāyurme yathā sthitam..
maheśvaraprasādena bilvapatrārcanānmayā..
ulūkatvaṃ mayā prāptaṃ bhṛgoḥ śāpānmahātmanaḥ..139..
5.270.d:
उलूक उवाच..
शृणु तेऽहं प्रवक्ष्यामि दीर्घायुर्मे यथा स्थितम्..
महेश्वरप्रसादेन बिल्वपत्रार्चनान्मया..
उलूकत्वं मया प्राप्तं भृगोः शापान्महात्मनः..139..
5.270.m: The owl said: / "Listen, I shall tell you how my long life came to be: / by the grace of Maheśvara, through my worship with bilva leaves; / [and] owl-hood was obtained by me through the curse of the noble Bhṛgu."

5.270.s:
ahamāsaṃ purā vipraḥ sarvavidyāsu pāragaḥ..
camatkārapure śreṣṭhe nāmnā khyātastu ghaṃṭakaḥ..
brahmacārī damopeto harapūjārcane rataḥ..6.271.140..
5.270.d:
अहमासं पुरा विप्रः सर्वविद्यासु पारगः..
चमत्कारपुरे श्रेष्ठे नाम्ना ख्यातस्तु घंटकः..
ब्रह्मचारी दमोपेतो हरपूजार्चने रतः..6.271.140..
5.270.m: I was formerly a brahmin, mastered in all sciences, / renowned by the name Ghaṇṭaka in the excellent Camatkārapura, / a celibate student endowed with self-control, devoted to the worship and adoration of Hara.

5.270.s:
akhaṃḍitairbilvapatrairagrajātaistripatrakaiḥ..
trikālaṃ pūjitaḥ śaṃbhurlakṣamātraiḥ sadā mayā..141..
5.270.d:
अखंडितैर्बिल्वपत्रैरग्रजातैस्त्रिपत्रकैः..
त्रिकालं पूजितः शंभुर्लक्षमात्रैः सदा मया..141..
5.270.m: With whole bilva leaves, grown at the tip, possessing three leaflets, / at the three times of day, Śambhu was constantly worshipped by me with a count of one hundred thousand.

5.270.s:
tato varṣasahsrāṃte tuṣṭo me bhagavānharaḥ..
provāca darśanaṃ gatvā meghagaṃbhīrayā girā..142..
5.270.d:
ततो वर्षसह्स्रांते तुष्टो मे भगवान्हरः..
प्रोवाच दर्शनं गत्वा मेघगंभीरया गिरा..142..
5.270.m: Then, at the end of a thousand years, the blessed Hara was pleased with me; / granting me darśana, he spoke in a voice deep as a thundercloud:

5.270.s:
ahaṃ tuṣṭo'smi te vatsa varaṃ varaya suvrata..
akhaṃḍitairbilvapatraistrikāle yattvayārcitaḥ..143..
5.270.d:
अहं तुष्टोऽस्मि ते वत्स वरं वरय सुव्रत..
अखंडितैर्बिल्वपत्रैस्त्रिकाले यत्त्वयार्चितः..143..
5.270.m: ‘I am pleased with you, child; choose a boon, O one of good vows, / since you have worshipped me at the three times of day with whole bilva leaves.

5.270.s:
bilvasya prasavāgreṇa tripatreṇa prajāyate..
ekenāpi yathātuṣṭistathānyeṣāṃ na koṭibhiḥ..144..
5.270.d:
बिल्वस्य प्रसवाग्रेण त्रिपत्रेण प्रजायते..
एकेनापि यथातुष्टिस्तथान्येषां न कोटिभिः..144..
5.270.m: With a single three-leafed shoot grown at the tip of the bilva, / such satisfaction is produced as not even with ten millions of other [leaves]

5.270.s:
puṣpāṇāmapi bhadraṃ te sugaṃdhānāmapi dhruvam..
sakhe mayā praṇamyoccaiḥ sa proktaḥ śaśiśekharaḥ..145..
5.270.d:
पुष्पाणामपि भद्रं ते सुगंधानामपि ध्रुवम्..
सखे मया प्रणम्योच्चैः स प्रोक्तः शशिशेखरः..145..
5.270.m: or even flowers, may you have good fortune, however fragrant they may certainly be.’ / O friend, having bowed down deeply, I said to that moon-crested lord:

5.270.s:
yadi tuṣṭosi me deva yadi deyo varo mama..
tanmāṃ kuru jagannātha jarāmaraṇavarjitam..146..
5.270.d:
यदि तुष्टोसि मे देव यदि देयो वरो मम..
तन्मां कुरु जगन्नाथ जरामरणवर्जितम्..146..
5.270.m: ‘If you are pleased with me, O God, if a boon is to be given to me, / then make me, O Lord of the World, free from old age and death.’

5.270.s:
sa tatheti pratijñāya mahādevo maheśvaraḥ..
kailāsaṃ prati deveśaḥ kṣaṇāccādarśanaṃ gataḥ..147..
5.270.d:
स तथेति प्रतिज्ञाय महादेवो महेश्वरः..
कैलासं प्रति देवेशः क्षणाच्चादर्शनं गतः..147..
5.270.m: Having agreed with ‘So be it!’, Mahādeva, the great lord, / the lord of gods, vanished toward Kailāsa in an instant.

5.270.s:
tatohaṃ parituṣṭotha varaṃ prāpya maheśvarāt..
kṛtakṛtyamivātmānaṃ ciṃtayāmi praharṣitaḥ..148..
5.270.d:
ततोहं परितुष्टोथ वरं प्राप्य महेश्वरात्..
कृतकृत्यमिवात्मानं चिंतयामि प्रहर्षितः..148..
5.270.m: Then, delighted, having obtained the boon from the great lord, / I rejoiced, considering myself to have achieved my goal.

5.270.s:
etasminneva kāle tu bhārgavo munisattamaḥ..
kuśalaḥ sarvaśāstreṣu vedavedāṃga pāragaḥ..149..
5.270.d:
एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु भार्गवो मुनिसत्तमः..
कुशलः सर्वशास्त्रेषु वेदवेदांग पारगः..149..
5.270.m: At that very time, there was a Bhārgava, an excellent sage, / skilled in all treatises, who had mastered the Vedas and their auxiliary sciences.

5.270.s:
tasya bhāryā'bhavatsādhvī nāmnā khyātā sudarśanā..
prāṇebhyo'pi priyā tasya gālavasya muneḥ sutā..6.271.150..
5.270.d:
तस्य भार्याऽभवत्साध्वी नाम्ना ख्याता सुदर्शना..
प्राणेभ्योऽपि प्रिया तस्य गालवस्य मुनेः सुता..6.271.150..
5.270.m: He had a virtuous wife, known by the name Sudarśanā, / dearer to him even than his life's breaths, the daughter of the sage Gālava.

5.270.s:
tasya kanyā samabhavadrūpeṇāpratimā bhuvi..
sā mayā sahasā dṛṣṭā krīḍamānā yathecchayā..151..
5.270.d:
तस्य कन्या समभवद्रूपेणाप्रतिमा भुवि..
सा मया सहसा दृष्टा क्रीडमाना यथेच्छया..151..
5.270.m: A daughter was born to him, peerless on earth in beauty. / She was suddenly seen by me as she was playing at her pleasure,

5.270.s:
madhyakṣāmā sukeśī ca biṃboṣṭhī dīrghalocanā..
tāmahaṃ vīkṣayitvā tu kāmadevavaśaṃ gataḥ..152..
5.270.d:
मध्यक्षामा सुकेशी च बिंबोष्ठी दीर्घलोचना..
तामहं वीक्षयित्वा तु कामदेववशं गतः..152..
5.270.m: slender-waisted, with beautiful hair, bimba-fruit lips, and long eyes. / But looking upon her, I fell under the power of the god of love.

5.270.s:
tataḥ pṛṣṭā mayā kasya kanyeyaṃ cārulocanā..
vibhaktasarvāvayavā devakanyeva rājate..153..
5.270.d:
ततः पृष्टा मया कस्य कन्येयं चारुलोचना..
विभक्तसर्वावयवा देवकन्येव राजते..153..
5.270.m: Then I asked: ‘Whose daughter is this beautiful-eyed maiden, / whose every limb is well-proportioned, who shines like a divine maiden?’

5.270.s:
sakhībhiḥ kīrtitā mahyaṃ bhārgavasya muneḥ sutā..
eṣā cādyāpi kanyātve vartate cāruhāsinī..154..
5.270.d:
सखीभिः कीर्तिता मह्यं भार्गवस्य मुनेः सुता..
एषा चाद्यापि कन्यात्वे वर्तते चारुहासिनी..154..
5.270.m: Her female companions said to me: ‘She is the daughter of the Bhārgava sage, / and even now this sweet-smiling girl remains unmarried.’

5.270.s:
tato'haṃ bhārgavaṃ gatvā vinayena samanvitaḥ..
yayāce kanyakāṃ tā ca kṛtāṃjalipuṭaḥ sthitaḥ.. 155.
5.270.d:
ततोऽहं भार्गवं गत्वा विनयेन समन्वितः..
ययाचे कन्यकां ता च कृतांजलिपुटः स्थितः.. 155.
5.270.m: Then, approaching that Bhārgava, filled with humility / and standing with folded hands, I asked for that maiden.

5.270.s:
savarṇaṃ māṃ parijñāya so'pi bhārgavanaṃdanaḥ..
dattavāṃstāṃ mahābhāga virūpasyāpi kanyakām..156..
atha sā kanyakā jñātvā pitrā dattāsmi dharmataḥ..
virūpāya tato gatvā mātaraṃ vākyamabravīt..57..
5.270.d:
सवर्णं मां परिज्ञाय सोऽपि भार्गवनंदनः..
दत्तवांस्तां महाभाग विरूपस्यापि कन्यकाम्..156..
अथ सा कन्यका ज्ञात्वा पित्रा दत्तास्मि धर्मतः..
विरूपाय ततो गत्वा मातरं वाक्यमब्रवीत्..57..
5.270.m:
Recognizing that I belonged to the same caste, that son of Bhṛgu, / though I was deformed, gave that daughter, O noble one.
Then that maiden, learning, ‘I have been given according to dharma by my father / to an ugly man,’ went and spoke these words to her mother:

5.270.s:
sulajjā sā'tiduḥkhārtā paśyāṃba janakena ca ..
virūpāya pradattāsmi nāhaṃ jīvitumutsahe..158..
5.270.d:
सुलज्जा साऽतिदुःखार्ता पश्यांब जनकेन च ..
विरूपाय प्रदत्तास्मि नाहं जीवितुमुत्सहे..158..
5.270.m: Very modest and exceedingly afflicted with grief: ‘Look, mother! By father / I have been given to a deformed man; I do not dare to go on living.

5.270.s:
viṣaṃ vā bhakṣayiṣyāmi pravekṣyāmi hutāśanam..
tasyāstadvacanaṃ śrutvā niṣiddhaḥ sa dvijastayā..159..
5.270.d:
विषं वा भक्षयिष्यामि प्रवेक्ष्यामि हुताशनम्..
तस्यास्तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा निषिद्धः स द्विजस्तया..159..
5.270.m: I will either consume poison or enter the fire!’ / Hearing that statement of hers, that twice-born was restrained by her [mother]:

5.270.s:
kasmānnātha pradattāsau virūpāya tvayā vibho..
kanyakeyaṃ surūpāḍhyā sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyutā..6.271.160..
5.270.d:
कस्मान्नाथ प्रदत्तासौ विरूपाय त्वया विभो..
कन्यकेयं सुरूपाढ्या सर्वलक्षणसंयुता..6.271.160..
5.270.m: ‘Why, O lord, was she given by you to a deformed man, O master, / when this maiden is endowed with great beauty and possesses all auspicious marks?’

5.270.s:
etacchrutvā tu vacanaṃ bhārgavo munisattamaḥ..
tatastāṃ garhayitvāsau dhiṅnārī puruṣāyate..161..
5.270.d:
एतच्छ्रुत्वा तु वचनं भार्गवो मुनिसत्तमः..
ततस्तां गर्हयित्वासौ धिङ्नारी पुरुषायते..161..
5.270.m: Hearing this speech, the Bhārgava, the best of sages, / then rebuking her, said: ‘Shame on a woman who acts like a man!

5.270.s:
anena prārthitā kanyā mayā cāsmai pradīyate..
tatkiṃ niṣedhayasi māṃ dīyamānāṃ sutāmimām..162..
5.270.d:
अनेन प्रार्थिता कन्या मया चास्मै प्रदीयते..
तत्किं निषेधयसि मां दीयमानां सुतामिमाम्..162..
5.270.m: The maiden was requested by him, and she is being given by me to him. / So why do you forbid me from giving this daughter away?’

5.270.s: ityuktvā sa prasuṣvāpa patnyātha kanyayā samam..163..
5.270.d: इत्युक्त्वा स प्रसुष्वाप पत्न्याथ कन्यया समम्..163..
5.270.m: Having said this, he went to sleep together with his wife and daughter.

5.270.s:
tato'rddharātre cāgatya mayā suptā ca bhārgavī..
hṛtvā svabhavane nītā niśi supte jane tadā..164..
5.270.d:
ततोऽर्द्धरात्रे चागत्य मया सुप्ता च भार्गवी..
हृत्वा स्वभवने नीता निशि सुप्ते जने तदा..164..
5.270.m: Then, arriving at midnight while the people were sleeping at night, / the sleeping daughter of the Bhārgava was abducted by me and carried off to my home.

5.270.s:
niyuktā kāmadharmeṇa hyanicchaṃtī balānmayā..
vipraḥ prātarjajāgāra pitā tasyāstataḥ param..165..
5.270.d:
नियुक्ता कामधर्मेण ह्यनिच्छंती बलान्मया..
विप्रः प्रातर्जजागार पिता तस्यास्ततः परम्..165..
5.270.m: She was constrained by me by force into the way of sexual desire, though she was unwilling. / After that, the brahmin, her father, woke up in the morning:

5.270.s:
kvāsau sā duhitā kena hṛtā naṣṭā madīyikā..
athāsau vīkṣituṃ bāhye babhrāma svavanāṃtikam..166..
5.270.d:
क्वासौ सा दुहिता केन हृता नष्टा मदीयिका..
अथासौ वीक्षितुं बाह्ये बभ्राम स्ववनांतिकम्..166..
5.270.m: ‘Where is that daughter? By whom has my girl been taken away and lost?’ / Then he wandered outside near his forest to search,

5.270.s:
padasaṃhatimārgeṇa munibhirbahubhirvṛtaḥ..
tena dṛṣṭā'tha sā kanyā kṛtakautukamaṃgalā..167..
5.270.d:
पदसंहतिमार्गेण मुनिभिर्बहुभिर्वृतः..
तेन दृष्टाऽथ सा कन्या कृतकौतुकमंगला..167..
5.270.m: surrounded by many sages, following the trail of footprints. / Then that maiden was seen by him, with the wedding rites already performed,

5.270.s:
rudaṃtī sasvanaṃ tatra lajjamānā hyadhomukhī..
tataḥ kopaparītātmā māṃ provāca sa bhārgavaḥ.. 168..
5.270.d:
रुदंती सस्वनं तत्र लज्जमाना ह्यधोमुखी..
ततः कोपपरीतात्मा मां प्रोवाच स भार्गवः.. 168..
5.270.m: weeping loudly there, bashful, with her face cast down. / Thereupon, his soul overwhelmed with anger, that Bhārgava spoke to me:

5.270.s:
niśācarasya dharmeṇa yasmādūḍhā sutā mama..
niśācaro bhavānastu karmaṇānena sāṃpratam.169..
5.270.d:
निशाचरस्य धर्मेण यस्मादूढा सुता मम..
निशाचरो भवानस्तु कर्मणानेन सांप्रतम्.169..
5.270.m: ‘Since my daughter was wed by you according to the practice of a night-roamer, / let you become a night-roamer [an owl] right now on account of this deed!’

5.270.s:
ghaṃṭaka uvāca..
nirdoṣaṃ māṃ dvijaśreṣṭha kasmāttvaṃ śapasi drutam..
tvayaiṣā me svayaṃ dattā tena rātrau hṛtā mayā..6.271.170..
5.270.d:
घंटक उवाच..
निर्दोषं मां द्विजश्रेष्ठ कस्मात्त्वं शपसि द्रुतम्..
त्वयैषा मे स्वयं दत्ता तेन रात्रौ हृता मया..6.271.170..
5.270.m: Ghaṇṭaka said: / ‘Why do you curse me so quickly, O best of the twice-born, when I am blameless? / She was given to me by you yourself; therefore she was carried off by me at night.

5.270.s:
yo datvā kanyakāṃ pūrvaṃ paścādyacchenna durmatiḥ.
sa yāti narakaṃ ghoraṃ yāvadābhūtasaṃplavam..171..
5.270.d:
यो दत्वा कन्यकां पूर्वं पश्चाद्यच्छेन्न दुर्मतिः.
स याति नरकं घोरं यावदाभूतसंप्लवम्..171..
5.270.m: Whatever evil-minded man having first given a maiden does not give her afterward, / he goes to a terrible hell for as long as the dissolution of all beings.’

5.270.s:
athāsau ciṃtayāmāsa satyametena jalpitam..
paścāttāpasamopeto vākyametaduvāca ha..172..
5.270.d:
अथासौ चिंतयामास सत्यमेतेन जल्पितम्..
पश्चात्तापसमोपेतो वाक्यमेतदुवाच ह..172..
5.270.m: Then he reflected: ‘What he said is true.’ / Endowed with repentance, he spoke these words:

5.270.s:
satyametattvayā proktaṃ na me vacanamanyathā..
ulūkarūpasaṃyukto bhaviṣyasi na saṃśayaḥ..173..
5.270.d:
सत्यमेतत्त्वया प्रोक्तं न मे वचनमन्यथा..
उलूकरूपसंयुक्तो भविष्यसि न संशयः..173..
5.270.m: ‘This which was said by you is true, but my word cannot be otherwise: / you will be endowed with the form of an owl, there is no doubt.

5.270.s:
utpatsyate yadā cātra bhartṛyajño mahāmuniḥ..
tasyopadeśamāsādya bhūyaḥ prāpsyasi svāṃ tanum..174..
5.270.d:
उत्पत्स्यते यदा चात्र भर्तृयज्ञो महामुनिः..
तस्योपदेशमासाद्य भूयः प्राप्स्यसि स्वां तनुम्..174..
5.270.m: And when the great sage Bhartṛyajña is born here, / having obtained his instruction, you will regain your own body.’

5.270.s:
tataḥ kauśikarūpaṃ tu paśyāmyātmānameva ca..
tathāpi na smṛtirnaṣṭā mama yā pūrvasaṃbhavā..175..
5.270.d:
ततः कौशिकरूपं तु पश्याम्यात्मानमेव च..
तथापि न स्मृतिर्नष्टा मम या पूर्वसंभवा..175..
5.270.m: Then I saw myself possessing the form of an owl; / even so, the memory belonging to my previous existence was not lost to me.

5.270.s:
atha yā tatsutā coḍhā mayā tasmingirau tadā..
sāpi māṃ saṃnirīkṣyātha tadrūpaṃ duḥkhasaṃyutā..
praviṣṭā havyavāhaṃ sā vidhavātvamanicchatī..176..
5.270.d:
अथ या तत्सुता चोढा मया तस्मिन्गिरौ तदा..
सापि मां संनिरीक्ष्याथ तद्रूपं दुःखसंयुता..
प्रविष्टा हव्यवाहं सा विधवात्वमनिच्छती..176..
5.270.m: Then, having looked upon me in that form, his daughter who had been wed by me on that mountain, / filled with grief and unwilling to endure widowhood, / entered the fire.

5.270.s:
evaṃ me kauśikatvaṃ hi saṃjātaṃ tu mahādyute..
bhārgavasya tu śāpena kanyārthe yattavoditam..177..
5.270.d:
एवं मे कौशिकत्वं हि संजातं तु महाद्युते..
भार्गवस्य तु शापेन कन्यार्थे यत्तवोदितम्..177..
5.270.m: Thus the state of an owl came about for me, O one of great splendor, / by the curse of the Bhārgava on account of the maiden, as has been told to you.

5.270.s:
akhaṃḍabilvapatreṇa pūjito yanmaheśvaraḥ..
cirāyustenasaṃjātaṃ satyametanmayoditam..178..
5.270.d:
अखंडबिल्वपत्रेण पूजितो यन्महेश्वरः..
चिरायुस्तेनसंजातं सत्यमेतन्मयोदितम्..178..
5.270.m: That Maheśvara was worshipped with whole bilva leaves, / by that a long life was attained—this that I have told you is true.

5.270.s:
satyaṃ kathaya yatkṛtyaṃ gṛhāyātasya kiṃ tava..
prakaromi mahābhāga yadyapi syātsudurlabham..179..
5.270.d:
सत्यं कथय यत्कृत्यं गृहायातस्य किं तव..
प्रकरोमि महाभाग यद्यपि स्यात्सुदुर्लभम्..179..
5.270.m: Tell me truly what duty there is for you who have come to my home: / what may I do, O noble one, even if it were very hard to obtain?’

5.270.s:
indradyumna uvāca ..
indradyumnasya jñānāya prāpto'haṃ yattavāṃtikam..
nāḍījaṃghena cānīto maraṇe kṛtaniścayaḥ..6.271.180..
5.270.d:
इन्द्रद्युम्न उवाच ..
इन्द्रद्युम्नस्य ज्ञानाय प्राप्तोऽहं यत्तवांतिकम्..
नाडीजंघेन चानीतो मरणे कृतनिश्चयः..6.271.180..
5.270.m: Indradyumna said: / ‘That I have come to your presence in order to gain knowledge of Indradyumna, / and was brought by Nāḍījaṅgha, having resolved upon death:

5.270.s:
yadi no jñāsyati bhavāṃstaṃ kīrtyā ca kulena ca..
praviśāmi tato nūnaṃ pradīptaṃ havyavāhanam..181..
5.270.d:
यदि नो ज्ञास्यति भवांस्तं कीर्त्या च कुलेन च..
प्रविशामि ततो नूनं प्रदीप्तं हव्यवाहनम्..181..
5.270.m: if you do not know him by fame and by family, / then I shall certainly enter the blazing fire.

5.270.s:
no cetkīrtaya me kañcidanyaṃ tu cirajīvinam..
pṛcchāmi tena taṃ gatvā yena vetti na vā ca saḥ..182..
5.270.d:
नो चेत्कीर्तय मे कञ्चिदन्यं तु चिरजीविनम्..
पृच्छामि तेन तं गत्वा येन वेत्ति न वा च सः..182..
5.270.m: If not, then tell me of some other long-lived being; / going to him, I shall ask him, so that he knows him or does not.’

5.270.s:
baka uvāca..
yuktamuktamanenādya tatkuruṣva vadāsya bhoḥ..
yadi jānāsi kaṃcitvamātmanaścirajīvinam..183..
5.270.d:
बक उवाच..
युक्तमुक्तमनेनाद्य तत्कुरुष्व वदास्य भोः..
यदि जानासि कंचित्वमात्मनश्चिरजीविनम्..183..
5.270.m: The crane said: / ‘What has been said by him today is proper; do that, speak to him, sir, / if you know anyone who has lived longer than yourself.

5.270.s:
no cedahamapi kṣipraṃ praviśāmi hutāśanam..
mārkaṃḍenāpi sahitaḥ sāṃprataṃ tava paśyataḥ..184..
5.270.d:
नो चेदहमपि क्षिप्रं प्रविशामि हुताशनम्..
मार्कंडेनापि सहितः सांप्रतं तव पश्यतः..184..
5.270.m: If not, I too, together with Mārkaṇḍa, / will quickly enter the fire right now before your eyes.’

5.270.s:
evam jñātvā mahābhāga cintayasva ciraṃtanam..
kaṃcidbhūmitale'nyatra yatastvaṃ cirajīvadhṛk..185..
5.270.d:
एवम् ज्ञात्वा महाभाग चिन्तयस्व चिरंतनम्..
कंचिद्भूमितलेऽन्यत्र यतस्त्वं चिरजीवधृक्..185..
5.270.m: Knowing this, O fortunate one, think of someone ancient / elsewhere on the earth's surface, since you possess long life.

5.270.s:
āśayā parayā prāptastavāhaṃ kila maṃdire..
pumāneṣa viśeṣeṇa mārkaṃḍeyaḥ priyo mama ..186..
5.270.d:
आशया परया प्राप्तस्तवाहं किल मंदिरे..
पुमानेष विशेषेण मार्कंडेयः प्रियो मम ..186..
5.270.m: Indeed, with great hope I have come to your abode; / in particular, this man Mārkaṇḍeya is dear to me.

5.270.s:
saṃtyatra parvataśreṣṭhāḥ śataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ..
yeṣu santi mahābhāgāstāpasāścirajīvinaḥ..
nānyathā jīvitaṃ cāsya kathaṃcitsaṃbhaviṣyati..187..
5.270.d:
संत्यत्र पर्वतश्रेष्ठाः शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः..
येषु सन्ति महाभागास्तापसाश्चिरजीविनः..
नान्यथा जीवितं चास्य कथंचित्संभविष्यति..187..
5.270.m: There are excellent mountains here by the hundreds and thousands, / on which dwell blessed ascetics who live long; / otherwise, his life will not be preserved in any way.

5.270.s:
iṃdradyumnasya rājarṣerhitaṃ paramakaṃ bhavet..
tathāvayordvayoścāpi tasmācciṃtaya satvaram..188..
5.270.d:
इंद्रद्युम्नस्य राजर्षेर्हितं परमकं भवेत्..
तथावयोर्द्वयोश्चापि तस्माच्चिंतय सत्वरम्..188..
5.270.m: Let there be the highest benefit for the royal seer Indradyumna, / and also for the two of us; therefore, consider it quickly."

5.270.s:
tasya taṃ niścayaṃ jñātvā maraṇārthaṃ mahīpateḥ..
sa ulūkaḥ kṛpāṃ gatvā tato vacanamabravīt..189..
5.270.d:
तस्य तं निश्चयं ज्ञात्वा मरणार्थं महीपतेः..
स उलूकः कृपां गत्वा ततो वचनमब्रवीत्..189..
5.270.m: Knowing that resolve of the king to die, / the owl, moved by pity, then spoke these words:

5.270.s:
yadyevaṃ tu mahābhāga martukāmo'si sāṃpratam..
tadāgaccha mayā sārdhaṃ gandhamādanaparvatam..6.271.190..
5.270.d:
यद्येवं तु महाभाग मर्तुकामोऽसि सांप्रतम्..
तदागच्छ मया सार्धं गन्धमादनपर्वतम्..6.271.190..
5.270.m: "If indeed, O fortunate one, you wish to die right now, / then come with me to Mount Gandhamādana.

5.270.s:
tatra saṃtiṣṭhate gṛdhraḥ sa ca me paramaḥ suhṛt..
ciraṃtanastathā samyaksa te jñāsyati taṃ nṛpam..
kathayiṣyatyasaṃdigdhaṃ mama vākyādasaṃśayam..191..
5.270.d:
तत्र संतिष्ठते गृध्रः स च मे परमः सुहृत्..
चिरंतनस्तथा सम्यक्स ते ज्ञास्यति तं नृपम्..
कथयिष्यत्यसंदिग्धं मम वाक्यादसंशयम्..191..
5.270.m: A vulture dwells there, and he is my greatest friend, / and ancient too; he will know that king well. / He will surely tell you, without doubt, upon my word."

5.270.s:
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā mārkaṃḍeyādibhistribhiḥ..
proktaḥ sarvairmahābhāga mā tvaṃ praviśa pāvakam..192..
5.270.d:
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा मार्कंडेयादिभिस्त्रिभिः..
प्रोक्तः सर्वैर्महाभाग मा त्वं प्रविश पावकम्..192..
5.270.m: Hearing his words, the king was addressed by all three, / beginning with Mārkaṇḍeya: "O fortunate one, do not enter the fire.

5.270.s:
vayaṃ yāsyāmahe sarve tvayā sārdhaṃ ca tatra hi..
kadācitso'pi jānāti iṃdradyumnaṃ mahīpatim..193..
5.270.d:
वयं यास्यामहे सर्वे त्वया सार्धं च तत्र हि..
कदाचित्सोऽपि जानाति इंद्रद्युम्नं महीपतिम्..193..
5.270.m: All of us will go there along with you; / perhaps he too knows the king Indradyumna."

5.270.s:
teṣāṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvā āśayā parayā yutaḥ..
sa rājā saha taiḥ sarvaiḥ prayayau gaṃdhamādanam..194..
5.270.d:
तेषां तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा आशया परया युतः..
स राजा सह तैः सर्वैः प्रययौ गंधमादनम्..194..
5.270.m: Hearing their words, filled with supreme hope, / the king set out for Gandhamādana together with all of them.

5.270.s:
gṛdhrarājo'pi tāndṛṣṭvā sarvāneva kṛtāṃjaliḥ..
ulūkaṃ purato dṛṣṭvā prahṛṣṭaḥ sanmukho yayau..195..
5.270.d:
गृध्रराजोऽपि तान्दृष्ट्वा सर्वानेव कृतांजलिः..
उलूकं पुरतो दृष्ट्वा प्रहृष्टः सन्मुखो ययौ..195..
5.270.m: Seeing them all with folded hands, / and seeing the owl in front, the king of vultures went to meet them with joy.

5.270.s:
tato'bravītprahṛṣṭātmā svāgataṃ te dvijottama..
cirakālātpradṛṣṭo'si ka ete'nye'tra ye sthitāḥ..196..
5.270.d:
ततोऽब्रवीत्प्रहृष्टात्मा स्वागतं ते द्विजोत्तम..
चिरकालात्प्रदृष्टोऽसि क एतेऽन्येऽत्र ये स्थिताः..196..
5.270.m: Then, joyful in spirit, he said: "Welcome to you, O best of birds! / You are seen after a long time. Who are these others standing here?"

5.270.s:
ulūka uvāca..
eṣa me paramaṃ mitraṃ nāḍījaṃgho bakaḥ smṛtaḥ..
etasyāpi tu mārkaṇḍaḥ saṃsthitaḥ paramaḥ suhṛt..197..
5.270.d:
उलूक उवाच..
एष मे परमं मित्रं नाडीजंघो बकः स्मृतः..
एतस्यापि तु मार्कण्डः संस्थितः परमः सुहृत्..197..
5.270.m: The owl said: / "This is my greatest friend, known as the crane Nāḍījaṅgha; / and Mārkaṇḍa is stationed as his greatest friend.

5.270.s:
asau trailokyavikhyātaḥ saptakalpasmaro bhuvi..
etasyāpi suhṛtkaścinnainaṃ jānāmi satvaram..198..
5.270.d:
असौ त्रैलोक्यविख्यातः सप्तकल्पस्मरो भुवि..
एतस्यापि सुहृत्कश्चिन्नैनं जानामि सत्वरम्..198..
5.270.m: He is renowned in the three worlds, remembering seven aeons on earth. / And someone is his friend; I do not know him directly.

5.270.s:
mriyamāṇo mayā hyeṣa samānī tastavāṃtikam..
ayaṃ jīvati vijñāta iṃdradyumne nareśvare..
no cetpraviśati kṣipraṃ pradīptaṃ havyavāhanam..199..
5.270.d:
म्रियमाणो मया ह्येष समानी तस्तवांतिकम्..
अयं जीवति विज्ञात इंद्रद्युम्ने नरेश्वरे..
नो चेत्प्रविशति क्षिप्रं प्रदीप्तं हव्यवाहनम्..199..
5.270.m: Being about to die, he was brought by me into your presence. / He will live if King Indradyumna is recognized; / otherwise, he will quickly enter the blazing fire.

5.270.s:
sa tvaṃ jānāsi cedbrūhi indradyumnaṃ mahīpatim..
ciraṃtano mayāpi tvaṃ tena praṣṭuṃ samāgataḥ..6.271.200..
5.270.d:
स त्वं जानासि चेद्ब्रूहि इन्द्रद्युम्नं महीपतिम्..
चिरंतनो मयापि त्वं तेन प्रष्टुं समागतः..6.271.200..
5.270.m: Therefore, if you know the king Indradyumna, tell us; / you are also considered ancient by me, and thus I have come to ask."

5.270.s:
gṛdhra uvāca..
indradyumneti vikhyātaṃ rājānaṃ na smarāmyaham..
na dṛṣṭo na śrutaścāpi indradyumno mahīpatiḥ..201..
5.270.d:
गृध्र उवाच..
इन्द्रद्युम्नेति विख्यातं राजानं न स्मराम्यहम्..
न दृष्टो न श्रुतश्चापि इन्द्रद्युम्नो महीपतिः..201..
5.270.m: The vulture said: / "I do not recall a king renowned as Indradyumna; / neither seen nor heard of is King Indradyumna."

5.270.s:
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā so'pi rājā sudurmanāḥ..
manasā cintayāmāsa maraṇe kṛtaniścayaḥ..202..
5.270.d:
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा सोऽपि राजा सुदुर्मनाः..
मनसा चिन्तयामास मरणे कृतनिश्चयः..202..
5.270.m: Hearing his words, the king, very despondent in mind, / reflected in his heart, having resolved upon death.

5.270.s:
tatastu kautukāviṣṭastaṃ papraccha dvijottamam..
karmaṇā kena saṃprāptamāyuṣyaṃ cedṛśaṃ vada..203..
5.270.d:
ततस्तु कौतुकाविष्टस्तं पप्रच्छ द्विजोत्तमम्..
कर्मणा केन संप्राप्तमायुष्यं चेदृशं वद..203..
5.270.m: Then, filled with curiosity, he asked that best of birds: / "Tell me, by what action was such a lifespan obtained [by you]?

5.270.s: tataḥ saṃbhāvayiṣyāmi śrutvā te'haṃ vibhāvasum..204..
5.270.d: ततः संभावयिष्यामि श्रुत्वा तेऽहं विभावसुम्..204..
5.270.m: Then, having heard your [story], I shall enter the fire."

5.270.s:
gṛdhra uvāca.. ahamāsaṃ camatkārapure markaṭakaḥ kila..
upatyakāyāṃ tatraiva raktaśṛṃgasya bhūbhṛtaḥ..205..
5.270.d:
गृध्र उवाच.. अहमासं चमत्कारपुरे मर्कटकः किल..
उपत्यकायां तत्रैव रक्तशृंगस्य भूभृतः..205..
5.270.m: The vulture said: / "Indeed, I was a monkey in Camatkārapura, / right there in the foothills of Mount Raktaśṛṅga.

5.270.s:
tatraivāsti mahacchaṃbhormaṃdiraṃ maṃdaropamam.
citreśvarābhidhānaṃ ca sarvapātakanāśanam..206..
5.270.d:
तत्रैवास्ति महच्छंभोर्मंदिरं मंदरोपमम्.
चित्रेश्वराभिधानं च सर्वपातकनाशनम्..206..
5.270.m: Right there stands a great temple of Śambhu, resembling Mount Mandara, / named Citreśvara, destroying all sins.

5.270.s:
vasaṃte tatra saṃprāpte paurajānapadaistathā..
āgatya caiva sumahānutsavo vihito'bhavat..207..
5.270.d:
वसंते तत्र संप्राप्ते पौरजानपदैस्तथा..
आगत्य चैव सुमहानुत्सवो विहितोऽभवत्..207..
5.270.m: When spring arrived there, a very great festival / was held by the citizens and countrymen who gathered.

5.270.s:
liṃgasya savidhai ramye sarvartuphalitadrume..
kānane kāminīlokakāṃte janamanohare..
liṃgamāropitaṃ cāru tarorāṃdolake mudā.. 208..
5.270.d:
लिंगस्य सविधै रम्ये सर्वर्तुफलितद्रुमे..
कानने कामिनीलोककांते जनमनोहरे..
लिंगमारोपितं चारु तरोरांदोलके मुदा.. 208..
5.270.m: Near the liṅga, in a lovely grove where trees bore fruit in all seasons, / pleasing to loving women and captivating the minds of men, / the charming liṅga was placed with joy on a tree-swing.

5.270.s:
kṛtvā damanakenārcāṃ sthāpyāṃdole suyaṃtrite..
yayuste svagṛhaṃ paścādarcayitvā trilocanam..209..
5.270.d:
कृत्वा दमनकेनार्चां स्थाप्यांदोले सुयंत्रिते..
ययुस्ते स्वगृहं पश्चादर्चयित्वा त्रिलोचनम्..209..
5.270.m: Having performed worship with damanaka flowers and placed it on a well-constructed swing, / they then went to their own homes after worshipping the Three-Eyed One.

5.270.s:
tato'haṃ rajanīvaktre tāṃ dolāṃ sumanoharām..
kautukāviṣṭahṛdayo dolayāmi muhurmuhuḥ..6.271.210..
5.270.d:
ततोऽहं रजनीवक्त्रे तां दोलां सुमनोहराम्..
कौतुकाविष्टहृदयो दोलयामि मुहुर्मुहुः..6.271.210..
5.270.m: Then, at nightfall, my heart seized with curiosity, / I swung that very charming swing again and again.

5.270.s:
evaṃ saṃdolayānasya mama prāptā narāstadā..
kaiścittaistrāsito hatvā laguḍaiḥ sarvatodiśam..211..
5.270.d:
एवं संदोलयानस्य मम प्राप्ता नरास्तदा..
कैश्चित्तैस्त्रासितो हत्वा लगुडैः सर्वतोदिशम्..211..
5.270.m: While I was thus swinging it, men arrived then; / terrified by them as they struck in every direction with clubs,

5.270.s:
tataḥ paṃcatvamāpannastatraivāyatane drutam..
tato jātismaro bhūtvā saṃjāto nṛpamaṃdire..212..
5.270.d:
ततः पंचत्वमापन्नस्तत्रैवायतने द्रुतम्..
ततो जातिस्मरो भूत्वा संजातो नृपमंदिरे..212..
5.270.m: I met with death right there in the temple quickly. / Then, remembering my past lives, I was born in a king's palace,

5.270.s:
koṭīśvarasyavikhyāto nāmnā caiva kuśadhvajaḥ..
pitṛpaitāmahaṃ rājyaṃ mayā prāptaṃ tataḥ kramāt.213..
5.270.d:
कोटीश्वरस्यविख्यातो नाम्ना चैव कुशध्वजः..
पितृपैतामहं राज्यं मया प्राप्तं ततः क्रमात्.213..
5.270.m: as the son of Koṭīśvara, well-known by the name Kuśadhvaja. / Then in due course, I attained the ancestral kingdom.

5.270.s:
koṭīśe samanuprāpte paralokaṃ svakarmaṇā ..
jāgeśvaraṃ mahābhāgaṃ dolayāmi yathecchayā..214..
5.270.d:
कोटीशे समनुप्राप्ते परलोकं स्वकर्मणा ..
जागेश्वरं महाभागं दोलयामि यथेच्छया..214..
5.270.m: When Koṭīśa attained the other world by his own karma, / I swung the glorious Jāgeśvara as I pleased,

5.270.s:
śivasiddhāṃtajairmaṃtrairguruṇā saṃniveditaiḥ..
tataḥ kālena mahatā tuṣṭo devo haro mama..
bhavato varadaścāsmi vākyametaduvāca ha..215..
5.270.d:
शिवसिद्धांतजैर्मंत्रैर्गुरुणा संनिवेदितैः..
ततः कालेन महता तुष्टो देवो हरो मम..
भवतो वरदश्चास्मि वाक्यमेतदुवाच ह..215..
5.270.m: with mantras born of the Śaiva Siddhānta taught by my guru. / Then, after a long time, the god Hara was pleased with me; / he became a granter of boons to me and spoke these words:

5.270.s:
kuśadhvaja pratuṣṭo'smi śraddhayā parayā tava..
varaṃ vṛṇīṣva bhadraṃ te yaḥ sadā manasi sthitaḥ..216..
5.270.d:
कुशध्वज प्रतुष्टोऽस्मि श्रद्धया परया तव..
वरं वृणीष्व भद्रं ते यः सदा मनसि स्थितः..216..
5.270.m: 'Kuśadhvaja, I am well-pleased by your supreme faith; / choose a boon, may good fortune be yours, that ever dwells in your mind.'

5.270.s: tato mayā praṇamyoccaiḥ sa prokto bhagavānharaḥ..217..
5.270.d: ततो मया प्रणम्योच्चैः स प्रोक्तो भगवान्हरः..217..
5.270.m: Then, having bowed deeply, I said to the blessed Hara:

5.270.s:
yadi tuṣṭosi me deva tanmāṃ kuru nijaṃ gaṇam..
trailokyarājyamapi me nānyatsaṃprati rocate..218..
5.270.d:
यदि तुष्टोसि मे देव तन्मां कुरु निजं गणम्..
त्रैलोक्यराज्यमपि मे नान्यत्संप्रति रोचते..218..
5.270.m: 'If you are pleased with me, O God, make me your own attendant; / even kingship over the three worlds does not please me now.'

5.270.s:
evamukto mayā devo vimāne māṃ nidhāya saḥ..
śivalokaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ sahasā māṃ samānayat..219..
5.270.d:
एवमुक्तो मया देवो विमाने मां निधाय सः..
शिवलोकं महापुण्यं सहसा मां समानयत्..219..
5.270.m: Addressed thus by me, the god placed me in an aerial chariot / and swiftly brought me to the exceedingly sacred Śivaloka.

5.270.s:
tataḥ prasādataścāhaṃ bhavānyāśca harasya ca..
krīḍāmi svecchayā tatra gaṇamadhye vyavasthitaḥ..6.271.220..
5.270.d:
ततः प्रसादतश्चाहं भवान्याश्च हरस्य च..
क्रीडामि स्वेच्छया तत्र गणमध्ये व्यवस्थितः..6.271.220..
5.270.m: Then, by the grace of Bhavānī and of Hara, / I played there as I pleased, dwelling in the midst of the gaṇas.

5.270.s:
kasyacittvatha kālasya vimānavaramāśritaḥ ..
svecchayābhramamāṇastu prāpto'traiva mahāgirau .. 221 ..
5.270.d:
कस्यचित्त्वथ कालस्य विमानवरमाश्रितः ..
स्वेच्छयाभ्रममाणस्तु प्राप्तोऽत्रैव महागिरौ .. 221 ..
5.270.m: After some time, however, mounted on an excellent aerial chariot / and wandering at will, I arrived right here on this great mountain.

5.270.s:
vasaṃtasamaye prāpte pravṛtte dakṣiṇānile ..
agniveśyasutā dṛṣṭā vivastrā jalama dhyagā .. 222 ..
5.270.d:
वसंतसमये प्राप्ते प्रवृत्ते दक्षिणानिले ..
अग्निवेश्यसुता दृष्टा विवस्त्रा जलम ध्यगा .. 222 ..
5.270.m: When springtime arrived and the southern wind blew, / I saw the daughter of Agniveśya unclothed in the midst of the water,

5.270.s:
ālibhirbahubhiryuktā krīḍamānā yathecchayā ..
muṣṭigrāhyā tu madhye sā biṃboṣṭhī vārijekṣaṇā .. 223 ..
5.270.d:
आलिभिर्बहुभिर्युक्ता क्रीडमाना यथेच्छया ..
मुष्टिग्राह्या तु मध्ये सा बिंबोष्ठी वारिजेक्षणा .. 223 ..
5.270.m: accompanied by many female friends, sporting at her pleasure, / slender-waisted, bimba-lipped, lotus-eyed,

5.270.s:
bilvastanī śaśāṃkāsyā sarvalakṣaṇalakṣitā ..
tato'haṃ manmathāviṣṭaḥ samabhūvaṃ hi tatkṣaṇāt .. 224 ..
5.270.d:
बिल्वस्तनी शशांकास्या सर्वलक्षणलक्षिता ..
ततोऽहं मन्मथाविष्टः समभूवं हि तत्क्षणात् .. 224 ..
5.270.m: with breasts like bilva fruits, moon-faced, endowed with every auspicious mark. / Thereupon I was instantly possessed by love.

5.270.s:
avatīrya vimānāgryādgṛhītātha kare mayā ..
prakurvāṇātha karuṇaṃ pakṣiṇīkurarī yathā .. 225 ..
5.270.d:
अवतीर्य विमानाग्र्याद्गृहीताथ करे मया ..
प्रकुर्वाणाथ करुणं पक्षिणीकुररी यथा .. 225 ..
5.270.m: Descending from the supreme aerial chariot, she was seized by me by the hand, / while she wept piteously like an osprey bird.

5.270.s:
tataḥ kanyā munīṃdrāṇāṃ yāḥ sthitāstatra vāriṇi ..
rudaṃtyaḥ saṃprayātāstā agniveśyasya saṃnidhau .. 226 ..
5.270.d:
ततः कन्या मुनींद्राणां याः स्थितास्तत्र वारिणि ..
रुदंत्यः संप्रयातास्ता अग्निवेश्यस्य संनिधौ .. 226 ..
5.270.m: Then the daughters of the lordly sages who were present there in the water / ran weeping into the presence of Agniveśya:

5.270.s:
nīyate tvatsutā brahmanvimānavaramāśritā ..
vaimānikena kenāpi krandamānā nirargalam ..227 ..
5.270.d:
नीयते त्वत्सुता ब्रह्मन्विमानवरमाश्रिता ..
वैमानिकेन केनापि क्रन्दमाना निरर्गलम् ..227 ..
5.270.m: 'O brahmin, your daughter, placed in an excellent aerial chariot, / is being carried off by an aerial traveller, crying out uncontrollably!'"

5.270.s:
tacchrutvā kupitaḥ so'tha vyomamārgāvalokanaḥ ..
svāśramātsaṃprayātaḥ sa bhartsamāno muhurmuhuḥ..229..
tiṣṭhatiṣṭheti ca procya staṃbhayāmāsa sarvataḥ ..
tapasogreṇa viprasya vimānaṃ mama saṃsthitam ..229..
5.270.d:
तच्छ्रुत्वा कुपितः सोऽथ व्योममार्गावलोकनः ..
स्वाश्रमात्संप्रयातः स भर्त्समानो मुहुर्मुहुः..229..
तिष्ठतिष्ठेति च प्रोच्य स्तंभयामास सर्वतः ..
तपसोग्रेण विप्रस्य विमानं मम संस्थितम् ..229..
5.270.m:
