Hearing that, enraged and scanning the path of the sky, / he set out from his hermitage, rebuking [me] again and again.
And shouting, 'Halt! Halt!', he paralyzed [it] completely; / by the fierce austerity of the brahmin, my aerial chariot stood still.

5.270.s:
abravīcca tato māṃ sa kopena mahatā'nvitaḥ ..
yasmātpāpa tvayā kanyā krīḍatī vihṛtādhunā .. 6.271.230 ..
5.270.d:
अब्रवीच्च ततो मां स कोपेन महताऽन्वितः ..
यस्मात्पाप त्वया कन्या क्रीडती विहृताधुना .. 6.271.230 ..
5.270.m: Then, filled with great wrath, he said to me: / 'Because, you sinner, of your carrying off just now a maiden at play,

5.270.s:
akāmā māṃsapeśīva yathā gṛdhreṇa durmate ..
tasmādgṛdhro bhavatvāśu mama vākyādasaṃśayam ..231..
5.270.d:
अकामा मांसपेशीव यथा गृध्रेण दुर्मते ..
तस्माद्गृध्रो भवत्वाशु मम वाक्यादसंशयम् ..231..
5.270.m: unwilling, like a piece of meat by a vulture, O evil-minded one! / Therefore, by my word, become a vulture swiftly, without doubt!'

5.270.s:
evamuktastatastena lajjayā'haṃ pariplutaḥ ..
nivedya kanyakāṃ tasmai praṇipatya muhurmuhuḥ .. 232 ..
5.270.d:
एवमुक्तस्ततस्तेन लज्जयाऽहं परिप्लुतः ..
निवेद्य कन्यकां तस्मै प्रणिपत्य मुहुर्मुहुः .. 232 ..
5.270.m: Thus addressed by him, I was overwhelmed with shame. / Restoring the maiden to him and bowing repeatedly,

5.270.s:
tataḥ prokto mayā viprastvagniveśyo mahātapāḥ ..
na mayā te sutā jñātā na kopayitumarhasi..233..
5.270.d:
ततः प्रोक्तो मया विप्रस्त्वग्निवेश्यो महातपाः ..
न मया ते सुता ज्ञाता न कोपयितुमर्हसि..233..
5.270.m: the brahmin Agniveśya of great austerity was then addressed by me: / 'I did not know [she was] your daughter; you ought not to be angry.

5.270.s: gṛdhratvaṃ me yathā na syāttathākuru munīśvara ..234..
5.270.d: गृध्रत्वं मे यथा न स्यात्तथाकुरु मुनीश्वर ..234..
5.270.m: Act so that vulturehood does not befall me, O lord of sages!'

5.270.s:
tato'haṃ tena ca prokto na mithyāvacanaṃ mama ..
kathaṃcijjāyate tasmādgṛdhratvaṃ prabhaviṣyati .. 235 ..
5.270.d:
ततोऽहं तेन च प्रोक्तो न मिथ्यावचनं मम ..
कथंचिज्जायते तस्माद्गृध्रत्वं प्रभविष्यति .. 235 ..
5.270.m: Then I was told by him: 'My word does not prove false / in any way; therefore vulturehood must come to pass.

5.270.s:
ānartasyopadeśena yadā yāsyasi bho'dhama ..
bhartṛyajñaṃ mahābhāgamupadeśakṛte tadā .. 236 ..
5.270.d:
आनर्तस्योपदेशेन यदा यास्यसि भोऽधम ..
भर्तृयज्ञं महाभागमुपदेशकृते तदा .. 236 ..
5.270.m: When, instructed by Ānarta, you go, O wretched one, / to the illustrious Bhartṛyajña for instruction, then,

5.270.s:
tasmācca niṣkṛtiṃ prāpya gṛdhratvaṃ te prayāsyati ..
sa mayā'nveṣamāṇena na dṛṣṭo naiva ca śrutaḥ .
nirviṇṇo gṛdhrabhāvena śāpāṃto na ca me'bhavat .. 237 ..
5.270.d:
तस्माच्च निष्कृतिं प्राप्य गृध्रत्वं ते प्रयास्यति ..
स मयाऽन्वेषमाणेन न दृष्टो नैव च श्रुतः .
निर्विण्णो गृध्रभावेन शापांतो न च मेऽभवत् .. 237 ..
5.270.m: obtaining expiation from him, your vulturehood will depart.' / Though sought by me, he was neither seen nor heard of; / despondent in the state of a vulture, the end of my curse did not come.

5.270.s:
gṛdhra uvāca .. ..
etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ gṛdhatvasya ca kāraṇam ..
āyuṣyaṃ ca yathā jātaṃ mama saṃkhyāvivarjitam .. 238 ..
5.270.d:
गृध्र उवाच .. ..
एतत्ते सर्वमाख्यातं गृधत्वस्य च कारणम् ..
आयुष्यं च यथा जातं मम संख्याविवर्जितम् .. 238 ..
5.270.m: The vulture said: / 'All this has been related to you, both the cause of my vulturehood, / and how my lifespan has become beyond reckoning.'

5.270.s:
indradyumna uvāca .. ..
anujñāṃ dehi me śīghraṃ praviśāmi hutāśanam ..
yena vairāgyamāpanno na hi jīvitumutsahe .. .. 239 ..
evamuktaḥ sa tenātha ciṃtayāmāsa cetasi ..
mamāṃtikaṃ samāyāta evaṃ mitrasamanvitaḥ ..
tatkaromi yathāśaktyā svopakāraṃ sudurlabham .. ..6.271.24...
5.270.d:
इन्द्रद्युम्न उवाच .. ..
अनुज्ञां देहि मे शीघ्रं प्रविशामि हुताशनम् ..
येन वैराग्यमापन्नो न हि जीवितुमुत्सहे .. .. 239 ..
एवमुक्तः स तेनाथ चिंतयामास चेतसि ..
ममांतिकं समायात एवं मित्रसमन्वितः ..
तत्करोमि यथाशक्त्या स्वोपकारं सुदुर्लभम् .. ..6.271.24...
5.270.m:
Indradyumna said: / 'Give me permission at once; I shall enter the fire, / for having attained detachment, I have no desire to live.'
Thus addressed by him, he then reflected in his mind: / 'He has come near me accompanied in this way by a friend; / I shall perform for him, according to my ability, a rare service.'

5.270.s:
tataḥ provāca taṃ prītyā dākṣiṇyaṃ paramaṃ gataḥ ..
mā sādhaya cāgniṃ bhoḥ śṛṇu tāvadvaco mama ..241..
5.270.d:
ततः प्रोवाच तं प्रीत्या दाक्षिण्यं परमं गतः ..
मा साधय चाग्निं भोः शृणु तावद्वचो मम ..241..
5.270.m: Then, displaying supreme courtesy, he said to him with affection: / 'Do not seek the fire, sir; hear my words first.

5.270.s:
ahaṃ te kīrtayiṣyāmi matto yo'pi ciraṃtanaḥ ..242..
yo jñāsyati na saṃdeha iṃdradyumnaṃ mahīpatim ..242..
5.270.d:
अहं ते कीर्तयिष्यामि मत्तो योऽपि चिरंतनः ..242..
यो ज्ञास्यति न संदेह इंद्रद्युम्नं महीपतिम् ..242..
5.270.m:
I shall tell you of one who is even older than I,
who will know King Indradyumna beyond doubt.

5.270.s:
tadāgaccha mayā sārdhaṃ tatsamīpaṃ mahātmanaḥ ..
sahāyaiḥ sahitaḥ sarvairmayā sārdhaṃ tathaiva ca ..243..
5.270.d:
तदागच्छ मया सार्धं तत्समीपं महात्मनः ..
सहायैः सहितः सर्वैर्मया सार्धं तथैव च ..243..
5.270.m: So come with me into the presence of that great-souled one, / accompanied by all your companions, and likewise with me.'

5.270.s:
.. iṃdradyumna uvāca .. ..
kastavāpyadhiko'pyasti jīvitavyena saddvija ..
etanme kautukaṃ bhūri tasmādvada mahāmate .. 244 ..
5.270.d:
.. इंद्रद्युम्न उवाच .. ..
कस्तवाप्यधिकोऽप्यस्ति जीवितव्येन सद्द्विज ..
एतन्मे कौतुकं भूरि तस्माद्वद महामते .. 244 ..
5.270.m: Indradyumna said: / 'Who could there be that exceeds even you in lifespan, O virtuous twice-born? / This is a great wonder to me; therefore tell [me], O noble-minded one!'

5.270.s:
gṛdhra uvāca ..
asti maṃtharakonāma kamaṭhaścirajīvitaḥ ..
mānase sarasi khyāta indradyumnaṃ sa vetsyati .. 245 ..
5.270.d:
गृध्र उवाच ..
अस्ति मंथरकोनाम कमठश्चिरजीवितः ..
मानसे सरसि ख्यात इन्द्रद्युम्नं स वेत्स्यति .. 245 ..
5.270.m: The vulture said: / 'There is a long-lived tortoise named Mantharaka, / renowned in Lake Mānasa; he will know Indradyumna.'

5.270.s:
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā mārkaṃḍādyāśca te trayaḥ ..
tamūcuḥ pārthivaśreṣṭhaṃ maraṇe kṛtaniścayam .. 246 ..
5.270.d:
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा मार्कंडाद्याश्च ते त्रयः ..
तमूचुः पार्थिवश्रेष्ठं मरणे कृतनिश्चयम् .. 246 ..
5.270.m: Hearing those words of his, those three, Mārkaṇḍa and the others, / said to that best of kings who was resolved upon death:

5.270.s:
yuktamuktaṃ mahābhāga gṛdharājena dhīmatā ..
tatra yāsyāmahe sarve yatrāsau kamaṭhaḥ sthitaḥ .. 247 ..
5.270.d:
युक्तमुक्तं महाभाग गृधराजेन धीमता ..
तत्र यास्यामहे सर्वे यत्रासौ कमठः स्थितः .. 247 ..
5.270.m: 'Fitly spoken, O illustrious one, by the wise king of vultures! / We shall all go there where that tortoise dwells.

5.270.s:
anirvedaḥ śriyo mūlaṃ yataḥ śaṃsaṃti paṃḍitāḥ..
nītiśāstravidaḥ sarve tasmādāgaccha gamyatām .. 248 ..
5.270.d:
अनिर्वेदः श्रियो मूलं यतः शंसंति पंडिताः..
नीतिशास्त्रविदः सर्वे तस्मादागच्छ गम्यताम् .. 248 ..
5.270.m: Since learned men, all knowers of political treatises, declare: / "Perseverance is the root of prosperity," therefore come, let us go!'

5.270.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
teṣāṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvākṛcchrānnirvartya pārthivaḥ ..
maraṇādbrāhmaṇaśreṣṭhā vairāgyaṃ paramaṃ gataḥ .. 249 ..
5.270.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
तेषां तद्वचनं श्रुत्वाकृच्छ्रान्निर्वर्त्य पार्थिवः ..
मरणाद्ब्राह्मणश्रेष्ठा वैराग्यं परमं गतः .. 249 ..
5.270.m: Sūta said: / Hearing their words, the king, dissuaded with difficulty from death, / O best of brahmins, attained supreme detachment.

5.270.s:
atha te prasthitāḥ sarve gaṃdhamādanaparvatāt ..
paṃcāpi ca samādiśya mānasaṃ sara uttamam ..
atha prāptāḥ krameṇaiva gacchamānā vihāyasā .. 6.271.250 ..
5.270.d:
अथ ते प्रस्थिताः सर्वे गंधमादनपर्वतात् ..
पंचापि च समादिश्य मानसं सर उत्तमम् ..
अथ प्राप्ताः क्रमेणैव गच्छमाना विहायसा .. 6.271.250 ..
5.270.m: Then, having all five set out from the Gandhamādana mountain, / aiming for the excellent lake Mānasa, / traveling through the sky, they presently arrived.

5.270.s:
mānasaṃ tatsaro ramyaṃ kūrmastoyādvinirgataḥ ..
nidāghe sevamānastu saṃtiṣṭhati yadṛcchayā .. 251 ..
5.270.d:
मानसं तत्सरो रम्यं कूर्मस्तोयाद्विनिर्गतः ..
निदाघे सेवमानस्तु संतिष्ठति यदृच्छया .. 251 ..
5.270.m: At that charming Lake Mānasa, the tortoise had come out of the water; / basking in the heat [of the sun], he was resting at his ease.

5.270.s:
sa ca tāṃścaturo dṛṣṭvā suciraṃ ca nirīkṣya tān ..
parijñāya tataḥ sarvānpranaṣṭaḥ salilaṃ prati .. 252 ..
5.270.d:
स च तांश्चतुरो दृष्ट्वा सुचिरं च निरीक्ष्य तान् ..
परिज्ञाय ततः सर्वान्प्रनष्टः सलिलं प्रति .. 252 ..
5.270.m: And seeing the four of them, gazing at them for a long time, / and recognizing them all, he disappeared into the water.

5.270.s:
atha taṃ kauśikaḥ prāha gacchamānaṃ parāṅmukham ..
bhobho mitrāya māṃ dṛṣṭvā saṃjāto'si parāṅmukhaḥ .. 253 ..
5.270.d:
अथ तं कौशिकः प्राह गच्छमानं पराङ्मुखम् ..
भोभो मित्राय मां दृष्ट्वा संजातोऽसि पराङ्मुखः .. 253 ..
5.270.m: Then the owl said to him as he was turning away and going: / 'Ho, ho, friend! Having seen me, you have turned away?

5.270.s: sunīco'pi gṛhaṃ prāpto bhavetpūjya tamaḥ satām .. 254 ..
5.270.d: सुनीचोऽपि गृहं प्राप्तो भवेत्पूज्य तमः सताम् .. 254 ..
5.270.m: Even the lowest person who arrives at one’s home should be most revered by the virtuous!'

5.270.s:
athāsau toyamadhyasthaḥ śiromātraṃ bahirgataḥ ..
pratyuvācātha taṃ gṛdhraṃ vinayāddvijasattamāḥ .. 255 ..
5.270.d:
अथासौ तोयमध्यस्थः शिरोमात्रं बहिर्गतः ..
प्रत्युवाचाथ तं गृध्रं विनयाद्द्विजसत्तमाः .. 255 ..
5.270.m: Then he, standing in the middle of the water with only his head protruding, / replied to that vulture out of modesty, O best of twice-born:

5.270.s:
nāhaṃ parāṅmukho jāta stvāṃ dṛṣṭvā'naṃtarāvubhau..
paṃcamo'yaṃ samabhyeti yo yuṣmākaṃ mahāpumān .. 256 ..
5.270.d:
नाहं पराङ्मुखो जात स्त्वां दृष्ट्वाऽनंतरावुभौ..
पंचमोऽयं समभ्येति यो युष्माकं महापुमान् .. 256 ..
5.270.m: 'I have not turned away upon seeing you, nor the other two; / this fifth great personage who approaches with you—

5.270.s:
bhayāttasya praṇaṣṭo'hamiṃdradyumnasya bhūpateḥ ..
anena tu pradagdhā me purā pṛṣṭhirmakhāgninā ..
satataṃ yajamānena rocake satpurottame .. 257 ..
5.270.d:
भयात्तस्य प्रणष्टोऽहमिंद्रद्युम्नस्य भूपतेः ..
अनेन तु प्रदग्धा मे पुरा पृष्ठिर्मखाग्निना ..
सततं यजमानेन रोचके सत्पुरोत्तमे .. 257 ..
5.270.m: out of fear of him, King Indradyumna, I fled! / For long ago my back was burned by the fire of the sacrifice of this man / constantly offering sacrifices in the excellent city of Rocaka.

5.270.s:
etadīyaṃ punaḥ smṛtvā bhayaṃ me sumahatsthitam ..
iṃdradyumnasya rājarṣeḥ kīrti saṃśrayaṇaṃ mahat .. 258 ..
5.270.d:
एतदीयं पुनः स्मृत्वा भयं मे सुमहत्स्थितम् ..
इंद्रद्युम्नस्य राजर्षेः कीर्ति संश्रयणं महत् .. 258 ..
5.270.m: Remembering his deed, a very great fear persists in me; / great is the resort of fame of the royal sage Indradyumna.'

5.270.s:
ityevamukte vacane kamaṭhena tadā divaḥ ..
devadūtaḥ samāgacchacchāsanātparameṣṭhinaḥ .. 259 ..
5.270.d:
इत्येवमुक्ते वचने कमठेन तदा दिवः ..
देवदूतः समागच्छच्छासनात्परमेष्ठिनः .. 259 ..
5.270.m: When these words were thus spoken by the tortoise, a messenger of the gods / arrived then from heaven by the command of the Supreme Lord [Brahmā].

5.270.s:
.. devadūta uvāca ..
āgacchāgaccha rājarṣe sāṃprataṃ brahmaṇoṃ'tikam ..
ukto'haṃ brahmaṇā rājankīrtiścāsya pṛthagvidhā .. 6.271.260 ..
5.270.d:
.. देवदूत उवाच ..
आगच्छागच्छ राजर्षे सांप्रतं ब्रह्मणोंऽतिकम् ..
उक्तोऽहं ब्रह्मणा राजन्कीर्तिश्चास्य पृथग्विधा .. 6.271.260 ..
5.270.m: The messenger of the gods said: / 'Come, come, royal sage, now into the presence of Brahmā! / I was told by Brahmā: "O King, his fame is of various kinds;

5.270.s:
yadā prakāśatāṃ yāti svalpāpi jagatī tale ..
tadā''neyo drutaṃ rājā mama loke sudurlabhe [. 261 ..
5.270.d:
यदा प्रकाशतां याति स्वल्पापि जगती तले ..
तदा'ऽनेयो द्रुतं राजा मम लोके सुदुर्लभे [. 261 ..
5.270.m: when even the least [of it] is made known upon the face of the earth, / then the king must be brought swiftly to my realm, so hard to attain."

5.270.s:
tasmādāgaccha gacchāmo vimānārohaṇaṃ kuru ..
nayāmi yena tatpārśvaṃ brahmaṇo'vyaktajanmanaḥ .. 262 ..
5.270.d:
तस्मादागच्छ गच्छामो विमानारोहणं कुरु ..
नयामि येन तत्पार्श्वं ब्रह्मणोऽव्यक्तजन्मनः .. 262 ..
5.270.m: Therefore come, let us go; ascend the aerial chariot, / that I may lead [you] into the presence of Brahmā of unmanifest origin.'

5.270.s:
..iṃdradyumna uvāca .. ..
yadyete suhṛdo mahyaṃ bakakauśikakacchapāḥ ..
mārkaṃḍeyena sahitā āgacchaṃti mayā saha .. 263 ..
5.270.d:
..इंद्रद्युम्न उवाच .. ..
यद्येते सुहृदो मह्यं बककौशिककच्छपाः ..
मार्कंडेयेन सहिता आगच्छंति मया सह .. 263 ..
5.270.m: Indradyumna said: / 'If these friends of mine, the crane, the owl, and the tortoise, / along with Mārkaṇḍeya, come with me,

5.270.s:
āgacchāmi tvayā sārdhaṃ tadahaṃ brahmaṇoṃ'tikam ..
anyathā nāgamiṣyāmi satyametanmayoditam .. 264 .. ..
5.270.d:
आगच्छामि त्वया सार्धं तदहं ब्रह्मणोंऽतिकम् ..
अन्यथा नागमिष्यामि सत्यमेतन्मयोदितम् .. 264 .. ..
5.270.m: then I shall come with you into the presence of Brahmā; / otherwise I will not go: this that I have spoken is true.'

5.270.s:
.. devadūta uvāca .. ..
ete haragaṇāḥ sarve śāpabhraṣṭā kṣitiṃ gatāḥ ..
śāpāṃte harapārśve tu yo yāsyaṃtyasaṃśayam ..265..
5.270.d:
.. देवदूत उवाच .. ..
एते हरगणाः सर्वे शापभ्रष्टा क्षितिं गताः ..
शापांते हरपार्श्वे तु यो यास्यंत्यसंशयम् ..265..
5.270.m: The messenger of the gods said: / 'All these are attendants of Hara who fell to earth through a curse; / at the end of the curse, they will undoubtedly go to Hara’s side.

5.270.s:
tasmādāgaccha gacchāmo muktvātraitāndrutaṃ nṛpa ..
na caiṣāṃ rocate svargo muktvā devaṃ maheśvaram .. 266 ..
5.270.d:
तस्मादागच्छ गच्छामो मुक्त्वात्रैतान्द्रुतं नृप ..
न चैषां रोचते स्वर्गो मुक्त्वा देवं महेश्वरम् .. 266 ..
5.270.m: Therefore come, let us go swiftly, leaving these behind here, O King; / nor does heaven please them, apart from the god Maheśvara.'

5.270.s:
.. iṃdradyumna uvāca .. ..
yadyevaṃ gaccha te bhadraṃ nāhaṃ gaṃtā triviṣṭapam ..
tathātathā yatiṣyāmi bhaviṣyāmi yathā gaṇaḥ .. 267 ..
5.270.d:
.. इंद्रद्युम्न उवाच .. ..
यद्येवं गच्छ ते भद्रं नाहं गंता त्रिविष्टपम् ..
तथातथा यतिष्यामि भविष्यामि यथा गणः .. 267 ..
5.270.m: Indradyumna said: / 'If it is so, go, may good fortune be yours! I will not go to heaven; / I shall strive in such a way that I will become an attendant [of Hara].'

5.270.s:
tatrasthasya dhruvaṃ bhāvi nityaṃ ca patanādbhayam ..
evamuktaḥ sa tenātha samādāya vimānakam .. 268 ..
5.270.d:
तत्रस्थस्य ध्रुवं भावि नित्यं च पतनाद्भयम् ..
एवमुक्तः स तेनाथ समादाय विमानकम् .. 268 ..
5.270.m: For one who remains there, fear of falling is certain and constant.' / Addressed thus by him, the messenger took the aerial chariot,

5.270.s:
brahmalokaṃ gato dūto vailakṣyaṃ paramaṃ gataḥ ..
iṃdradyumnopi prapaccha taṃ kūrmaṃ vinayānvitaḥ .. 269 ..
5.270.d:
ब्रह्मलोकं गतो दूतो वैलक्ष्यं परमं गतः ..
इंद्रद्युम्नोपि प्रपच्छ तं कूर्मं विनयान्वितः .. 269 ..
5.270.m: and went to the world of Brahmā, utterly abashed. / Then Indradyumna, filled with humility, questioned the tortoise:

5.270.s:
ākhyāhi kūrma svaṃ karma yadīdṛktvaṃ ciraṃtanaḥ .
karmaṇā kena tatprāptaṃ kūrmatvaṃ śaṃsa me drutam .. 6.271.270 ..
5.270.d:
आख्याहि कूर्म स्वं कर्म यदीदृक्त्वं चिरंतनः .
कर्मणा केन तत्प्राप्तं कूर्मत्वं शंस मे द्रुतम् .. 6.271.270 ..
5.270.m: 'Tell me, O tortoise, your own past deed, by which you are so ancient. / By what action was that tortoisehood obtained? Tell me quickly.'

5.270.s:
.. kūrma uvāca .. ..
ahamāsaṃ purā vipro bālabhāve vyavasthitaḥ..
camatkārapure ramye śāṃḍilyo nāma viśrutaḥ .. 271 ..
5.270.d:
.. कूर्म उवाच .. ..
अहमासं पुरा विप्रो बालभावे व्यवस्थितः..
चमत्कारपुरे रम्ये शांडिल्यो नाम विश्रुतः .. 271 ..
5.270.m: The tortoise said: / 'Formerly I was a brahmin, in my childhood, / in delightful Camatkārapura, famed by the name of Śāṇḍilya.

5.270.s:
bālakrīḍāsu sarvāsu krīḍamāno yadṛcchayā ..
pakveṣṭikamayaṃ śaṃbhoḥ krīḍatā nirmitaṃ gṛham ..
tatra jāgeśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ hṛtvā'tha viniveśitam .. 272 ..
5.270.d:
बालक्रीडासु सर्वासु क्रीडमानो यदृच्छया ..
पक्वेष्टिकमयं शंभोः क्रीडता निर्मितं गृहम् ..
तत्र जागेश्वरं लिंगं हृत्वाऽथ विनिवेशितम् .. 272 ..
5.270.m: Playing at random in all the games of boys, / a house of burnt bricks was built by me as I played, for Śambhu; / taking a Jāgeśvara liṅga, it was then installed therein.

5.270.s:
tato'haṃ bhaktisaṃyuktaḥ pūjayāmi dinedine ..
krīḍamāno vinā maṃtraiḥ śiśubhiḥ parivāritaḥ .. 273 ..
5.270.d:
ततोऽहं भक्तिसंयुक्तः पूजयामि दिनेदिने ..
क्रीडमानो विना मंत्रैः शिशुभिः परिवारितः .. 273 ..
5.270.m: Then, endowed with devotion, I worshipped day by day, / playing without mantras, surrounded by children.

5.270.s:
kasyacittvatha kālasya maraṇe samupasthite .
jātismaro hyahaṃ vipro jāto vai vaidiśe pure .. 274 ..
5.270.d:
कस्यचित्त्वथ कालस्य मरणे समुपस्थिते .
जातिस्मरो ह्यहं विप्रो जातो वै वैदिशे पुरे .. 274 ..
5.270.m: After some time, when death arrived, / I was born in the city of Vaidiśa as a brahmin remembering my previous births.

5.270.s:
tato me'bhyadhikā jātā bhaktirdevaṃ haraṃ prati ..
kṛttvā bhikṣāṭanaṃ nityaṃ yācayitvā dhanaṃ bahu .. 276 ..
kṛtvā prāsādamātraṃ tu liṃgaṃ saṃsthāpitaṃ mayā ..
pūjayāmi tato bhaktyā devaṃ paśupatiṃ haram .. 276 ..
5.270.d:
ततो मेऽभ्यधिका जाता भक्तिर्देवं हरं प्रति ..
कृत्त्वा भिक्षाटनं नित्यं याचयित्वा धनं बहु .. 276 ..
कृत्वा प्रासादमात्रं तु लिंगं संस्थापितं मया ..
पूजयामि ततो भक्त्या देवं पशुपतिं हरम् .. 276 ..
5.270.m:
Then an even greater devotion arose in me toward the god Hara. / Making my daily rounds for alms and begging for much wealth,
having built merely a temple, a liṅga was installed by me. / Then with devotion I worshipped the god Hara, the Lord of Beasts.

5.270.s:
brahmavidyāsamopeto bhikṣānnakṛtabhojanaḥ ..
brahmacaryasamopetastrikālaṃ ca japañchivam .. 277..
5.270.d:
ब्रह्मविद्यासमोपेतो भिक्षान्नकृतभोजनः ..
ब्रह्मचर्यसमोपेतस्त्रिकालं च जपञ्छिवम् .. 277..
5.270.m: Endowed with knowledge of the Absolute, eating only food received from begging, / observing celibacy, and chanting [the name of] Śiva at the three junctures of the day,

5.270.s:
tatastena prabhāvena saṃjā to'haṃ bhavāṃtare ..
sārvabhaumo mahīpālo jātismaraṇasaṃyutaḥ .. 278 ..
5.270.d:
ततस्तेन प्रभावेन संजा तोऽहं भवांतरे ..
सार्वभौमो महीपालो जातिस्मरणसंयुतः .. 278 ..
5.270.m: by that power I was then born in another life / as a universal monarch, endowed with the remembrance of my previous births.

5.270.s:
tataḥ saṃkhyāvihīnāśca prāsādāḥ kāritā mayā ..
trinetrasya mahārāja kailāsa śikharopamāḥ ..279..
5.270.d:
ततः संख्याविहीनाश्च प्रासादाः कारिता मया ..
त्रिनेत्रस्य महाराज कैलास शिखरोपमाः ..279..
5.270.m: Then countless temples were commissioned by me, / O great king, resembling the peaks of Kailāsa, for the Three-Eyed Lord.

5.270.s:
tathā nirūpitā pūjā bahupuṣpasamudbhavā ..
nānyatkiṃcitkaromyatra dharma dānādikaṃ nṛpa .. 6.271.280 ..
5.270.d:
तथा निरूपिता पूजा बहुपुष्पसमुद्भवा ..
नान्यत्किंचित्करोम्यत्र धर्म दानादिकं नृप .. 6.271.280 ..
5.270.m: Likewise, worship was arranged with a great abundance of flowers. / I performed no other righteous deed, such as charity, here, O king.

5.270.s:
tataḥ kālena mahatā tuṣṭo me śaśiśekharaḥ ..
tataḥ provāca rājarṣe prahasañchlakṣṇayā girā .. 281 ..
5.270.d:
ततः कालेन महता तुष्टो मे शशिशेखरः ..
ततः प्रोवाच राजर्षे प्रहसञ्छ्लक्ष्णया गिरा .. 281 ..
5.270.m: Then, after a long time, the Moon-Crested Lord was pleased with me. / Then, O royal seer, laughing, he spoke in a gentle voice:

5.270.s:
jayadatta pratuṣṭo'smi tava pārthivasattama ..
bhaktyā'nayā drutaṃ brūhi kiṃ te yacchāmi vāṃchitam.. 282 ..
5.270.d:
जयदत्त प्रतुष्टोऽस्मि तव पार्थिवसत्तम ..
भक्त्याऽनया द्रुतं ब्रूहि किं ते यच्छामि वांछितम्.. 282 ..
5.270.m: 'Jayadatta, best of kings, I am well pleased / with this devotion of yours. Speak quickly: what desired [boon] shall I grant you?'

5.270.s:
praṇipatya tato'ṣṭāṃgaṃ stutvā caiva pṛthigvidham ..
mayā prokto haro rājankuru māmajarāmaram ..
sa tatheti pratijñāya gatoṃ'tardhānameva hi .. 283 ..
5.270.d:
प्रणिपत्य ततोऽष्टांगं स्तुत्वा चैव पृथिग्विधम् ..
मया प्रोक्तो हरो राजन्कुरु मामजरामरम् ..
स तथेति प्रतिज्ञाय गतोंऽतर्धानमेव हि .. 283 ..
5.270.m: Having bowed down with eight limbs and praised [him] in various ways, / Hara was addressed by me: 'O king, make me free from old age and death.' / Promising, 'So be it,' he vanished from sight.

5.270.s:
aprameyagatirdevaścaturdaśajagatpatiḥ ..
tato'haṃ tuṣṭisaṃyukto jarāmaraṇavarjitaḥ ..
vicarāmi mahīpṛṣṭhe svecchayā śatru varjitaḥ .. 284 ..
5.270.d:
अप्रमेयगतिर्देवश्चतुर्दशजगत्पतिः ..
ततोऽहं तुष्टिसंयुक्तो जरामरणवर्जितः ..
विचरामि महीपृष्ठे स्वेच्छया शत्रु वर्जितः .. 284 ..
5.270.m: The god of unfathomable course, the lord of the fourteen worlds. / Then, filled with contentment, free from old age and death, / I wandered upon the surface of the earth at will, free from enemies.

5.270.s:
tataḥ kālena mahatā gatena nṛpasattama ..
bahukāmāgnisaṃtaptaḥ śivabhaktivivarjitaḥ .. 285 ..
5.270.d:
ततः कालेन महता गतेन नृपसत्तम ..
बहुकामाग्निसंतप्तः शिवभक्तिविवर्जितः .. 285 ..
5.270.m: Then, after a great time had passed, O best of kings, / tormented by the fire of manifold lust, devoid of devotion to Śiva,

5.270.s:
yāṃyāṃ paśyāmi rūpāḍhyāṃ paranārīṃ manoramām ..
tāṃtāṃ nirīkṣya suciraṃ dharṣayāmi tataḥ param .. 286 ..
5.270.d:
यांयां पश्यामि रूपाढ्यां परनारीं मनोरमाम् ..
तांतां निरीक्ष्य सुचिरं धर्षयामि ततः परम् .. 286 ..
5.270.m: whichever charming wife of another endowed with beauty I saw, / having gazed at her for a long time, I then violated her.

5.270.s: dharmarājabhayatyaktaḥ pārthivatvaṃ samāśritaḥ .. 287 ..
5.270.d: धर्मराजभयत्यक्तः पार्थिवत्वं समाश्रितः .. 287 ..
5.270.m: Free from the fear of Dharmarāja, relying upon my kingship.

5.270.s:
etasminnaṃtare rājanmama pāpena karmaṇā ..
hāhākārastato jātaḥ samagre dharaṇītale .. 288 ..
5.270.d:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे राजन्मम पापेन कर्मणा ..
हाहाकारस्ततो जातः समग्रे धरणीतले .. 288 ..
5.270.m: In the meantime, O king, on account of my sinful deed, / a cry of distress arose over the entire surface of the earth.

5.270.s:
etasminnaṃtare prāpto dharmarājaḥ śivāṃtikam ..
abravītpraṇipatyoccairduḥkhita stadanaṃtaram..289..
tvayā deva mahīpālo jayadatto mahītale ..
yo nirmitaḥ pratuṣṭena jarāmaraṇavarjitaḥ..6.271.29...
5.270.d:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे प्राप्तो धर्मराजः शिवांतिकम् ..
अब्रवीत्प्रणिपत्योच्चैर्दुःखित स्तदनंतरम्..289..
त्वया देव महीपालो जयदत्तो महीतले ..
यो निर्मितः प्रतुष्टेन जरामरणवर्जितः..6.271.29...
5.270.m:
At that juncture, Dharmarāja approached Śiva; / bowing down, he then spoke aloud in grief:
'O God, the king Jayadatta upon the earth, / who was made free from old age and death by you when pleased,

5.270.s:
sa satīnāṃ satītvaṃ ca balānnāśayate kudhīḥ ..
sarvo bhūpabhayāllokaḥ sarvadharmabahiṣkṛtaḥ .. 291 ..
5.270.d:
स सतीनां सतीत्वं च बलान्नाशयते कुधीः ..
सर्वो भूपभयाल्लोकः सर्वधर्मबहिष्कृतः .. 291 ..
5.270.m: that evil-minded one forcibly destroys the chastity of chaste women. / Out of fear of the king, all people have been cast out from all righteous duties.

5.270.s:
saṃjāto vibudhaśreṣṭha na svabhāvātkathaṃcana ..
tasyaikamapi me nāsti bhayaṃ satyaṃ bravīmi te .. 292 ..
5.270.d:
संजातो विबुधश्रेष्ठ न स्वभावात्कथंचन ..
तस्यैकमपि मे नास्ति भयं सत्यं ब्रवीमि ते .. 292 ..
5.270.m: This has occurred, O best of the wise, not at all by their own nature. / He has not even a single fear of me; I speak truth to you.

5.270.s:
tasmādvāraya taṃ śīghraṃ yāvaddharmo na naśyati ..
martyalokādaśeṣeṇa satīnāṃ dharṣaṇena ca .. 293 ..
5.270.d:
तस्माद्वारय तं शीघ्रं यावद्धर्मो न नश्यति ..
मर्त्यलोकादशेषेण सतीनां धर्षणेन च .. 293 ..
5.270.m: Therefore restrain him quickly, before righteousness perishes / completely from the mortal world through the violation of chaste women.'

5.270.s:
evamuktastato devaḥ kopena mahatānvitaḥ ..
śaśāpa māṃ samānīya vepamānaṃ kṛtāñjalim .. 294 ..
5.270.d:
एवमुक्तस्ततो देवः कोपेन महतान्वितः ..
शशाप मां समानीय वेपमानं कृताञ्जलिम् .. 294 ..
5.270.m: Addressed thus, the god, filled with great anger, / had me brought before him, trembling with joined palms, and cursed me:

5.270.s:
yasmādduṣṭasamācāra kṛtaṃ karma vigarhitam ..
tasmānmacchāpa nirdagdhaḥ kamaṭho vai bhaviṣyasi .. 295 ..
5.270.d:
यस्माद्दुष्टसमाचार कृतं कर्म विगर्हितम् ..
तस्मान्मच्छाप निर्दग्धः कमठो वै भविष्यसि .. 295 ..
5.270.m: 'Since, of wicked conduct, you committed a reprehensible deed, / therefore, burned by my curse, you will indeed become a tortoise.'

5.270.s:
tato mayā sudīnena prārthitaḥ parameśvaraḥ ..
śāpāṃtaṃ me kuruṣveśa kuruṣva ca dayāṃ mama .. 296 ..
5.270.d:
ततो मया सुदीनेन प्रार्थितः परमेश्वरः ..
शापांतं मे कुरुष्वेश कुरुष्व च दयां मम .. 296 ..
5.270.m: Then the Supreme Lord was entreatied by me, utterly wretched: / 'O Lord, make an end to my curse; have mercy on me!'

5.270.s:
tatastena punaḥ proktaṃ kalpāṃte ṣaṣṭisaṃjñite ..
svaśarīraṃ punaḥ prāpya madgaṇastvaṃ bhaviṣyasi .. 297 ..
5.270.d:
ततस्तेन पुनः प्रोक्तं कल्पांते षष्टिसंज्ञिते ..
स्वशरीरं पुनः प्राप्य मद्गणस्त्वं भविष्यसि .. 297 ..
5.270.m: Then he spoke again: 'At the end of the kalpa named the sixtieth, / having attained your own body again, you will become my attendant.'

5.270.s:
etasminnaṃtare kūrmaḥ saṃjāto'haṃ mahīpate ..
samudrasalilaṃ prāpya saṃsthito duḥkhito'niśam .. 298 ..
5.270.d:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे कूर्मः संजातोऽहं महीपते ..
समुद्रसलिलं प्राप्य संस्थितो दुःखितोऽनिशम् .. 298 ..
5.270.m: Meanwhile, O ruler of the earth, I became a tortoise. / Reaching the waters of the ocean, I remained constantly miserable.

5.270.s:
kasyacittvathakālasya rājaṃstvaṃ bhūtale sthitaḥ ..
yajanārthaṃ samānītaḥ samudrasalilastvayā ..299...
5.270.d:
कस्यचित्त्वथकालस्य राजंस्त्वं भूतले स्थितः ..
यजनार्थं समानीतः समुद्रसलिलस्त्वया ..299...
5.270.m: After some time, O king, as you dwelt upon the earth, / I was brought from the waters of the ocean by you for the sake of sacrifice.

5.270.s:
sthāpito bhūmipṛṣṭhe tu maṃtrai saṃstaṃbhitastathā ..
mamopari tato yajñāḥ kṛtāḥ śatasahasraśaḥ .. 6.271.300 ..
5.270.d:
स्थापितो भूमिपृष्ठे तु मंत्रै संस्तंभितस्तथा ..
ममोपरि ततो यज्ञाः कृताः शतसहस्रशः .. 6.271.300 ..
5.270.m: Placed upon the surface of the earth and immobilized by mantras, / hundreds of thousands of sacrifices were then performed upon me.

5.270.s:
kriyamāṇaiśca yairdagdhā mama pṛṣṭhiḥ samaṃtataḥ ...
dahyato'pi mahārāja tena yajñāgninā tadā ..
prasādanānmaheśasya na me prāṇātyayo 'bhavat.. 301 ..
5.270.d:
क्रियमाणैश्च यैर्दग्धा मम पृष्ठिः समंततः ...
दह्यतोऽपि महाराज तेन यज्ञाग्निना तदा ..
प्रसादनान्महेशस्य न मे प्राणात्ययो ऽभवत्.. 301 ..
5.270.m: By these being performed, my back was burned all around. / Even while burning with that sacrificial fire at that time, O great king, / by the grace of the Great Lord, there was no loss of my life.

5.270.s:
kevalaṃ jāyate dāho yathā pāpaṃ purā kṛtam..
anubhūtaṃ ca tatsarvaṃ harakopādasaṃśayam .. 302 ..
5.270.d:
केवलं जायते दाहो यथा पापं पुरा कृतम्..
अनुभूतं च तत्सर्वं हरकोपादसंशयम् .. 302 ..
5.270.m: Only burning occurred, just as sin had been committed in the past. / And all that was experienced, beyond doubt, due to the anger of Hara.

5.270.s:
atha prāpte divaṃ caiva tvayi pārthivasattama ..
ekārṇave tu saṃjāte jalapūrṇe dharātale ..
saṃprāptaḥ plavamānastu tato'haṃ mānasaṃ saraḥ .. 303 ..
5.270.d:
अथ प्राप्ते दिवं चैव त्वयि पार्थिवसत्तम ..
एकार्णवे तु संजाते जलपूर्णे धरातले ..
संप्राप्तः प्लवमानस्तु ततोऽहं मानसं सरः .. 303 ..
5.270.m: Then, when you had gone to heaven, O best of kings, / and the earth, flooded with water, became a single ocean, / I then, swimming, reached Lake Mānasa.

5.270.s:
ṣaḍpaṃcāśatpramāṇena kalpā mama ca saṃsthitāḥ ..
caturbhiraparairmokṣaḥ kūrmatvātsaṃbhaviṣyati .. 304 ...
5.270.d:
षड्पंचाशत्प्रमाणेन कल्पा मम च संस्थिताः ..
चतुर्भिरपरैर्मोक्षः कूर्मत्वात्संभविष्यति .. 304 ...
5.270.m: Fifty-six kalpas have elapsed for me; / in four more, release from tortoisehood will occur.

5.270.s:
etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ dīrghāyuṣṭvasya kāraṇam ..
haraprasādakaraṇādbahupuṣpārcanādvibhoḥ .. 305 ..
5.270.d:
एतत्ते सर्वमाख्यातं दीर्घायुष्ट्वस्य कारणम् ..
हरप्रसादकरणाद्बहुपुष्पार्चनाद्विभोः .. 305 ..
5.270.m: All this, the cause of my long life, has been told to you: / from winning the favor of Hara, from worshipping the Lord with abundant flowers,

5.270.s:
kūrmatvaṃ ca yathā jātaṃ kāmadevasya kopataḥ ..
sa tvaṃ vada mahābhāga gṛhāyātasya kiṃ tava ..
karomi sāṃprataṃ kṛtyaṃ śatrorapi hṛdi sthitam .. 306 ..
5.270.d:
कूर्मत्वं च यथा जातं कामदेवस्य कोपतः ..
स त्वं वद महाभाग गृहायातस्य किं तव ..
करोमि सांप्रतं कृत्यं शत्रोरपि हृदि स्थितम् .. 306 ..
5.270.m: and how the tortoisehood arose due to the wrath of the God of Love. / Tell me, O fortunate one, what duty to a guest who has arrived at my home, / even an enemy dwelling in my heart, shall I perform for you now?

5.270.s:
tvayā me suciraṃ kālaṃ dagdhā pṛṣṭhirmakhāgninā ..
adyāpi ca prapaśyāmi tāṃ jvalaṃtīmiva sthitām .. 307 ..
5.270.d:
त्वया मे सुचिरं कालं दग्धा पृष्ठिर्मखाग्निना ..
अद्यापि च प्रपश्यामि तां ज्वलंतीमिव स्थिताम् .. 307 ..
5.270.m: My back was burned by you for a very long time with sacrificial fire; / even today, I see it remaining as if blazing.

5.270.s:
etasmātkāraṇānnaṣṭastvāṃ dṛṣṭvāhaṃ mahīpate ..
kasmāttvaṃ na gataḥ svargaṃ vimāne'pi samāgate ..
etasmātkāraṇāddharmaṃ prakurvaṃti narādhipāḥ .. 308 ..
5.270.d:
एतस्मात्कारणान्नष्टस्त्वां दृष्ट्वाहं महीपते ..
कस्मात्त्वं न गतः स्वर्गं विमानेऽपि समागते ..
एतस्मात्कारणाद्धर्मं प्रकुर्वंति नराधिपाः .. 308 ..
5.270.m: For this reason I fled upon seeing you, O ruler of the earth. / Why did you not go to heaven even when the aerial chariot arrived? / For this reason kings practice righteousness.'

5.270.s:
.. indradyumna uvāca .. ..
svargasthāne ca lokānāṃ nityaṃ ca patanā dbhayam ..
tanna yāsyāmyahaṃ tatra yatiṣyāmi vimuktaye .. 309 ..
5.270.d:
.. इन्द्रद्युम्न उवाच .. ..
स्वर्गस्थाने च लोकानां नित्यं च पतना द्भयम् ..
तन्न यास्याम्यहं तत्र यतिष्यामि विमुक्तये .. 309 ..
5.270.m:
Indradyumna said:
And in the realm of heaven, creatures are constantly afraid of falling.
Therefore I will not go there; I will strive for liberation.

5.270.s:
sa tvaṃ karoṣi cetkṛtyaṃ gṛhāyātasya me makhe ..
ciraṃtanaṃ kathaya me yadyasti tava sauhṛdam .. 6.271.310 ..
5.270.d:
स त्वं करोषि चेत्कृत्यं गृहायातस्य मे मखे ..
चिरंतनं कथय मे यद्यस्ति तव सौहृदम् .. 6.271.310 ..
5.270.m:
If you perform your duty toward me, who have arrived at your home during a sacrifice,
tell me of someone older, if you have any affection [for me].

5.270.s:
.. kūrma uvāca .. ..
lomaśo nāma viprarṣiḥ sa matto'sti ciraṃtanaḥ ..
śrūyate sa mayā dṛṣṭo nadītīraṃ samāśritaḥ ..311.. ..
5.270.d:
.. कूर्म उवाच .. ..
लोमशो नाम विप्रर्षिः स मत्तोऽस्ति चिरंतनः ..
श्रूयते स मया दृष्टो नदीतीरं समाश्रितः ..311.. ..
5.270.m:
The tortoise said:
There is a brahmin seer named Lomaśa, who is older than I.
It is said, and I have seen him, that he resides on a riverbank.

5.270.s:
.. indradyumna uvāca .. ..
tadāgacchata gacchāmo yataḥ sarve drutaṃ svayam..
pṛcchāmo bahukālasya jīvitasya ca kāraṇam..312..
5.270.d:
.. इन्द्रद्युम्न उवाच .. ..
तदागच्छत गच्छामो यतः सर्वे द्रुतं स्वयम्..
पृच्छामो बहुकालस्य जीवितस्य च कारणम्..312..
5.270.m:
Indradyumna said:
Then come, let us all go quickly ourselves to where he is,
and let us ask the cause of his long life.

5.270.s:
atha te sahitāḥ pañca vyomamārgeṇa saṃsthitāḥ ..
atha te dadṛśustatra lomaśaṃ ca nirāśrayam .. 313 ..
5.270.d:
अथ ते सहिताः पञ्च व्योममार्गेण संस्थिताः ..
अथ ते ददृशुस्तत्र लोमशं च निराश्रयम् .. 313 ..
5.270.m:
Then the five of them together travelled by the pathway of the sky,
and there they saw Lomaśa, without any shelter,

5.270.s:
svādhyāyanirataṃ dāṃtaṃ japahomaparāyaṇam ..
savya haste tṛṇaughena chāyārthaṃ vidhṛtena ca .. 314 ..
5.270.d:
स्वाध्यायनिरतं दांतं जपहोमपरायणम् ..
सव्य हस्ते तृणौघेन छायार्थं विधृतेन च .. 314 ..
5.270.m:
devoted to Vedic study, self-controlled, intent upon silent prayer and oblations,
holding a mass of grass in his left hand to provide shade,

5.270.s:
dadhataṃ cākṣamālāṃ ca dakṣiṇena kareṇa hi ..
te taṃ dṛṣṭvā mahātmānaṃ kṛtvā tasya pradakṣiṇām ..
upaviṣṭāstataḥ sarve svāgatenābhinanditāḥ .. 315 ..
5.270.d:
दधतं चाक्षमालां च दक्षिणेन करेण हि ..
ते तं दृष्ट्वा महात्मानं कृत्वा तस्य प्रदक्षिणाम् ..
उपविष्टास्ततः सर्वे स्वागतेनाभिनन्दिताः .. 315 ..
5.270.m:
and indeed holding a rosary with his right hand.
Having seen that great-souled one and circumambulated him,
they all then sat down, welcomed with words of greeting.

5.270.s:
pṛṣṭāstena tataścaiva ke yūyaṃ kimihāgatāḥ ..
viśrabdhaṃ kathyatāṃ mahyaṃ yena sarvaṃ karomyaham .. .. 316 ..
5.270.d:
पृष्टास्तेन ततश्चैव के यूयं किमिहागताः ..
विश्रब्धं कथ्यतां मह्यं येन सर्वं करोम्यहम् .. .. 316 ..
5.270.m:
Then they were questioned by him: “Who are you? Why have you come here?
Tell me with confidence, so that I may do everything [necessary].”

5.270.s:
.. kūrma uvāca .. ..
mārkaṃḍo nāma viprarṣiḥ saptakalpasmaro hyayam ..
indradyumnena cānīto bhūbhujānena sanmune .. 317 ..
5.270.d:
.. कूर्म उवाच .. ..
मार्कंडो नाम विप्रर्षिः सप्तकल्पस्मरो ह्ययम् ..
इन्द्रद्युम्नेन चानीतो भूभुजानेन सन्मुने .. 317 ..

5.270.s:
bakasyāsya samīpe tu nāḍījaṃghasya dhīmataḥ ..
cirāyuriti vijñāya ātmanaścāyuruttamam ..
indradyumnasya vārtārthaṃ dviguṇāyuṣamātmanaḥ .. 318 ..
5.270.d:
बकस्यास्य समीपे तु नाडीजंघस्य धीमतः ..
चिरायुरिति विज्ञाय आत्मनश्चायुरुत्तमम् ..
इन्द्रद्युम्नस्य वार्तार्थं द्विगुणायुषमात्मनः .. 318 ..
5.270.m:
into the presence of this wise crane Nāḍījaṅgha,
knowing him to be long-lived and his own life to be superior,
for news about Indradyumna, as his lifespan was twice as long as his own.

5.270.s:
atha tena na vijñāto yadā sa pṛthivīpatiḥ ..
tadā dvāvapi cāyātāvulūkasyāsya saṃnidhau .. 319 ..
5.270.d:
अथ तेन न विज्ञातो यदा स पृथिवीपतिः ..
तदा द्वावपि चायातावुलूकस्यास्य संनिधौ .. 319 ..
5.270.m:
Then, when that king of the earth was not recognized by him,
both of them came into the presence of this owl.

5.270.s:
dviguṇāstatpramāṇena kalpāścāsya mahātmanaḥ ..
vartaṃte naiva vijñāto nṛpo hyetena saddvija .. 6.271.320 ..
5.270.d:
द्विगुणास्तत्प्रमाणेन कल्पाश्चास्य महात्मनः ..
वर्तंते नैव विज्ञातो नृपो ह्येतेन सद्द्विज .. 6.271.320 ..
5.270.m:
The aeons of this great-souled one are double that measure;
yet the king was not recognized at all by him, O good brahmin.

5.270.s: tatastrayo'pi cānītā gṛdhrarājasya cāntikam .. 321 ..
5.270.d: ततस्त्रयोऽपि चानीता गृध्रराजस्य चान्तिकम् .. 321 ..
5.270.m: Then the three of them were brought into the presence of the king of vultures.

5.270.s:
ṣaṭpañcāśatpramāṇena kalpāścāsya mahātmanaḥ ..
vartante naiva vijñāto nṛpo hyetena saddvija .. 322 ..
5.270.d:
षट्पञ्चाशत्प्रमाणेन कल्पाश्चास्य महात्मनः ..
वर्तन्ते नैव विज्ञातो नृपो ह्येतेन सद्द्विज .. 322 ..
5.270.m:
The aeons of this great-souled one number fifty-six;
yet the king was not recognized at all by him, O good brahmin.

5.270.s:
catvāro'pi samānītā etenaiva mamāntikam ..
cirāyuṣaṃ ca māṃ jñātvā mitrabhāvena te dvija .. 323 ..
5.270.d:
चत्वारोऽपि समानीता एतेनैव ममान्तिकम् ..
चिरायुषं च मां ज्ञात्वा मित्रभावेन ते द्विज .. 323 ..
5.270.m:
Then all four were brought into my presence by him,
having known me to be long-lived, out of friendship, O brahmin.

5.270.s:
mayāpyasau parijñāto dūrādeva samāgataḥ ..
indradyumno dhruvaṃ hyeṣa dagdhā pṛṣṭhiḥ purā mama .. 324 ..
5.270.d:
मयाप्यसौ परिज्ञातो दूरादेव समागतः ..
इन्द्रद्युम्नो ध्रुवं ह्येष दग्धा पृष्ठिः पुरा मम .. 324 ..
5.270.m:
I too recognized him as soon as he arrived from afar:
“This is certainly Indradyumna! In the past, my back was burned

5.270.s:
yena yajñāgninā maṃtrai staṃbhayitvā kṣiteradhaḥ ..
tato'haṃ tadbhayānnaṣṭo gṛdhrādyaiśca nivāritaḥ .. 325 ..
5.270.d:
येन यज्ञाग्निना मंत्रै स्तंभयित्वा क्षितेरधः ..
ततोऽहं तद्भयान्नष्टो गृध्राद्यैश्च निवारितः .. 325 ..
5.270.m:
by him, having immobilized me beneath the earth with sacrificial fire and mantras.”
Then, out of fear of that, I fled, but was restrained by the vulture and others.

5.270.s:
upālaṃbhaistu bahubhiḥ praṇayā jjalamāviśat ..
mayokto'tha sa bhūyo'pi nāhaṃ tava parāṅmukhaḥ .. 326 ..
5.270.d:
उपालंभैस्तु बहुभिः प्रणया ज्जलमाविशत् ..
मयोक्तोऽथ स भूयोऽपि नाहं तव पराङ्मुखः .. 326 ..
5.270.m:
With many reproaches, out of affection, he entered the water.
Then he was told again by me: “I am not averse to you,

5.270.s:
indradyumnena me pṛṣṭhiryena dagdhā makhāgninā ..
etasminnantare svargāddevadūto mahāmanāḥ ..
vimānavaramārūḍhaḥ prāptaścāsya mahātmanaḥ .. 327 ..
5.270.d:
इन्द्रद्युम्नेन मे पृष्ठिर्येन दग्धा मखाग्निना ..
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे स्वर्गाद्देवदूतो महामनाः ..
विमानवरमारूढः प्राप्तश्चास्य महात्मनः .. 327 ..
5.270.m:
by which Indradyumna my back was burned with sacrificial fire.”
In the meantime, a noble messenger of the gods from heaven,
mounted upon an excellent aerial chariot, arrived for this great-souled one.

5.270.s:
kīrtilopācyutaḥ svargādayamāsīnmahīpatiḥ ..
tato vimānamāyātamuktamātre mayā divaḥ .. 328 ..
5.270.d:
कीर्तिलोपाच्युतः स्वर्गादयमासीन्महीपतिः ..
ततो विमानमायातमुक्तमात्रे मया दिवः .. 328 ..
5.270.m:
Because his fame had perished, this king had fallen from heaven.
Then, as soon as I spoke, an aerial chariot arrived from the sky.

5.270.s:
athāsau na gataḥ svargaṃ vinā'smābhirdvijottama ..
mārkaṃḍeyaṃ parityajya tiryagyonigataistribhiḥ .. 329 ..
5.270.d:
अथासौ न गतः स्वर्गं विनाऽस्माभिर्द्विजोत्तम ..
मार्कंडेयं परित्यज्य तिर्यग्योनिगतैस्त्रिभिः .. 329 ..
5.270.m:
Then he would not go to heaven without us, O best of brahmins—
setting aside Mārkaṇḍeya, with the three of us born in animal wombs.

5.270.s:
pṛcchato'sya mayā proktamāyuṣyaṃ cātmanaḥ punaḥ ..
ṣaṇṇavatipramāṇena kalpā me jīvato gatāḥ . 6.271.330 ..
5.270.d:
पृच्छतोऽस्य मया प्रोक्तमायुष्यं चात्मनः पुनः ..
षण्णवतिप्रमाणेन कल्पा मे जीवतो गताः . 6.271.330 ..
5.270.m:
When he asked, I told him of my own lifespan as well:
“Ninety-six aeons have passed as I lived.”

5.270.s:
pṛṣṭo'haṃ pūrvamevātra saṃsthitastava pārśvataḥ ..
ciraṃtanatamo brūhi mayā tvaṃ tu niveditaḥ .. 331 ..
5.270.d:
पृष्टोऽहं पूर्वमेवात्र संस्थितस्तव पार्श्वतः ..
चिरंतनतमो ब्रूहि मया त्वं तु निवेदितः .. 331 ..
5.270.m:
I was asked by him who was situated beside you earlier:
“Speak of the oldest one!” And you were pointed out by me.

5.270.s:
etasmātkāraṇātprāptā vayaṃ sarve tavāṃtikam ..
tasmādyatpṛcchate bhūpa eṣa tvāṃ tatprakīrtaya .. 332 ..
5.270.d:
एतस्मात्कारणात्प्राप्ता वयं सर्वे तवांतिकम् ..
तस्माद्यत्पृच्छते भूप एष त्वां तत्प्रकीर्तय .. 332 ..
5.270.m:
For this reason we have all arrived near you.
Therefore, declare to him what this king asks of you.

5.270.s:
.. bhartṛyajña uvāca .. ..
lomaśo'pyatha taṃ prāha viśrabdhaṃ pṛccha pārthiva ..
avaśyaṃ kathayiṣyāmi yanmāṃ tvaṃ paripṛcchasi .. 333 ..
5.270.d:
.. भर्तृयज्ञ उवाच .. ..
लोमशोऽप्यथ तं प्राह विश्रब्धं पृच्छ पार्थिव ..
अवश्यं कथयिष्यामि यन्मां त्वं परिपृच्छसि .. 333 ..

5.270.s:
.. iṃdradyumna uvāca .. ..
kasmāttvaṃ grīṣmakāle'pi madhyaṃ prāpte divākare ..
nivāsārthaṃ gṛhaṃ ramyaṃ kimarthaṃ na kariṣyasi .. 334 ..
5.270.d:
.. इंद्रद्युम्न उवाच .. ..
कस्मात्त्वं ग्रीष्मकालेऽपि मध्यं प्राप्ते दिवाकरे ..
निवासार्थं गृहं रम्यं किमर्थं न करिष्यसि .. 334 ..
5.270.m:
Indradyumna said:
Why, even in the summer season when the sun has reached its zenith,
do you not make a charming house for your dwelling?

5.270.s:
.. .. lomaśa uvāca .. ..
kasyārthe kriyate gehamanityaṃ jīvitaṃ yataḥ ..
yadi syācchāśvato dehastadarthaṃ kriyate ca tat .. 335 ..
5.270.d:
.. .. लोमश उवाच .. ..
कस्यार्थे क्रियते गेहमनित्यं जीवितं यतः ..
यदि स्याच्छाश्वतो देहस्तदर्थं क्रियते च तत् .. 335 ..
5.270.m:
Lomaśa said:
For whose sake is a house made, since life is impermanent?
If the body were eternal, then it would be made for its sake.

5.270.s:
.. indradyumna uvāca .. ..
sarveṣāmeva lokānāṃ cirāyuḥ śrūyate bhavān ..
tenāhamapi saṃprāpto bhavaddarśanakāmyayā .. 336 ..
5.270.d:
.. इन्द्रद्युम्न उवाच .. ..
सर्वेषामेव लोकानां चिरायुः श्रूयते भवान् ..
तेनाहमपि संप्राप्तो भवद्दर्शनकाम्यया .. 336 ..

5.270.s:
.. lomaśa uvāca .. ..
kalpe kalpe tu saṃprāpte romakaṃ mama naśyati ..
abhāve sarvaromṇāṃ ca tato nāśo bhaviṣyati .. 337 ..
5.270.d:
.. लोमश उवाच .. ..
कल्पे कल्पे तु संप्राप्ते रोमकं मम नश्यति ..
अभावे सर्वरोम्णां च ततो नाशो भविष्यति .. 337 ..

5.270.s:
paśya tvaṃ maccharīre'sminprakāśaṃ romavarjitam ..
na karomi gṛhaṃ tena kāraṇena mahāmate ..338..
5.270.d:
पश्य त्वं मच्छरीरेऽस्मिन्प्रकाशं रोमवर्जितम् ..
न करोमि गृहं तेन कारणेन महामते ..338..
5.270.m:
Behold in this body of mine an area devoid of hair!
For that reason, O highly intelligent one, I do not make a house.

5.270.s:
.. indradyumna uvāca .. ..
kiṃ tvayā vihitaṃ karma yenedṛgjīvitaṃ sthitam ..
kiṃ dānasyaprabhāvo'yaṃ tapaso niyamasya vā .. 339 ..
.. lomaśa uvāca .. ..
ahamāsaṃ purā śūdro daridreṇa pariplutaḥ ..
bhramāmi medinīpṛṣṭha udarasya kṛte sadā ..6.271.34...
5.270.d:
.. इन्द्रद्युम्न उवाच .. ..
किं त्वया विहितं कर्म येनेदृग्जीवितं स्थितम् ..
किं दानस्यप्रभावोऽयं तपसो नियमस्य वा .. 339 ..
.. लोमश उवाच .. ..
अहमासं पुरा शूद्रो दरिद्रेण परिप्लुतः ..
भ्रमामि मेदिनीपृष्ठ उदरस्य कृते सदा ..6.271.34...
5.270.m:
Indradyumna said:
What action was performed by you by which such a life has endured?
Is this the power of giving, of austerity, or of observance?
Lomaśa said:
Formerly I was a śūdra, overwhelmed by poverty.
I constantly wandered on the surface of the earth for the sake of my belly.

5.270.s:
karmayogena mahatā saṃprāpto hāṭakeśvaram..
kṣutkṣāmastu pipāsārto yatraitalliṃgamuttamam ..
avadhūtaṃ tato liṃgaṃ mayā dṛṣṭvā svayaṃbhu tat.. 341 ..
5.270.d:
कर्मयोगेन महता संप्राप्तो हाटकेश्वरम्..
क्षुत्क्षामस्तु पिपासार्तो यत्रैतल्लिंगमुत्तमम् ..
अवधूतं ततो लिंगं मया दृष्ट्वा स्वयंभु तत्.. 341 ..
5.270.m:
Through a great course of destiny, I reached Hāṭakeśvara,
emaciated with hunger and afflicted by thirst, where this excellent liṅga is.
Then, having seen that self-manifest liṅga that was neglected,

5.270.s:
snāpitaṃ toyamādāya śītametatsunirmalam..
tatastu kamalairetairmayā pūjā vinirmitā ..342..
5.270.d:
स्नापितं तोयमादाय शीतमेतत्सुनिर्मलम्..
ततस्तु कमलैरेतैर्मया पूजा विनिर्मिता ..342..
5.270.m:
it was bathed by me, taking this cool, completely pure water.
Then worship was performed by me with these lotus flowers.

5.270.s:
atha pūjāṃ vinirvartya yāvanmārgasamāśritaḥ .. kṣu
tkṣāmakaṇṭhasya tataḥ prāṇā naṣṭāstadā mama ..343..
5.270.d:
अथ पूजां विनिर्वर्त्य यावन्मार्गसमाश्रितः .. क्षु
त्क्षामकण्ठस्य ततः प्राणा नष्टास्तदा मम ..343..
5.270.m:
Then, having concluded the worship, as I set out upon the path,
then my life-breaths vanished, my throat being emaciated with hunger.

5.270.s:
athāhaṃ brāhmaṇagṛhe jāto jātismarastataḥ ..
sarvaṃ smarāmi bhūpāla devadevasyapūjanāt .. 344 ..
5.270.d:
अथाहं ब्राह्मणगृहे जातो जातिस्मरस्ततः ..
सर्वं स्मरामि भूपाल देवदेवस्यपूजनात् .. 344 ..
5.270.m:
Then I was born in the house of a brahmin, remembering my past lives;
I remember everything, O king, from worshipping the god of gods.

5.270.s:
tato mūkatvamāpanno naiva jalpāmi kiṃcana ..
īśāna iti me nāma pitā cakre praharṣitaḥ ..345..
5.270.d:
ततो मूकत्वमापन्नो नैव जल्पामि किंचन ..
ईशान इति मे नाम पिता चक्रे प्रहर्षितः ..345..
5.270.m:
Then I assumed muteness and would not chatter anything at all.
My father, overjoyed, gave me the name Īśāna,

5.270.s:
īśānena yato dattaḥ pūrvamārādhitena ca ..
vairāgyaṃ paramaṃ prāpto iṣṭvā saṃsārasaṃsthitim ..346..
5.270.d:
ईशानेन यतो दत्तः पूर्वमाराधितेन च ..
वैराग्यं परमं प्राप्तो इष्ट्वा संसारसंस्थितिम् ..346..
5.270.m:
because I was given by Īśāna, who had been worshipped formerly.
Having perceived the condition of saṃsāra, I attained supreme dispassion.

5.270.s:
pitā me bahuvātsalyādbheṣajāni prayojayet..
vācārthaṃ maṃtravādāṃśca tathā caivopayācitam ..
brāhmaṇānpṛcchate nityaṃ divārātrimataṃdritaḥ .. 347 ..
5.270.d:
पिता मे बहुवात्सल्याद्भेषजानि प्रयोजयेत्..
वाचार्थं मंत्रवादांश्च तथा चैवोपयाचितम् ..
ब्राह्मणान्पृच्छते नित्यं दिवारात्रिमतंद्रितः .. 347 ..

5.270.s:
tato me jāyate hāsyaṃ nijacitte narādhipa ..
dṛṣṭvā saṃsārasaṃsaktiṃ piturmātuśca bhūriśaḥ ..348..
5.270.d:
ततो मे जायते हास्यं निजचित्ते नराधिप ..
दृष्ट्वा संसारसंसक्तिं पितुर्मातुश्च भूरिशः ..348..
5.270.m: Then laughter arose in my own heart, O king, / seeing the great attachment of my father and mother to worldly life.

5.270.s:
tataśca yauvanaṃ prāptaḥ krameṇa nṛpasattama ..
yadā tadā niśi tyaktvā tāvubhau cātra saṃgataḥ .. 349 ..
tato hṛṣṭamanā nityaṃ pūjayāmi samāhitaḥ ..
īśānaṃ parayā bhaktyā saṃsnāpya salilena ca ..6.271.35...
5.270.d:
ततश्च यौवनं प्राप्तः क्रमेण नृपसत्तम ..
यदा तदा निशि त्यक्त्वा तावुभौ चात्र संगतः .. 349 ..
ततो हृष्टमना नित्यं पूजयामि समाहितः ..
ईशानं परया भक्त्या संस्नाप्य सलिलेन च ..6.271.35...
5.270.m:
Then, having reached youth in due course, O best of kings, / leaving them both at night, I came here.
Then, joyful in mind, I constantly worshipped Īśāna with focused mind / and supreme devotion, bathing him with water

5.270.s:
brāhmaṇītīrthajātena trikālaṃ nṛpasattama ..
śiloṃchavṛttimāsādya prāṇayātrāṃ samācaran ..
nīvārairbadaraiḥ śākaiścirbhaṭaiḥ phalapatrakaiḥ .. 351 ..
5.270.d:
ब्राह्मणीतीर्थजातेन त्रिकालं नृपसत्तम ..
शिलोंछवृत्तिमासाद्य प्राणयात्रां समाचरन् ..
नीवारैर्बदरैः शाकैश्चिर्भटैः फलपत्रकैः .. 351 ..
5.270.m: arising from the Brāhmaṇī tīrtha at the three junctures of the day, O best of kings, / maintaining my life by adopting the livelihood of gleaning grains, / with wild rice, jujube berries, greens, melons, fruits, and leaves.

5.270.s:
tato me bhagavānrudraḥ sarvadeveśvaro haraḥ ..
abravīddarśanaṃ gatvā meghagambhīrayā girā .. 352 ..
5.270.d:
ततो मे भगवान्रुद्रः सर्वदेवेश्वरो हरः ..
अब्रवीद्दर्शनं गत्वा मेघगम्भीरया गिरा .. 352 ..
5.270.m: Then the blessed Rudra, Hara, lord of all the gods, / appeared to my sight and spoke with a voice deep as a thundercloud:

5.270.s:
parituṣṭo'smi te vatsa varaṃ varaya suvate ..
adeyamapi dāsyāmi yadyapi syātsudurlabham.. 353 ..
5.270.d:
परितुष्टोऽस्मि ते वत्स वरं वरय सुवते ..
अदेयमपि दास्यामि यद्यपि स्यात्सुदुर्लभम्.. 353 ..
5.270.m: “I am well pleased with you, child. Choose a boon, O you of noble vows! / Even what is not to be given I shall give, even if it be very difficult to obtain.”

5.270.s:
tatastaṃ praṇipatyoccaiḥ stutvā vākyaiḥ pṛthagvidhaiḥ ..
mayā proktaṃ kuru vibho jarāmaraṇa varjitam..354..
5.270.d:
ततस्तं प्रणिपत्योच्चैः स्तुत्वा वाक्यैः पृथग्विधैः ..
मया प्रोक्तं कुरु विभो जरामरण वर्जितम्..354..
5.270.m: Then, having prostrated before him and praised him aloud with various words, / it was said by me: “O Lord, make me free from old age and death.”

5.270.s:
śrībhagavānuvāca.. amaratvaṃ yato nāsti martyaloke'tra karhicit..
maryādāṃ kuru tasmāttvaṃ jīvitasya svakasya vai..355..
5.270.d:
श्रीभगवानुवाच.. अमरत्वं यतो नास्ति मर्त्यलोकेऽत्र कर्हिचित्..
मर्यादां कुरु तस्मात्त्वं जीवितस्य स्वकस्य वै..355..
5.270.m: The Blessed Lord said: / “Since there is no immortality anywhere in this mortal world, / therefore make a limit to your own life.”

5.270.s:
tato me bhagavānuktaḥ kalpāṃte samupasthite ..
romṇa ekasya me nāśo jāyatāṃ tridaśeśvara..356..
5.270.d:
ततो मे भगवानुक्तः कल्पांते समुपस्थिते ..
रोम्ण एकस्य मे नाशो जायतां त्रिदशेश्वर..356..
5.270.m: Then the Lord was addressed by me: “When the end of an eon arrives, / let there be the loss of one hair of mine, O lord of the gods!

5.270.s:
yadā ca sarvaromṇāṃ me vināśaḥ saṃprajāyate ..
tadā mama gaṇatvaṃ ca jāyatāṃ tāvakaṃ vibho .. 357 ..
5.270.d:
यदा च सर्वरोम्णां मे विनाशः संप्रजायते ..
तदा मम गणत्वं च जायतां तावकं विभो .. 357 ..
5.270.m: And when the destruction of all my hairs occurs, / then let me become one of your gaṇas, O Lord!”

5.270.s:
evaṃ bhaviṣyatītyuktaṃ paraṃ liṃga sadā mama ..
snāpyaṃ jalena caitena brāhmaṇīsaṃbhavena ca .. 398 ..
brahmādyaiḥ pūjanīya ca trikālaṃ dvijasattama ..
mamakaivāsaraṃ yāvattava cāyurbhaviṣyati .. 359 ..
anyo'pi yo naro bhaktyā pūjayiṣyati māmiha ..
snāpayiṣyati sadbhaktyā vipāpmā sa bhaviṣyati .. 6.271.360 ..
nāpamṛtyurbhavettasya kadāciddvijasattama ..
sakṛtsaṃpūjite 'pyevaṃ brahmādyairmatkalevare .. 361 ..
sakṛtpibati yastoyaṃ brahmatīrthasamudbhavam ..
sarvapāpaviśuddhātmā tatkṣaṇājjāyate hi saḥ .. 362 ..
evamuktvātha deveśastataścādarśanaṃ gataḥ .. 363 ..
ahaṃ tu saṃsthitaścātra tataḥ prabhṛti pārthiva ..
pūjayānaśca sadbhaktyā liṃgametatsadaiva hi .. 364 ..
etasmātkāraṇājjātaṃ mamāyurativistṛtam ..
śaṃkarasya prasādena nānyadastīha kāraṇam .. 365 ..
5.270.d:
एवं भविष्यतीत्युक्तं परं लिंग सदा मम ..
स्नाप्यं जलेन चैतेन ब्राह्मणीसंभवेन च .. 398 ..
ब्रह्माद्यैः पूजनीय च त्रिकालं द्विजसत्तम ..
ममकैवासरं यावत्तव चायुर्भविष्यति .. 359 ..
अन्योऽपि यो नरो भक्त्या पूजयिष्यति मामिह ..
स्नापयिष्यति सद्भक्त्या विपाप्मा स भविष्यति .. 6.271.360 ..
नापमृत्युर्भवेत्तस्य कदाचिद्द्विजसत्तम ..
सकृत्संपूजिते ऽप्येवं ब्रह्माद्यैर्मत्कलेवरे .. 361 ..
सकृत्पिबति यस्तोयं ब्रह्मतीर्थसमुद्भवम् ..
सर्वपापविशुद्धात्मा तत्क्षणाज्जायते हि सः .. 362 ..
एवमुक्त्वाथ देवेशस्ततश्चादर्शनं गतः .. 363 ..
अहं तु संस्थितश्चात्र ततः प्रभृति पार्थिव ..
पूजयानश्च सद्भक्त्या लिंगमेतत्सदैव हि .. 364 ..
एतस्मात्कारणाज्जातं ममायुरतिविस्तृतम् ..
शंकरस्य प्रसादेन नान्यदस्तीह कारणम् .. 365 ..
5.270.m:
“So it shall be!” he said. “Moreover, my liṅga must always / be bathed with this water that arises from the Brāhmaṇī,
and must be worshipped by Brahmā and the others at the three junctures of the day, O best of brahmins. / For as long as my day lasts, your life shall endure.
Any other man also who shall worship me here with devotion / and bathe me with sincere devotion shall be freed from sin.
Untimely death shall never befall him, O best of brahmins, / when this body of mine has thus been worshipped even once by Brahmā and the others.
He who even once drinks the water originating from the Brahma-tīrtha / becomes immediately purified of all sins in soul.”
Having spoken thus, the lord of the gods then vanished.
And I have remained here from that time on, O king, / always worshipping this liṅga with true devotion.
For this reason my lifespan has become so extremely vast; / it is by the grace of Śaṃkara, and there is no other reason here.

5.270.s:
.. indradyumna uvāca .. ..
ahamapyarcayiṣyāmi liṃgameta ttvayā saha ..
nānyatra vā gamiṣyāmi mamaivaṃ hṛdi niścayaḥ .. 366 ..
.. lomaśa uvāca .. ..
evaṃ kuru mahābhāga tvamavāpsyasi vāṃchitam ..
harabhaktasya lokasya vāṃchitaṃ nāsti dularbham .. 367 ..
nāḍījaṃgho gṛhaṃ yātu mārkaṃḍagṛdhakauśikāḥ ..
kacchapena samāyuktastvaṃ hi tiṣṭha mamā śrame .. 368 ..
tataḥ procuśca te sarve na vayaṃ tu nareśvara ..
tvāṃ vinā saṃprayāsyāmo bhūya eva nijālayam .
liṃgamārādhayiṣyāmo yadetadbhavatā rcitam .. 369 ..
evamuktvā tu te sarve lomaśasya varāśrame ..
tasthuḥ saṃpūjayāmāsustrikālaṃ liṃgameva tat .. 6.271.370 ..
saṃsnāpya brāhmaṇītoyaiḥ padmā dyaiḥ pūjayaṃti ca .. 371 ..
kasyacittvatha kālasya nārado munisattamaḥ ..
tīrthayātrāprasaṃgena saṃprāptastatra yatra te .. 372 ..
5.270.d:
.. इन्द्रद्युम्न उवाच .. ..
अहमप्यर्चयिष्यामि लिंगमेत त्त्वया सह ..
नान्यत्र वा गमिष्यामि ममैवं हृदि निश्चयः .. 366 ..
.. लोमश उवाच .. ..
एवं कुरु महाभाग त्वमवाप्स्यसि वांछितम् ..
हरभक्तस्य लोकस्य वांछितं नास्ति दुलर्भम् .. 367 ..
नाडीजंघो गृहं यातु मार्कंडगृधकौशिकाः ..
कच्छपेन समायुक्तस्त्वं हि तिष्ठ ममा श्रमे .. 368 ..
ततः प्रोचुश्च ते सर्वे न वयं तु नरेश्वर ..
त्वां विना संप्रयास्यामो भूय एव निजालयम् .
लिंगमाराधयिष्यामो यदेतद्भवता र्चितम् .. 369 ..
एवमुक्त्वा तु ते सर्वे लोमशस्य वराश्रमे ..
तस्थुः संपूजयामासुस्त्रिकालं लिंगमेव तत् .. 6.271.370 ..
संस्नाप्य ब्राह्मणीतोयैः पद्मा द्यैः पूजयंति च .. 371 ..
कस्यचित्त्वथ कालस्य नारदो मुनिसत्तमः ..
तीर्थयात्राप्रसंगेन संप्राप्तस्तत्र यत्र ते .. 372 ..
5.270.m:
Indradyumna said: / “I too will worship this liṅga along with you; / I will not go elsewhere—such is the resolve in my heart.”
Lomaśa said: / “Do so, O noble one! You will obtain your desire. / Nothing desired is difficult to obtain for a person devoted to Hara.
Let Nāḍījaṅgha go home, along with Mārkaṇḍa, the vulture, and the owl; / do you, along with the tortoise, remain in my hermitage.”
Then they all said: “O king, / we shall not go back to our own home without you! / We will worship the liṅga that has been worshipped by you.”
Having spoken thus, they all stayed in the excellent hermitage of Lomaśa / and worshipped that very liṅga at the three junctures of the day.
Having bathed it with the waters of the Brāhmaṇī, they worshipped it with lotuses and other [flowers].
Then after some time, Nārada, the best of sages, / arrived in the course of his pilgrimage to sacred fords at the place where they were.

5.270.s:
atha ? nāradaṃ dṛṣṭvā kṛtvā caivārhaṇakriyām ..
viśrāṃtaṃ ca tato jñātvā papracchurvinayānvitāḥ .. 373 ..
śāpabhraṣṭā vayaṃ sarve yataḥ saṃvartadarśanāt ..
bakādyāścaiva catvāraḥ kūrmāṃtāśca mahāmune .. 374 ..
na sa vijñāyate kvāpi kasminsthāne vyavasthitaḥ ..
kiṃrūpaḥ kiṃpramāṇaśca kimācāraḥ kva saṃsthitaḥ .. 375 ..
sa tvaṃ yadi vijānāsi yatra taṃ saṃsthitaṃ munim ..
tadvadasva mahābhāga na kiṃcitte'styagocaram .. 376 ..
.. śrīnārada uvāca .. ..
ahaṃ jānāmi taṃ samyaksaṃvartaṃ munisattamam ..
guptācāreṇa tiṣṭhaṃtaṃ nānyo vetti kathaṃcanam .. 377 ..
vārāṇāsyāṃ sthito nityaṃ so'vadhūto mahāmuniḥ ..
vivastro maladigdhāṃgaḥ sadāraṇyaṃ samāśritaḥ .. 378 ..
bhikṣārthaṃ kutape kāle samāgacchati tāṃ purīm ..
pāṇipātrakṛtāhāro gṛhaiḥ kaiścitsadaiva hi.. 379 ..
5.270.d:
अथ ? नारदं दृष्ट्वा कृत्वा चैवार्हणक्रियाम् ..
विश्रांतं च ततो ज्ञात्वा पप्रच्छुर्विनयान्विताः .. 373 ..
शापभ्रष्टा वयं सर्वे यतः संवर्तदर्शनात् ..
बकाद्याश्चैव चत्वारः कूर्मांताश्च महामुने .. 374 ..
न स विज्ञायते क्वापि कस्मिन्स्थाने व्यवस्थितः ..
किंरूपः किंप्रमाणश्च किमाचारः क्व संस्थितः .. 375 ..
स त्वं यदि विजानासि यत्र तं संस्थितं मुनिम् ..
तद्वदस्व महाभाग न किंचित्तेऽस्त्यगोचरम् .. 376 ..
.. श्रीनारद उवाच .. ..
अहं जानामि तं सम्यक्संवर्तं मुनिसत्तमम् ..
गुप्ताचारेण तिष्ठंतं नान्यो वेत्ति कथंचनम् .. 377 ..
वाराणास्यां स्थितो नित्यं सोऽवधूतो महामुनिः ..
विवस्त्रो मलदिग्धांगः सदारण्यं समाश्रितः .. 378 ..
भिक्षार्थं कुतपे काले समागच्छति तां पुरीम् ..
पाणिपात्रकृताहारो गृहैः कैश्चित्सदैव हि.. 379 ..
5.270.m:
Then, seeing Nārada and performing the rites of hospitable reception, / and knowing he was rested, full of humility, they asked him:
“We, the four beginning with the crane and ending with the tortoise, O great sage, / fallen by a curse, [can be freed] through the sight of Saṃvarta.
He is not known anywhere, in what place he stays, / of what form, of what stature, of what conduct, and where he resides.
If you know where that sage resides, / then tell us, O noble one; nothing is beyond your sight.”
The venerable Nārada said: / “I know that Saṃvarta well, that best of sages / living with hidden conduct; no other knows him in any way.
That great sage, an avadhūta, constantly stays in Vārāṇasī, / unclothed, his limbs smeared with dirt, always resorting to the forest.
At the midday hour he comes into that city for alms, / using his hands as an alms-bowl, constantly from certain houses.

5.270.s:
bhūyopi yāti sāyāhne kiṃcideva vanāṃtaram ..
tasyāṃ puryāṃ tathārūpāḥ śataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ .. 6.271.380 ..
tiṣṭhaṃti tāpasaśreṣṭhāstasya vakṣyāmi lakṣaṇam ..
bhavadbhiḥ sa yathā jñeyo mama vākyādasaṃśayam .. 381 ..
vārāṇasyāḥ pratolyāṃ ca sthāpanīyaṃ suyatnataḥ ḥ.
kuṇapaṃ caiva guptaṃ ca yathā no vetti kaścana .. 382 ..
yāsyaṃti tāpasāḥ sarve tamatikramya bhūriśaḥ ..
saṃvarto divyadṛṣṭistu śalyaṃ nātikramiṣyati .. 383 ..
nivartanaṃ tu yaścakre bhūbhāgātkuṇapāśrayāt ..
sa saṃvartaḥ parijñeyaḥ praṣṭavyaśca tataḥ param .. 384 ..
yadi pṛcchati kenāhaṃ bhavatāṃ saṃniveditaḥ ..
nāradena tato vācyaṃ sa tvāṃ jānāti vai sadā .. 385 ..
yadi pṛcchati bhūyaḥ sa nāradaḥ kva sa tiṣṭhati .. 386 ..
tato vācyo nivedya tvāṃ pratiṣṭo havyavāhanam .. .. 387 ..
5.270.d:
भूयोपि याति सायाह्ने किंचिदेव वनांतरम् ..
तस्यां पुर्यां तथारूपाः शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः .. 6.271.380 ..
तिष्ठंति तापसश्रेष्ठास्तस्य वक्ष्यामि लक्षणम् ..
भवद्भिः स यथा ज्ञेयो मम वाक्यादसंशयम् .. 381 ..
वाराणस्याः प्रतोल्यां च स्थापनीयं सुयत्नतः ः.
कुणपं चैव गुप्तं च यथा नो वेत्ति कश्चन .. 382 ..
यास्यंति तापसाः सर्वे तमतिक्रम्य भूरिशः ..
संवर्तो दिव्यदृष्टिस्तु शल्यं नातिक्रमिष्यति .. 383 ..
निवर्तनं तु यश्चक्रे भूभागात्कुणपाश्रयात् ..
स संवर्तः परिज्ञेयः प्रष्टव्यश्च ततः परम् .. 384 ..
यदि पृच्छति केनाहं भवतां संनिवेदितः ..
नारदेन ततो वाच्यं स त्वां जानाति वै सदा .. 385 ..
यदि पृच्छति भूयः स नारदः क्व स तिष्ठति .. 386 ..
ततो वाच्यो निवेद्य त्वां प्रतिष्टो हव्यवाहनम् .. .. 387 ..
5.270.m:
Again in the evening he goes to some other forest. / In that city there are hundreds and thousands of foremost ascetics
of such appearance; I shall tell you his distinguishing mark, / so that he can be recognized by you without doubt according to my word.
In the main street of Vārāṇasī, a corpse should be placed with great care, / and concealed, so that no one notices.
All the ascetics will pass by, stepping past it in great numbers; / but Saṃvarta, endowed with divine sight, will not step over the obstacle.
He who turns back from the spot where the corpse lies, / he is to be recognized as Saṃvarta, and must be questioned after that.
If he asks, ‘By whom was I made known to you?’, / then it should be said, ‘Nārada; he indeed always knows you.’
If he asks further, ‘Where is that Nārada staying?’,
then it should be said, ‘Having made you known, he entered the fire.’”

5.270.s:
tacchrutvā nāradavacaḥ sarve vai lomaśādayaḥ ..
vārāṇasīṃ purīṃ prāptāstasya darśanalālasāḥ .. 388 ..
pratolyāṃ kuṇapaṃ sthāpya guptaṃ lokairalakṣitam ..
svayaṃ caiva sthitā dūraṃ prekṣamāṇāḥ prayatnataḥ .. 389 ..
tatastu kutape kāle saṃvartastu samāgataḥ ..
yādṛgrūpaḥ purā prokto nāradena mahātmanā .. 6.271.390 ..
sa dṛṣṭvā kuṇapaṃ tatra divyadṛṣṭyā mahāmuniḥ ..
nivṛttaḥ kṣutpipāsārto naiva śalyamalaṃghayat .. 391 ..
atha te taṃ samuddiśya pṛṣṭhato'nuyayustadā ..
tiṣṭhatiṣṭheti jalpaṃtaḥ prasādaḥ kriyatāmiti . 392 0..
so'pi nirbhartsayannetānnivartadhvamiti bruvan ..
mā gacchata matsamīpamiti procya palāyitam .. 393 ..
atha dūrataraṃ gatvā sa provāca kṣudhānvitaḥ .. 394 ..
kenādiṣṭo'smi yuṣmākaṃ sa śīghraṃ me nivedyatām..
śāpāgnau yena taṃ pāpaṃ bhasmasātprakaromyaham .. 395 ..
5.270.d:
तच्छ्रुत्वा नारदवचः सर्वे वै लोमशादयः ..
वाराणसीं पुरीं प्राप्तास्तस्य दर्शनलालसाः .. 388 ..
प्रतोल्यां कुणपं स्थाप्य गुप्तं लोकैरलक्षितम् ..
स्वयं चैव स्थिता दूरं प्रेक्षमाणाः प्रयत्नतः .. 389 ..
ततस्तु कुतपे काले संवर्तस्तु समागतः ..
यादृग्रूपः पुरा प्रोक्तो नारदेन महात्मना .. 6.271.390 ..
स दृष्ट्वा कुणपं तत्र दिव्यदृष्ट्या महामुनिः ..
निवृत्तः क्षुत्पिपासार्तो नैव शल्यमलंघयत् .. 391 ..
अथ ते तं समुद्दिश्य पृष्ठतोऽनुययुस्तदा ..
तिष्ठतिष्ठेति जल्पंतः प्रसादः क्रियतामिति . 392 0..
सोऽपि निर्भर्त्सयन्नेतान्निवर्तध्वमिति ब्रुवन् ..
मा गच्छत मत्समीपमिति प्रोच्य पलायितम् .. 393 ..
अथ दूरतरं गत्वा स प्रोवाच क्षुधान्वितः .. 394 ..
केनादिष्टोऽस्मि युष्माकं स शीघ्रं मे निवेद्यताम्..
शापाग्नौ येन तं पापं भस्मसात्प्रकरोम्यहम् .. 395 ..
5.270.m:
Having heard those words of Nārada, all of them, Lomaśa and the others, / arrived at the city of Vārāṇasī, eager for his sight.
Having placed a corpse in the main street, hidden and unnoticed by the people, / they themselves stood at a distance, watching carefully.
Then, at the midday hour, Saṃvarta arrived, / of the very appearance previously described by the high-souled Nārada.
Having seen the corpse there with his divine vision, the great sage,
afflicted by hunger and thirst, turned back and did not cross over the bone [obstacle] at all.
Then, addressing him, they followed behind him at that time,
calling out, “Wait! Wait! Grant your grace!”
He too, rebuking them and saying, “Turn back!
Do not come near me!” fled after speaking.
Then, having gone farther off, afflicted with hunger, he said:
“By whom was I pointed out to you? Tell me quickly,
so that in the fire of a curse I may reduce that sinner to ashes!”

5.270.s:
.. ta ūcuḥ .. ..
nāradena samākhyāto bhavānatra sthito hi naḥ ..
kathayitvā tato vahnau saṃpraviṣṭaḥ sa tatkṣaṇāt .. 396 ..
.. saṃvarta uvāca .. ..
ahaṃ tadeva kartā ca tasya duṣṭasya sāṃpratam ..
nirdiṣṭo yena yuṣmākaṃ guptācāraṃ samāśritaḥ .. 397 ..
ta ūcuḥ. .. ..
bhagavannāradenoktastvamasmākaṃ mahāmune ..
cirādanveṣyamāṇānāṃ nānyastvāṃ vetti kaścana .. 398 ..
5.270.d:
.. त ऊचुः .. ..
नारदेन समाख्यातो भवानत्र स्थितो हि नः ..
कथयित्वा ततो वह्नौ संप्रविष्टः स तत्क्षणात् .. 396 ..
.. संवर्त उवाच .. ..
अहं तदेव कर्ता च तस्य दुष्टस्य सांप्रतम् ..
निर्दिष्टो येन युष्माकं गुप्ताचारं समाश्रितः .. 397 ..
त ऊचुः. .. ..
भगवन्नारदेनोक्तस्त्वमस्माकं महामुने ..
चिरादन्वेष्यमाणानां नान्यस्त्वां वेत्ति कश्चन .. 398 ..
5.270.m:
They said:
“You were told to us by Nārada to be residing here.
Having spoken, he entered into the fire that very moment.”
Saṃvarta said:
“I will do that very thing to that wicked one now,
by whom I, living in hiding, was pointed out to you.”
They said:
“O venerable one, you were mentioned to us by Nārada, O great sage,
as we were searching for a long time; no one else knew of you.

5.270.s:
tāvannivedya cāsmākaṃ praviṣṭo havyavāhanam ..
tatkṣaṇādeva vipreṃdra na vidmastatra kāraṇam .. 399 ..
.. saṃvarta uvāca .. ..
ahamapyatisaṃkruddhaḥ śāpātkartuṃ samudyataḥ ..6.271.40...
etadevahi tasmācca svayameva kṛtaṃ ca yat ..0
5.270.d:
तावन्निवेद्य चास्माकं प्रविष्टो हव्यवाहनम् ..
तत्क्षणादेव विप्रेंद्र न विद्मस्तत्र कारणम् .. 399 ..
.. संवर्त उवाच .. ..
अहमप्यतिसंक्रुद्धः शापात्कर्तुं समुद्यतः ..6.271.40...
एतदेवहि तस्माच्च स्वयमेव कृतं च यत् ..0
5.270.m:
Having merely told us that, he entered the fire,
that very moment, O best of brahmins; we do not know the reason for it.”
Saṃvarta said:
“I too, greatly enraged, was ready to act with a curse.
Therefore, that very thing was indeed done by himself.

5.270.s: tasmādvadatha me śīghraṃ kasmādyūyaṃ samāgatāḥ .. 401 ..
5.270.d: तस्माद्वदथ मे शीघ्रं कस्माद्यूयं समागताः .. 401 ..
5.270.m: Therefore, tell me quickly: why have you come?

5.270.s:
ciraṃ sthāsyāmi nātrāhaṃ bhramiṣyāmi purīṃ prati ..
prāṇayātrākṛte bhikṣāṃ kariṣyāmi svayaṃ yataḥ .. 402 ..
5.270.d:
चिरं स्थास्यामि नात्राहं भ्रमिष्यामि पुरीं प्रति ..
प्राणयात्राकृते भिक्षां करिष्यामि स्वयं यतः .. 402 ..
5.270.m:
I will not stay here for long; I shall wander towards the city,
since I will personally beg for alms to sustain my life.

5.270.s:
viśalyaḥ kriyatāṃ mārgaḥ kuṇapaṃ hriyatāṃ ca yat ..
nocecchāpaṃ pradāsyāmi yadyevaṃ na kariṣyatha .. 403 ..
5.270.d:
विशल्यः क्रियतां मार्गः कुणपं ह्रियतां च यत् ..
नोचेच्छापं प्रदास्यामि यद्येवं न करिष्यथ .. 403 ..
5.270.m:
Let the path be cleared of obstacles, and let the corpse be removed;
otherwise I will utter a curse if you do not do so.

5.270.s:
tathāhaṃ naiva vaktavyaḥ kasyaciccātra saṃsthitaḥ .
anveṣayati māṃ nityaṃ maruttaḥ pṛthivīpatiḥ .. 404 ..
5.270.d:
तथाहं नैव वक्तव्यः कस्यचिच्चात्र संस्थितः .
अन्वेषयति मां नित्यं मरुत्तः पृथिवीपतिः .. 404 ..
5.270.m:
Moreover, I must not be spoken of to anyone as residing here.
King Marutta constantly searches for me.

5.270.s:
yajñārthaṃ naiva taṃ bhūpaṃ yājayiṣye kathaṃcana ..
dhiṣaṇena parityakto guruṇā sa mahīpatiḥ .. 405 ..
5.270.d:
यज्ञार्थं नैव तं भूपं याजयिष्ये कथंचन ..
धिषणेन परित्यक्तो गुरुणा स महीपतिः .. 405 ..
5.270.m:
I will by no means officiate at a sacrifice for that king;
that monarch was abandoned by his guru, Dhiṣaṇa [Bṛhaspati].

5.270.s: guruputraṃ ca māṃ jñātvā tato'nveṣayate hi mām .. 406 ..
5.270.d: गुरुपुत्रं च मां ज्ञात्वा ततोऽन्वेषयते हि माम् .. 406 ..
5.270.m: And knowing me to be the guru's brother, he therefore searches for me.”

5.270.s:
.. ta ūcuḥ .. ..
śāpabhraṣṭā vayaṃ sarve catvāro'pi bakādayaḥ ..
pakṣitvaṃ caiva saṃprāptā brahmaśāpena sanmune .. .. 407 ..
5.270.d:
.. त ऊचुः .. ..
शापभ्रष्टा वयं सर्वे चत्वारोऽपि बकादयः ..
पक्षित्वं चैव संप्राप्ता ब्रह्मशापेन सन्मुने .. .. 407 ..
5.270.m:
They said:
“We, all four, Baka and the others, have fallen due to a curse,
and have been reduced to birds by a brahmin's curse, O good sage.

5.270.s:
maheśvaragaṇāścaiva vayaṃ trailokyavaṃditāḥ ..
tiryagyoniṃ samānītā vairāgyaṃ paramaṃ gatāḥ .. 408 ..
5.270.d:
महेश्वरगणाश्चैव वयं त्रैलोक्यवंदिताः ..
तिर्यग्योनिं समानीता वैराग्यं परमं गताः .. 408 ..
5.270.m:
We were attendants of Maheśvara, praised throughout the three worlds;
brought to an animal rebirth, we have attained supreme detachment.

5.270.s:
śāpāṃtastu samādiṣṭastairvipraiḥ strīsamu dbhavaḥ .
tavopadeśatastena bakādyāḥ śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ .. 409 ..
5.270.d:
शापांतस्तु समादिष्टस्तैर्विप्रैः स्त्रीसमु द्भवः .
तवोपदेशतस्तेन बकाद्याः शरणं गताः .. 409 ..
5.270.m:
The end of the curse was decreed by those brahmins to arise from a woman,
[and] by your instruction; therefore we, Baka and the others, have sought refuge [in you].

5.270.s: tasmāttrāhi mahābhāga pakṣitvātsāṃprataṃ vibho .. 6.271.410 ..
5.270.d: तस्मात्त्राहि महाभाग पक्षित्वात्सांप्रतं विभो .. 6.271.410 ..
5.270.m: Therefore deliver us now from the state of birds, O noble, mighty one!

5.270.s:
nirviṇṇāścirakālaṃ ca pakṣitvasya niṣevaṇāt ..
etacca kāraṇaṃ nānyattava saṃgasamudbhavam .. 413 ..
.. saṃvarta uvāca .. ..
yadyevaṃ gamyatāṃ śīghraṃ camatkārapuraṃ prati ..
bhartṛ yajñaḥ sthito'pyatra sarvasaṃdehahārakaḥ .. 412 ..
sa vai dāsyati sarveṣāmupadeśaṃ suśobhanam ..
tena prāpsyatha saṃdehaṃ pūrvīyaṃ ca yathāsthitam .. .. 413 ..
5.270.d:
निर्विण्णाश्चिरकालं च पक्षित्वस्य निषेवणात् ..
एतच्च कारणं नान्यत्तव संगसमुद्भवम् .. 413 ..
.. संवर्त उवाच .. ..
यद्येवं गम्यतां शीघ्रं चमत्कारपुरं प्रति ..
भर्तृ यज्ञः स्थितोऽप्यत्र सर्वसंदेहहारकः .. 412 ..
स वै दास्यति सर्वेषामुपदेशं सुशोभनम् ..
तेन प्राप्स्यथ संदेहं पूर्वीयं च यथास्थितम् .. .. 413 ..
5.270.m:
We are weary of enduring the state of birds for a long time;
and this is the reason, none other, arising from contact with you.”
Saṃvarta said:
“If so, go quickly to Camatkārapura.
Bhartṛyajña resides there, the dispeller of all doubts.
He will indeed give you all auspicious instruction;
through him you will resolve your earlier doubt as it truly is.

5.270.s:
sa pūrvaṃ yājñavalkyo'bhūtsarvaśāstrārthapāragaḥ ..
tato bhavāṃtare'nyasminkātyāyana iti smṛtaḥ .. 414 ..
5.270.d:
स पूर्वं याज्ञवल्क्योऽभूत्सर्वशास्त्रार्थपारगः ..
ततो भवांतरेऽन्यस्मिन्कात्यायन इति स्मृतः .. 414 ..
5.270.m:
Formerly he was Yājñavalkya, thoroughly versed in the meaning of all scriptures;
then, in another birth, he was known as Kātyāyana.

5.270.s:
tato dehāṃtaraṃ prāpya khyāto vararucirdvijaḥ ..
tato dehāṃtare'nyasminveśyāputro babhūva ha .. 415 ..
5.270.d:
ततो देहांतरं प्राप्य ख्यातो वररुचिर्द्विजः ..
ततो देहांतरेऽन्यस्मिन्वेश्यापुत्रो बभूव ह .. 415 ..
5.270.m:
Then, having obtained another body, the brahmin was famous as Vararuci;
then, in yet another body, he became the son of a courtesan.

5.270.s:
ārādhitā brahmasutā devī vāgrūpiṇī sadā ..
na ca tuṣṭā svayaṃ devī kāraṇaṃ vīkṣya kiṃcana .. 416 ..
5.270.d:
आराधिता ब्रह्मसुता देवी वाग्रूपिणी सदा ..
न च तुष्टा स्वयं देवी कारणं वीक्ष्य किंचन .. 416 ..
5.270.m:
The daughter of Brahmā, the goddess who is speech itself, was constantly worshipped [by him],
yet the goddess herself was not pleased, perceiving a certain cause.

5.270.s:
brāhmaṇena prajātastu dehāṃtaṃ prāpya kiṃcana ..
tasya vaktraṃ samāpannā svayameva sarasvatī .. 417 ..
5.270.d:
ब्राह्मणेन प्रजातस्तु देहांतं प्राप्य किंचन ..
तस्य वक्त्रं समापन्ना स्वयमेव सरस्वती .. 417 ..
5.270.m:
Born of a brahmin, when he reached the end of a certain body,
Sarasvatī herself directly entered his mouth.

5.270.s:
pūrvamārādhitā nityaṃ na sā tyajati karhicit ..
tasyāścaryamabhūccānyadyajñe veśyāsutasya hi .. 419 ..
brahmasūtraṃ samabhyeti skaṃdhe niryāti gacchati .. 419 ..
5.270.d:
पूर्वमाराधिता नित्यं न सा त्यजति कर्हिचित् ..
तस्याश्चर्यमभूच्चान्यद्यज्ञे वेश्यासुतस्य हि .. 419 ..
ब्रह्मसूत्रं समभ्येति स्कंधे निर्याति गच्छति .. 419 ..
5.270.m:
Constantly worshipped earlier, she never abandons him.
Another wonder occurred at the sacrifice of that courtesan's son:
the sacred thread would come onto his shoulder, come forth, and depart.

5.270.s:
pūrveṣāmeva lokānāṃ yajñakarmasu saṃsthitān ..
sa saṃdehānharatyeva yathā nānyo'tra kaścana .. 6.271.420 ..
5.270.d:
पूर्वेषामेव लोकानां यज्ञकर्मसु संस्थितान् ..
स संदेहान्हरत्येव यथा नान्योऽत्र कश्चन .. 6.271.420 ..
5.270.m:
He indeed dispels the doubts of ancient people engaged in sacrificial rites,
as no one else here can.”

5.270.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā praṇipatya muhurmuhuḥ ..
gatāste kuṇapaṃ yatra saṃvartena praṇoditāḥ .. 421 ..
5.270.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा प्रणिपत्य मुहुर्मुहुः ..
गतास्ते कुणपं यत्र संवर्तेन प्रणोदिताः .. 421 ..
5.270.m:
Sūta said:
Having heard his words and bowing down repeatedly,
they went to where the corpse was, urged on by Saṃvarta.

5.270.s:
taccākṛṣya tataḥ sarve camatkārapuraṃ gatāḥ ..
vāstusthānapade tīrthe taṃ dṛṣṭvā tatra saṃsthitam .. 422 ..
5.270.d:
तच्चाकृष्य ततः सर्वे चमत्कारपुरं गताः ..
वास्तुस्थानपदे तीर्थे तं दृष्ट्वा तत्र संस्थितम् .. 422 ..
5.270.m:
And having dragged it away, they all went to Camatkārapura.
Having seen him residing there at the sacred ford known as Vāstusthānapada,

5.270.s:
praṇipatya tataḥ procuḥ sarve vinayasaṃsthitāḥ ..
brahmaśāpena nirdagdhā vayaṃ catvāra eva hi .. 423 ..
5.270.d:
प्रणिपत्य ततः प्रोचुः सर्वे विनयसंस्थिताः ..
ब्रह्मशापेन निर्दग्धा वयं चत्वार एव हि .. 423 ..
5.270.m:
having bowed down, they all spoke, established in humility:
“We four were indeed burned by a brahmin's curse:

5.270.s:
pakṣitvaṃ samanuprāptāstrayaḥ kūrmatvamanyakaḥ ..
ya ete ca trayo'smākaṃ sthitāḥ pārśve mahattarāḥ ..424..
5.270.d:
पक्षित्वं समनुप्राप्तास्त्रयः कूर्मत्वमन्यकः ..
य एते च त्रयोऽस्माकं स्थिताः पार्श्वे महत्तराः ..424..
5.270.m:
three attained the state of birds, and another that of a tortoise.
And these three who stand beside us are very great [beings]:

5.270.s:
mārkaṃḍaḥ kathito hyeṣa iṃdradyumnastathā paraḥ ..
tṛtīyo lomaśo nāma vikhyātaḥ sumahātapāḥ .. 425 ..
5.270.d:
मार्कंडः कथितो ह्येष इंद्रद्युम्नस्तथा परः ..
तृतीयो लोमशो नाम विख्यातः सुमहातपाः .. 425 ..
5.270.m:
this one is said to be Mārkaṇḍa, and another is Indradyumna;
the third is known by the name Lomaśa, of very great austerity.

5.270.s:
jīvitavyasya nirviṇṇāstraya eva ca sāṃpratam ..
upadeśapradānena prasādaṃ kartumarhasi .. 426 .. ..
5.270.d:
जीवितव्यस्य निर्विण्णास्त्रय एव च सांप्रतम् ..
उपदेशप्रदानेन प्रसादं कर्तुमर्हसि .. 426 .. ..
5.270.m:
These three too are now weary of living.
You should grant your favor by giving instruction.”

5.270.s:
sūta uvāca .. ..
teṣāṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvā bhartṛyajño mahāmuniḥ ..
abravītsuciraṃ dhyātvā jñātvā divyena cakṣuṣā .. 427 ..
5.270.d:
सूत उवाच .. ..
तेषां तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा भर्तृयज्ञो महामुनिः ..
अब्रवीत्सुचिरं ध्यात्वा ज्ञात्वा दिव्येन चक्षुषा .. 427 ..
5.270.m:
Sūta said:
Having heard their words, the great sage Bhartṛyajña,
having meditated for a long time and known [the matter] with divine sight, said:

5.270.s:
yūyaṃ saptaiva liṃgāni sthāpayadhvaṃ samāgatāḥ ..
hāṭakeśvaraje kṣetre. nāmnā caivāṃtike nibhoḥ .. 428 ..
5.270.d:
यूयं सप्तैव लिंगानि स्थापयध्वं समागताः ..
हाटकेश्वरजे क्षेत्रे. नाम्ना चैवांतिके निभोः .. 428 ..
5.270.m:
“All of you, having assembled, establish seven liṅgas
in the sacred field born of Hāṭakeśvara, near the Lord, under your names.

5.270.s:
tato dānāni saptaiva teṣāmagre prayacchata ..
kulaparvatasaṃjñāni sarvapāpaharāṇi ca .. 429 ..
5.270.d:
ततो दानानि सप्तैव तेषामग्रे प्रयच्छत ..
कुलपर्वतसंज्ञानि सर्वपापहराणि च .. 429 ..
5.270.m:
Then offer seven gifts before them,
named after the principal mountain ranges, which remove all sins.

5.270.s:
tataḥ prāpsyatha cābhīṣṭaṃ vapurdivyaṃ manoramam ..
gaṇatvaṃ devadevasya trine trasya mahātmanaḥ .. 6.271.430 ..
5.270.d:
ततः प्राप्स्यथ चाभीष्टं वपुर्दिव्यं मनोरमम् ..
गणत्वं देवदेवस्य त्रिने त्रस्य महात्मनः .. 6.271.430 ..
5.270.m:
Then you will attain your desired divine, beautiful form,
and the status of attendants of the god of gods, the great-souled Three-Eyed One.”

5.270.s:
.. ta ūcuḥ .. ..
prakīrtaya vibho dānaṃ teṣāṃ yacchāmahe yathā ..
pramāṇaṃ ca vidhānaṃ ca vistareṇa mahāmune ..431..
5.270.d:
.. त ऊचुः .. ..
प्रकीर्तय विभो दानं तेषां यच्छामहे यथा ..
प्रमाणं च विधानं च विस्तरेण महामुने ..431..
5.270.m:
They said:
“O mighty one, proclaim the gifts so that we may bestow them,
and the measure and ritual rule in detail, O great sage!”

5.270.s:
.. bhartṛyajña uvāca .. ..
deyo hemamayo meruḥ kailāso rajatodbhavaḥ ..
kārppāsena himādristu guḍajo gaṃdhamādanaḥ ..432..
5.270.d:
.. भर्तृयज्ञ उवाच .. ..
देयो हेममयो मेरुः कैलासो रजतोद्भवः ..
कार्प्पासेन हिमाद्रिस्तु गुडजो गंधमादनः ..432..

5.270.s:
suvelastu tilairdeyo viṃdhyaḥ śarkarayā tathā ..
lavaṇena tathā śṛṃgī yathoktavidhinā tataḥ .. 433 ..
5.270.d:
सुवेलस्तु तिलैर्देयो विंध्यः शर्करया तथा ..
लवणेन तथा शृंगी यथोक्तविधिना ततः .. 433 ..
5.270.m:
Suvela should be given with sesame seeds, Vindhya likewise with sugar,
and Śṛṅgin with salt, according to the prescribed rule, after that.”

5.270.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā saṃsthāpya vidhipūrvakam ..
saptaliṃgāni taiḥ paścātpradattāḥ kulaparvatāḥ .. 434 ..
5.270.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा संस्थाप्य विधिपूर्वकम् ..
सप्तलिंगानि तैः पश्चात्प्रदत्ताः कुलपर्वताः .. 434 ..
5.270.m: Sūta said: / Hearing that speech of his, and having established [them] according to rule, / the family mountains were then given away by them beside the seven liṅgas. 434.

5.270.s:
iṃdradyumneśvarasyāgre iṃdradyumnaḥ pratāpavān ..
meruṃ hemamayaṃ kṛtvā bhartṛyajñamate sthitaḥ .. 435 ...
5.270.d:
इंद्रद्युम्नेश्वरस्याग्रे इंद्रद्युम्नः प्रतापवान् ..
मेरुं हेममयं कृत्वा भर्तृयज्ञमते स्थितः .. 435 ...
5.270.m: In front of Indradyumneśvara, the valiant Indradyumna, / abiding by the opinion of Bhartṛyajña, made a golden Meru [and offered it]. 435.

5.270.s:
mārkaṃḍeśvaradevasya mārkaṃḍena ca dhīmatā ..
kailāso rājato datto bhaktipūrvaṃ dvijottamāḥ .. 436 ..
5.270.d:
मार्कंडेश्वरदेवस्य मार्कंडेन च धीमता ..
कैलासो राजतो दत्तो भक्तिपूर्वं द्विजोत्तमाः .. 436 ..
5.270.m: And in front of the god Mārkaṇḍeśvara, Kailāsa made of silver / was given with devotion by the wise Mārkaṇḍa, O best of the twice-born. 436.

5.270.s:
kārpāso himavāndattaḥ pālakena dvijātaye ..
gaṃdhamādanasaṃjñastu pradatto guḍajaḥ puraḥ .. 437 ..
5.270.d:
कार्पासो हिमवान्दत्तः पालकेन द्विजातये ..
गंधमादनसंज्ञस्तु प्रदत्तो गुडजः पुरः .. 437 ..
5.270.m: Himavat made of cotton was given by Pālaka to the twice-born; / and the one named Gandhamādana, made of raw sugar, was offered before [it]. 437.

5.270.s:
ghaṃṭakeśvaradevasya ghaṃṭakena dvijottamāḥ ..
kacchapena tu saṃdattaḥ suvelaḥ parvatottamaḥ .. 438 ..
5.270.d:
घंटकेश्वरदेवस्य घंटकेन द्विजोत्तमाः ..
कच्छपेन तु संदत्तः सुवेलः पर्वतोत्तमः .. 438 ..
5.270.m: In front of the god Ghaṇṭakeśvara, O best of the twice-born, / Suvela, the best of mountains, was offered by Ghaṇṭaka; / and by the tortoise, 438.

5.270.s:
kacchapeśvaradevasya purastilamayastathā ..
śārkarastu tadā śailaḥ pradatto bhaktipūrvakam.. 439 ..
5.270.d:
कच्छपेश्वरदेवस्य पुरस्तिलमयस्तथा ..
शार्करस्तु तदा शैलः प्रदत्तो भक्तिपूर्वकम्.. 439 ..
5.270.m: in front of the god Kacchapeśvara, [a mountain] made of sesame seeds [was offered]; / and likewise the mountain made of sugar was then offered with devotion 439.

5.270.s:
śaila īśānasaṃjñena nijadevasya cā'grataḥ ..
vānareśvara devasya purato dvijasattamāḥ .. 6.271.440 ..
5.270.d:
शैल ईशानसंज्ञेन निजदेवस्य चाऽग्रतः ..
वानरेश्वर देवस्य पुरतो द्विजसत्तमाः .. 6.271.440 ..
5.270.m: before his own god by the mountain named Īśāna; / and before the god Vānareśvara, O best of the twice-born, 440.

5.270.s:
gṛdhreṇātha pradattastu lavaṇākhyo mahāgiriḥ..
śṛṃgī nāma mahābhāgaḥ śraddhāpūtena cetasā .. 441 ..
5.270.d:
गृध्रेणाथ प्रदत्तस्तु लवणाख्यो महागिरिः..
शृंगी नाम महाभागः श्रद्धापूतेन चेतसा .. 441 ..
5.270.m: the great mountain made of salt, named Śṛṅgī, / was then offered by the vulture, O fortunate one, with a mind purified by faith. 441.

5.270.s:
tatrāścaryamabhūdviprā dattamātrairnagottamaiḥ ..
pakṣitvaṃ nirgataṃ teṣāṃ kūrmatvamitarasya ca .. 442 ..
5.270.d:
तत्राश्चर्यमभूद्विप्रा दत्तमात्रैर्नगोत्तमैः ..
पक्षित्वं निर्गतं तेषां कूर्मत्वमितरस्य च .. 442 ..
5.270.m: A marvel happened there, O brahmins: merely by the giving of the best of mountains, / their state as birds vanished, and the tortoise-nature of the other disappeared. 442.

5.270.s:
etasminneva kāle tu sarve te tatprabhāvataḥ ..
divyamālyāṃbaradharā divyagaṃdhānulepanāḥ ..
saṃjātā brāhmaṇaśreṣṭhā ye ca tatsaṃmukhe sthitāḥ .. 443 ..
vimānāni ca sarveṣāṃ samāyātāni tatkṣaṇāt .1
5.270.d:
एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु सर्वे ते तत्प्रभावतः ..
दिव्यमाल्यांबरधरा दिव्यगंधानुलेपनाः ..
संजाता ब्राह्मणश्रेष्ठा ये च तत्संमुखे स्थिताः .. 443 ..
विमानानि च सर्वेषां समायातानि तत्क्षणात् .1
5.270.m:
At that very time, by the power thereof, / wearing divine garlands and garments, anointed with divine fragrant pastes, / those who were standing before them became the best of brahmins. 443.
And aerial chariots arrived instantly for them all. 1

5.270.s:
bhartṛyajñamanuprāpya praṇipatya ca tāndvijān ..
kailāsaṃ parvataṃ prāptā vimānavaramāśritāḥ .. 444 ..
5.270.d:
भर्तृयज्ञमनुप्राप्य प्रणिपत्य च तान्द्विजान् ..
कैलासं पर्वतं प्राप्ता विमानवरमाश्रिताः .. 444 ..
5.270.m: Approaching Bhartṛyajña and bowing down to those twice-born, / they reached Mount Kailāsa, mounted on excellent aerial chariots. 444.

5.270.s:
etadvaḥ sarvamākhyātaṃ yathā talliṃgasaptakam ..
hāṭakeśvaraje kṣetre saṃjātaṃ pāpanāśanam ..445..
5.270.d:
एतद्वः सर्वमाख्यातं यथा तल्लिंगसप्तकम् ..
हाटकेश्वरजे क्षेत्रे संजातं पापनाशनम् ..445..
5.270.m: All this has been related to you: how that group of seven liṅgas, / which destroys sins, arose in the sacred field born of Hāṭakeśvara. 445.

5.270.s:
anyo'pi yaḥ punasteṣāṃ liṃgānāṃ bhaktisaṃyutaḥ..
kulaparvatadānaṃ ca kuryātso'pi śivaṃ vrajet..448..
tāni liṃgāni yo martyaḥ prātarutthāya vīkṣate ..
ajñānavihitātpāpātso'pi muktimavāpnuyāt..447..
yaścaitānparvatānsapta krameṇātra prayacchati..
dvijātibhyaḥ svaliṃgānāṃ puratastridivaṃ vrajet ..448..
5.270.d:
अन्योऽपि यः पुनस्तेषां लिंगानां भक्तिसंयुतः..
कुलपर्वतदानं च कुर्यात्सोऽपि शिवं व्रजेत्..448..
तानि लिंगानि यो मर्त्यः प्रातरुत्थाय वीक्षते ..
अज्ञानविहितात्पापात्सोऽपि मुक्तिमवाप्नुयात्..447..
यश्चैतान्पर्वतान्सप्त क्रमेणात्र प्रयच्छति..
द्विजातिभ्यः स्वलिंगानां पुरतस्त्रिदिवं व्रजेत् ..448..
5.270.m:
Any other person who, endowed with devotion to these liṅgas, / performs the gift of the family mountains, he too shall go to Śiva. 446.
Whatever mortal rises early in the morning and beholds these liṅgas / shall obtain liberation even from sin committed through ignorance. 447.
And whoever duly offers these seven mountains here / to the twice-born before their liṅgas shall go to heaven. 448.

5.270.s:
sthitvā kalpāṃtaraṃ tatra saṃsevya ca varāpsarāḥ ..
divyānbhogāṃśca saṃsevya yadā bhūmau prajāyate..
cakravartitvamāsādya sārvabhaumaḥ prajāyate .. 449 ..
5.270.d:
स्थित्वा कल्पांतरं तत्र संसेव्य च वराप्सराः ..
दिव्यान्भोगांश्च संसेव्य यदा भूमौ प्रजायते..
चक्रवर्तित्वमासाद्य सार्वभौमः प्रजायते .. 449 ..
5.270.m: Remaining there for another kalpa, served by choice apsarases, / and having enjoyed celestial pleasures, when he is born on earth, / attaining universal sovereignty, he is born as an emperor. 449.

5.270.s:
ekena tu pradattena jāyate pāpasaṃkṣayaḥ ..
dvābhyāṃ putrāśca pautrāśca vāṃchitāni phalāni ca .. 6.271.450 .
tribhiḥ saṃjāyate rājā caturbhirmaṃḍaleśvaraḥ ..
bhāratasya ca khaṇḍasya svāmī bhavati paṃcabhiḥ .. 451 ..
5.270.d:
एकेन तु प्रदत्तेन जायते पापसंक्षयः ..
द्वाभ्यां पुत्राश्च पौत्राश्च वांछितानि फलानि च .. 6.271.450 .
त्रिभिः संजायते राजा चतुर्भिर्मंडलेश्वरः ..
भारतस्य च खण्डस्य स्वामी भवति पंचभिः .. 451 ..
5.270.m: By giving one [mountain], destruction of sin takes place; / by two, sons, grandsons, and desired fruits [are attained]; 450. / by three, he becomes a king; by four, a ruler of a realm; / by five, he becomes the lord of the land of Bhārata; 451.

5.270.s:
jaṃbudvīpādhipaḥ ṣaṅbhiścakravartī ca saptabhiḥ ..
vidhivatparvatairdattaireta dāha pitāmahaḥ ..452..
5.270.d:
जंबुद्वीपाधिपः षङ्भिश्चक्रवर्ती च सप्तभिः ..
विधिवत्पर्वतैर्दत्तैरेत दाह पितामहः ..452..
5.270.m: by six, the sovereign of Jambudvīpa; and by seven, a universal emperor. / When the mountains are given according to rule, this is what the Grandfather said: 452.

5.270.s:
naraḥ syādbrāhmaṇaśreṣṭhāḥ sadājanmanijanmani ..
na duḥkhito daridro vā vyādhito vā prajāyate .. 453 ..
5.270.d:
नरः स्याद्ब्राह्मणश्रेष्ठाः सदाजन्मनिजन्मनि ..
न दुःखितो दरिद्रो वा व्याधितो वा प्रजायते .. 453 ..
