5.270.m: Such a man, O best of brahmins, in birth after birth, / is never born miserable, poor, or diseased. 453.

5.270.s:
saubhāgyasukhasaṃyuktaḥ sudeho ratnavānbhavet ..
sarvarājyavinirmuktaḥ pratāpī vijitendriyaḥ .. 454 ..
5.270.d:
सौभाग्यसुखसंयुक्तः सुदेहो रत्नवान्भवेत् ..
सर्वराज्यविनिर्मुक्तः प्रतापी विजितेन्द्रियः .. 454 ..
5.270.m: Endowed with good fortune and happiness, having a beautiful body, possessing jewels, / free from all kingdom[-afflictions], valiant, he masters his senses. 454.

5.270.s:
tasmātsarvaprayatnena bhūmipālairviśeṣataḥ ..
etaṃ ca parvatā deyā uddiśya nijadevatāḥ .. 455 ..
iti śrīskāde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye saptaliṃgotpatti māhātmyavṛttāntavarṇanaṃnāmaikasaptatyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 271 ..
5.270.d:
तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन भूमिपालैर्विशेषतः ..
एतं च पर्वता देया उद्दिश्य निजदेवताः .. 455 ..
इति श्रीस्कादे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखण्डे हाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये सप्तलिंगोत्पत्ति माहात्म्यवृत्तान्तवर्णनंनामैकसप्तत्युत्तरद्विशततमोऽध्यायः .. 271 ..
5.270.m:
Therefore, with every effort, particularly by rulers of the earth, / these mountains must be given, dedicated to their own deities. 455.
Thus ends the two hundred seventy-first chapter, entitled 'Description of the Account of the Māhātmya of the Origin of the Seven Liṅgas,' in the Māhātmya of Hāṭakeśvara Sacred Field, in the Nāgarakhaṇḍa, the sixth [part] of the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, in the collection of eighty-one thousand [verses]. 271.

5.271.s:
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. .
yadetadbhavatā proktamīśānasya mahīpateḥ..
īśvareṇa purā dattamāyuryāvatsvavāsaram.. 1 ..
5.271.d:
ऋषय ऊचुः .. .
यदेतद्भवता प्रोक्तमीशानस्य महीपतेः..
ईश्वरेण पुरा दत्तमायुर्यावत्स्ववासरम्.. 1 ..
5.271.m: The seers said: / This which has been spoken by you—that to King Īśāna / a lifespan lasting as long as his own day was given of old by Īśvara— 1.

5.271.s:
kiṃpramāṇaṃ bhavettasya divasasya bravīhi naḥ ..
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
ahaṃ vaḥ kīrtayiṣyāmi pramāṇaṃ divasasya tu .. 2 ..
5.271.d:
किंप्रमाणं भवेत्तस्य दिवसस्य ब्रवीहि नः ..
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
अहं वः कीर्तयिष्यामि प्रमाणं दिवसस्य तु .. 2 ..
5.271.m: tell us, what is the measure of that day? / Sūta said: / I shall declare to you the measure of that day 2.

5.271.s:
māheśvarasya viprendrāḥ śrūyatāṃ gadataḥ sphuṭam ..
nimeṣasya caturbhāgastruṭiḥ syāttaddvayaṃ lavaḥ .. 3 ..
5.271.d:
माहेश्वरस्य विप्रेन्द्राः श्रूयतां गदतः स्फुटम् ..
निमेषस्य चतुर्भागस्त्रुटिः स्यात्तद्द्वयं लवः .. 3 ..
5.271.m: of the Great Lord, O best of brahmins; listen clearly as it is spoken: / A truṭi is the fourth part of a nimeṣa; two of them make a lava; 3.

5.271.s:
lavadvayaṃ yavaḥ proktaḥ kāṣṭhā te daśa paṃca ca ..
triṃśatkāṣṭhāḥ kalāmāhuḥ kṣaṇastriṃśatkalo mataḥ .. 4 ..
5.271.d:
लवद्वयं यवः प्रोक्तः काष्ठा ते दश पंच च ..
त्रिंशत्काष्ठाः कलामाहुः क्षणस्त्रिंशत्कलो मतः .. 4 ..
5.271.m: two lavas are called a yava; fifteen of them make a kāṣṭhā; / thirty kāṣṭhās they call a kalā; a kṣaṇa is considered to be thirty kalās; 4.

5.271.s:
kṣaṇaiḥ ṣaṣṭyā palaṃ proktaṃ ṣaṣṭyā teṣāṃ ca nāḍikā ..
nāḍikādvitayenaiva muhūrtaṃ parikīrtitam .. 5 ..
5.271.d:
क्षणैः षष्ट्या पलं प्रोक्तं षष्ट्या तेषां च नाडिका ..
नाडिकाद्वितयेनैव मुहूर्तं परिकीर्तितम् .. 5 ..
5.271.m: by sixty kṣaṇas a pala is declared; and by sixty of those, a nāḍikā; / by two nāḍikās, a muhūrta is proclaimed; 5.

5.271.s:
triṃśanmuhūrttamuddiṣṭamahorātraṃ manīṣibhiḥ ..
māsastriṃśadahorātraidvau dvau māsāvṛtuṃ viduḥ .. 6 ..
5.271.d:
त्रिंशन्मुहूर्त्तमुद्दिष्टमहोरात्रं मनीषिभिः ..
मासस्त्रिंशदहोरात्रैद्वौ द्वौ मासावृतुं विदुः .. 6 ..
5.271.m: a day and night is designated by the wise as thirty muhūrtas; / a month consists of thirty days and nights; two months each are known as a season; 6.

5.271.s:
ṛtutrayaṃ cāpyayanamayane dve tu vatsaram ..
mānuṣāṇāṃ hi sarveṣāṃ sa eva parikīrtitaḥ .. 7 ..
5.271.d:
ऋतुत्रयं चाप्ययनमयने द्वे तु वत्सरम् ..
मानुषाणां हि सर्वेषां स एव परिकीर्तितः .. 7 ..
5.271.m: three seasons make a solstice; and two solstices make a year. / Indeed, that very [year] is proclaimed for all mortal men. 7.

5.271.s:
sa devānāmahorātraṃ purāṇajñāḥ pracakṣate ..
ayanaṃ cottaraṃ śuklaṃ yaddevānāṃ dinaṃ ca tat ..
yaddakṣiṇaṃ tu sā rātriḥ śubhakarmavigarhitā .. 8 ..
5.271.d:
स देवानामहोरात्रं पुराणज्ञाः प्रचक्षते ..
अयनं चोत्तरं शुक्लं यद्देवानां दिनं च तत् ..
यद्दक्षिणं तु सा रात्रिः शुभकर्मविगर्हिता .. 8 ..
5.271.m: The knowers of the Purāṇas declare that to be a day and night of the gods: / the northern solstice, which is bright, is the day of the gods; / that which is the southern is the night, censured for auspicious rites. 8.

5.271.s:
yathā supto na gṛhṇāti kiṃcidbhogādikaṃ naraḥ ..
tathā devāśca yajñāṃśānna gṛhṇanti kathaṃ cana .. 9 ..
5.271.d:
यथा सुप्तो न गृह्णाति किंचिद्भोगादिकं नरः ..
तथा देवाश्च यज्ञांशान्न गृह्णन्ति कथं चन .. 9 ..
5.271.m: Just as a sleeping man does not receive any enjoyments or the like, / so the gods do not receive portions of the sacrifice in any way. 9.

5.271.s:
anenaiva tu mānena mānavena dvijottamāḥ ..
lakṣaiḥ saptadaśākhyaistu vatsarāṇāṃ prakīrtitam .. 6.272.10 ..
5.271.d:
अनेनैव तु मानेन मानवेन द्विजोत्तमाः ..
लक्षैः सप्तदशाख्यैस्तु वत्सराणां प्रकीर्तितम् .. 6.272.10 ..
5.271.m: By this very human reckoning, O best of the twice-born, / seventeen hundred thousand 10.

5.271.s:
aṣṭāviṃśatsahasraistu vatsarāṇāṃ kṛtaṃ yugam ..
tasmiñchveto'bhavadviṣṇurbhagavānyo jagadguruḥ .. 11 ..
5.271.d:
अष्टाविंशत्सहस्रैस्तु वत्सराणां कृतं युगम् ..
तस्मिञ्छ्वेतोऽभवद्विष्णुर्भगवान्यो जगद्गुरुः .. 11 ..
5.271.m: and twenty-eight thousand years are proclaimed as the Kṛta Yuga. / In it, the venerable Viṣṇu, who is the teacher of the world, became white. 11.

5.271.s:
lokāḥ pāpavinirmuktāḥ śāṃtā dāṃtā jitendriyāḥ ..
dīrghāyuṣastathā sarve sadaiva tapasi sthitāḥ .. 12 ..
5.271.d:
लोकाः पापविनिर्मुक्ताः शांता दांता जितेन्द्रियाः ..
दीर्घायुषस्तथा सर्वे सदैव तपसि स्थिताः .. 12 ..
5.271.m: People were free from sin, tranquil, self-restrained, mastering their senses, / long-lived, and all constantly established in austerity. 12.

5.271.s:
yo yathā janma cāpnoti tathā sa mriyate naraḥ..
na putrasaṃbhavo mṛtyurvīkṣyate janakaiḥ kvacit .. 13 ..
5.271.d:
यो यथा जन्म चाप्नोति तथा स म्रियते नरः..
न पुत्रसंभवो मृत्युर्वीक्ष्यते जनकैः क्वचित् .. 13 ..
5.271.m: As a person was born, so he died [in natural order]; / the death of a son was never witnessed by parents. 13.

5.271.s:
kāmaḥ krodhastathā lobho daṃbho matsara eva ca ..
na jāyate nṛṇāṃ tatra yuge tu dvijasattamāḥ ..14..
5.271.d:
कामः क्रोधस्तथा लोभो दंभो मत्सर एव च ..
न जायते नृणां तत्र युगे तु द्विजसत्तमाः ..14..
5.271.m: Desire, anger, greed, deceit, and envy / did not arise among men in that yuga, O best of the twice-born. 14.

5.271.s:
tatastretāyugaṃ bhāvi dvitīyaṃ munisattamāḥ ..
pādenaikena pāpaṃ tu raudraṃ dharme tadāviśat .. 15 ..
5.271.d:
ततस्त्रेतायुगं भावि द्वितीयं मुनिसत्तमाः ..
पादेनैकेन पापं तु रौद्रं धर्मे तदाविशत् .. 15 ..
5.271.m: After that comes the Tretā Yuga, the second, O best of sages; / then terrible sin entered into dharma by a single quarter. 15.

5.271.s:
tato raktatvamabhyeti bhagavānmadhusūdanaḥ ..
pāpāṃśe'pi ca saṃprāpte sasparddho jāyate janaḥ .. 16 ..
5.271.d:
ततो रक्तत्वमभ्येति भगवान्मधुसूदनः ..
पापांशेऽपि च संप्राप्ते सस्पर्द्धो जायते जनः .. 16 ..
5.271.m: Then the venerable Madhusūdana attains red coloration; / and when a fraction of sin arrived, people became competitive. 16.

5.271.s:
svargamārgakṛte sarve cakruryajñāṃstataḥ param ..
agniṣṭomādikāṃstatra bahuhomādikāṃstathā .. 17 ..
5.271.d:
स्वर्गमार्गकृते सर्वे चक्रुर्यज्ञांस्ततः परम् ..
अग्निष्टोमादिकांस्तत्र बहुहोमादिकांस्तथा .. 17 ..
5.271.m: For the sake of the path to heaven, all performed sacrifices thereafter— / the Agniṣṭoma and others there, and many burnt offerings and the like. 17.

5.271.s:
devalokāṃstato yāṃti mūlādyāvaccaturdaśa ..
brahmalokasya paryaṃtaṃ svakīyairya jñakarmabhiḥ ..19..
kiṃcitsvalpāyuṣastatra jāyante spardhayā'nvitāḥ ..
paraṃ tatrāpi no yāṃti mṛtyuṃ putrāḥ kathaṃcana .. 19 ..
5.271.d:
देवलोकांस्ततो यांति मूलाद्यावच्चतुर्दश ..
ब्रह्मलोकस्य पर्यंतं स्वकीयैर्य ज्ञकर्मभिः ..19..
किंचित्स्वल्पायुषस्तत्र जायन्ते स्पर्धयाऽन्विताः ..
परं तत्रापि नो यांति मृत्युं पुत्राः कथंचन .. 19 ..
5.271.m:
Thereupon, by their own sacrificial rites, they go to the fourteen divine worlds, / from the base up to the world of Brahmā. 19.
There, [people] are born with somewhat shorter lifespans, possessed of rivalry; / even there, however, sons in no way meet with death [before their elders]

5.271.s:
janake vidyamāne ca sva lpadoṣāḥ prakīrtitāḥ ..
kāmakrodhādayo ye ca bhavaṃti na bhavaṃti ca .. 6.272.20 ..
5.271.d:
जनके विद्यमाने च स्व ल्पदोषाः प्रकीर्तिताः ..
कामक्रोधादयो ये च भवंति न भवंति च .. 6.272.20 ..
5.271.m: while the father is alive, and they are declared to have slight faults. / Desire, anger, and the like both occur and do not occur [among them].

5.271.s:
ekayā velayā tatra vāpitaṃ sasyamuttamam ..
saptavārānpragṛhṇaṃti vaiśyāḥ kṛṣiparāyaṇāḥ .. 21 ..
5.271.d:
एकया वेलया तत्र वापितं सस्यमुत्तमम् ..
सप्तवारान्प्रगृह्णंति वैश्याः कृषिपरायणाः .. 21 ..
5.271.m: The excellent grain sown there in a single season, / the vaiśyas devoted to agriculture harvest seven times.

5.271.s:
sarvā ghaṭasravā gāvo mahiṣyaśca caturguṇāḥ ..
prayacchaṃti tathā kṣīramuṣṭryastāsāṃ caturguṇam .. 22 ..
5.271.d:
सर्वा घटस्रवा गावो महिष्यश्च चतुर्गुणाः ..
प्रयच्छंति तथा क्षीरमुष्ट्र्यस्तासां चतुर्गुणम् .. 22 ..
5.271.m: All the cows yield a whole jar of milk, the female buffaloes four times that much, / and likewise female camels yield four times the milk of those buffaloes;

5.271.s:
ajāvikāstathā pādaṃ nāryaḥ sarvāstathaiva ca ..
vedādhyayanasaṃpannāḥ pratigrahavivarjitāḥ ..
śāpānugrahakṛtyeṣu samarthāḥ saṃbhavaṃti ca 23 ..
5.271.d:
अजाविकास्तथा पादं नार्यः सर्वास्तथैव च ..
वेदाध्ययनसंपन्नाः प्रतिग्रहविवर्जिताः ..
शापानुग्रहकृत्येषु समर्थाः संभवंति च 23 ..
5.271.m: likewise female goats and sheep [yield] a quarter, and all the women [are] similarly [virtuous]. / [The brahmins] are endowed with Vedic study, free from receiving gifts, / and capable in the acts of cursing and blessing.

5.271.s:
kṣatriyāḥ kṣātradharmeṇa pālayaṃti vasuṃdharām ..
na tatra dṛśyate cauro na ca jāraḥ kathaṃcana ..
svadharmaniratāḥ sarve varṇāścaiva vyavasthitāḥ .. 24 ..
5.271.d:
क्षत्रियाः क्षात्रधर्मेण पालयंति वसुंधराम् ..
न तत्र दृश्यते चौरो न च जारः कथंचन ..
स्वधर्मनिरताः सर्वे वर्णाश्चैव व्यवस्थिताः .. 24 ..
5.271.m: The kṣatriyas protect the earth in accordance with the duty of the warrior; / neither thief nor adulterer is seen there in any way; / and all the social classes are established, devoted to their own duties.

5.271.s:
tacca dvādaśabhirlakṣairvatsarāṇāṃ prakīrtitam ..
ṣaṇṇavatyā sahasraistu dvitīyaṃ yugamuttamam ..25..
5.271.d:
तच्च द्वादशभिर्लक्षैर्वत्सराणां प्रकीर्तितम् ..
षण्णवत्या सहस्रैस्तु द्वितीयं युगमुत्तमम् ..25..
5.271.m: That second, excellent yuga is declared / to consist of one million two hundred and ninety-six thousand years.

5.271.s:
tataśca dvāparaṃ bhāvi tṛtīyaṃ dvijasattamāḥ ..
dvau pādau tatra pāpasya dvau ca dharmasya saṃsthitau..
bhagavānvāsudevaśca kapilastatra jāyate .. 26 ..
5.271.d:
ततश्च द्वापरं भावि तृतीयं द्विजसत्तमाः ..
द्वौ पादौ तत्र पापस्य द्वौ च धर्मस्य संस्थितौ..
भगवान्वासुदेवश्च कपिलस्तत्र जायते .. 26 ..
5.271.m: After that will come the Dvāpara, the third [yuga], O best of brahmins. / There two quarters of sin and two of righteousness are established; / the blessed Vāsudeva is born there as Kapila.

5.271.s:
taccāṣṭalakṣamānena vatsarāṇāṃ prakīrtitam ..
catuḥṣaṣṭibhiranyaistu sahasrāṇāṃ dvijottamāḥ .. 27 ..
5.271.d:
तच्चाष्टलक्षमानेन वत्सराणां प्रकीर्तितम् ..
चतुःषष्टिभिरन्यैस्तु सहस्राणां द्विजोत्तमाः .. 27 ..
5.271.m: And that is declared to have a measure of eight hundred / and sixty-four thousand years, O best of brahmins.

5.271.s:
kāmaḥ krodhastathā lobho daṃbho matsara eva ca ..
ṣaḍete tatra jāyaṃte īrṣyā caiva tu saptamī..28..
5.271.d:
कामः क्रोधस्तथा लोभो दंभो मत्सर एव च ..
षडेते तत्र जायंते ईर्ष्या चैव तु सप्तमी..28..
5.271.m: Desire, anger, greed, deceit, and malice— / these six are born there, and jealousy as the seventh.

5.271.s:
atha saṃsevitāstaistu mānavāśca parasparam ..
viruddhāṃśca prakurvaṃti nāpnuvaṃti yathā divam .. 29 ..
5.271.d:
अथ संसेवितास्तैस्तु मानवाश्च परस्परम् ..
विरुद्धांश्च प्रकुर्वंति नाप्नुवंति यथा दिवम् .. 29 ..
5.271.m: Then men, attended by these [faults], / act in opposition to one another and do not attain heaven as before.

5.271.s:
kecittatrāpi jāyaṃte śāṃtā dāṃtā jiteṃdriyāḥ ..
na sarve'pi dvijaśreṣṭhā yato'rddhaṃ pātakasya tu .. 6.272.30 ..
5.271.d:
केचित्तत्रापि जायंते शांता दांता जितेंद्रियाः ..
न सर्वेऽपि द्विजश्रेष्ठा यतोऽर्द्धं पातकस्य तु .. 6.272.30 ..
5.271.m: Some are born even there peaceful, self-controlled, and with conquered senses, / but not all, O best of brahmins, because half consists of sin.

5.271.s:
tataḥ kaliyugaṃ proktaṃ caturthaṃ ca sudāruṇam ..
ekapādo vṛṣo yatra pāpaṃ pādaistribhiḥ sthitam .. 31 ..
5.271.d:
ततः कलियुगं प्रोक्तं चतुर्थं च सुदारुणम् ..
एकपादो वृषो यत्र पापं पादैस्त्रिभिः स्थितम् .. 31 ..
5.271.m: After that is proclaimed the Kaliyuga, the fourth and exceedingly dreadful [age], / wherein the bull [of Dharma] has a single foot, and sin stands upon three feet.

5.271.s:
kṛṣṇatvaṃ yāti devo'pi tatra caiva caturbhujaḥ ..
eka pādo'pi dharmasya yāvattāvatpravartate .. 32 ..
5.271.d:
कृष्णत्वं याति देवोऽपि तत्र चैव चतुर्भुजः ..
एक पादोऽपि धर्मस्य यावत्तावत्प्रवर्तते .. 32 ..
5.271.m: There even the four-armed God assumes blackness. / So long as that single foot of righteousness endures,

5.271.s:
paścānnāśaṃ samabhyeti yāvattāvacchanaiḥśanaiḥ ..
pramāṇaṃ tasya nirdiṣṭaṃ lakṣāścatvāra eva hi .. 33 ..
5.271.d:
पश्चान्नाशं समभ्येति यावत्तावच्छनैःशनैः ..
प्रमाणं तस्य निर्दिष्टं लक्षाश्चत्वार एव हि .. 33 ..
5.271.m: it gradually moves toward destruction thereafter. / Its duration is indicated as four hundred

5.271.s:
dvātriṃśacca sahasrāṇi yugasyaivāṃtimasya ca ..
kalinā tatra saṃpṛṣṭā martyāḥ sarve parasparam .. 34 ..
5.271.d:
द्वात्रिंशच्च सहस्राणि युगस्यैवांतिमस्य च ..
कलिना तत्र संपृष्टा मर्त्याः सर्वे परस्परम् .. 34 ..
5.271.m: and thirty-two thousand [years] of that final yuga. / Touched there by Kali, all mortals toward one another,

5.271.s:
vibudhaiste pravartaṃte rāgadveṣaparāyaṇāḥ ..
yasyayasya gṛhe vittaṃ tathā nāryo manoramāḥ ..36..
tenatena samaṃ maitrīṃ kalau kurvaṃti mānavāḥ ..
vidhavānāṃ yatīnāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ ca tapasvinām..36..
5.271.d:
विबुधैस्ते प्रवर्तंते रागद्वेषपरायणाः ..
यस्ययस्य गृहे वित्तं तथा नार्यो मनोरमाः ..36..
तेनतेन समं मैत्रीं कलौ कुर्वंति मानवाः ..
विधवानां यतीनां च सर्वेषां च तपस्विनाम्..36..
5.271.m:
acting alongside scholars, become devoted to passion and malice. / In whosever house there is wealth and charming women,
with that very person men form friendships in the Kali [age]. / For widows, ascetics, and all practitioners of austerity,

5.271.s:
lokadvayavināśaḥ syādyataśceto na śudhyati ..
prāvṛṭkāle'pi saṃprāpte durbhikṣeṇa prapīḍitāḥ .. 37 ..
5.271.d:
लोकद्वयविनाशः स्याद्यतश्चेतो न शुध्यति ..
प्रावृट्कालेऽपि संप्राप्ते दुर्भिक्षेण प्रपीडिताः .. 37 ..
5.271.m: there is ruin of both worlds, because their minds are not purified. / Even when the rainy season arrives, afflicted by famine,

5.271.s:
bhramaṃti ca kalau lokā gaganāsaktadṛṣṭayaḥ..
jānāti cāpi tanayaḥ pitā cennidhanaṃ vrajet .. 38 .
5.271.d:
भ्रमंति च कलौ लोका गगनासक्तदृष्टयः..
जानाति चापि तनयः पिता चेन्निधनं व्रजेत् .. 38 .
5.271.m: people in the Kali wander with their eyes fixed upon the sky. / And a son thinks, “If my father were to die,

5.271.s:
tatohaṃ gṛhapo bhūyāṃ bāṃdhavo hyapi bāṃdhavam ..
snuṣāpi vetti cittena yadi śvaśrūḥ kṣayaṃ vrajet .. 39 ..
5.271.d:
ततोहं गृहपो भूयां बांधवो ह्यपि बांधवम् ..
स्नुषापि वेत्ति चित्तेन यदि श्वश्रूः क्षयं व्रजेत् .. 39 ..
5.271.m: then I would become the master of the house”; a relative [thinks so] of a relative; / even a daughter-in-law thinks in her heart, “If my mother-in-law were to perish,

5.271.s:
mama syādgṛha aiśvaryaṃ tatsarvaṃ nānyathā vrajet ..
kāvyairupahatā vedāḥ putrā jāmātṛkaistathā .. 6.272.40 ..
5.271.d:
मम स्याद्गृह ऐश्वर्यं तत्सर्वं नान्यथा व्रजेत् ..
काव्यैरुपहता वेदाः पुत्रा जामातृकैस्तथा .. 6.272.40 ..
5.271.m: all the lordship in the house would be mine, and it would not go otherwise.” / The Vedas are struck down by poetic compositions, sons by sons-in-law,

5.271.s:
śālakairbāṃdhavāścaiva hyasatībhiḥ kulastriyaḥ ..
śūdrāstapasvinaścaiva śūdrā dharmasya sūcakāḥ ..41..
5.271.d:
शालकैर्बांधवाश्चैव ह्यसतीभिः कुलस्त्रियः ..
शूद्रास्तपस्विनश्चैव शूद्रा धर्मस्य सूचकाः ..41..
5.271.m: kinsmen by brothers-in-law, and noble wives by unchaste women. / Śūdras become ascetics, and śūdras proclaim righteousness;

5.271.s:
brāhmaṇānāṃ tataḥ śūdrā upadeśaṃ vadaṃti ca ..
alpodakāstathā meghā alpasasyā ca medinī .. 42 ..
5.271.d:
ब्राह्मणानां ततः शूद्रा उपदेशं वदंति च ..
अल्पोदकास्तथा मेघा अल्पसस्या च मेदिनी .. 42 ..
5.271.m: then śūdras utter instruction to brahmins. / The clouds have little water, and the earth little grain;

5.271.s:
alpakṣīrāstathā gāvaḥ kṣīre sarpistathā'lpakam .
sarvabhakṣāstathā viprā nṛpā niṣkaruṇāstataḥ ..
kṛṣyā lajjaṃti vaiśyāśca śūdrā brāhmaṇapreṣakāḥ .. 43 ..
5.271.d:
अल्पक्षीरास्तथा गावः क्षीरे सर्पिस्तथाऽल्पकम् .
सर्वभक्षास्तथा विप्रा नृपा निष्करुणास्ततः ..
कृष्या लज्जंति वैश्याश्च शूद्रा ब्राह्मणप्रेषकाः .. 43 ..
5.271.m: cows yield little milk, and in the milk is little ghee. / Brahmins eat all foods, kings are merciless, / vaiśyas are ashamed of agriculture, and śūdras dispatch brahmins [on errands].

5.271.s:
hetuvādaratā ye ca bhaṃḍaṃvidyāparāśca ye ..
tete syurbhūmipālasya sadā'bhīṣṭāḥ kalau yuge ..44..
5.271.d:
हेतुवादरता ये च भंडंविद्यापराश्च ये ..
तेते स्युर्भूमिपालस्य सदाऽभीष्टाः कलौ युगे ..44..
5.271.m: Those who are devoted to specious reasoning and those intent on the arts of buffoons / are always dear to the king in the Kaliyuga.

5.271.s:
śvaḥśvaḥpāpīyadivasāḥ pṛthivī gatayauvanā .
atikrāṃta śubhāḥ kālāḥ paryupasthitadāruṇāḥ ..45..
5.271.d:
श्वःश्वःपापीयदिवसाः पृथिवी गतयौवना .
अतिक्रांत शुभाः कालाः पर्युपस्थितदारुणाः ..45..
5.271.m: Day after day becomes more sinful; the earth's youth is gone; / auspicious times are past, and dreadful ones have drawn near.

5.271.s:
yathāyathā yugaṃ bhāvi vṛddhiṃ yāṃti striyo narāḥ ..
tathātathā prayāṃti sma laghutāṃ jaṃtubhiḥ saha ..46..
5.271.d:
यथायथा युगं भावि वृद्धिं यांति स्त्रियो नराः ..
तथातथा प्रयांति स्म लघुतां जंतुभिः सह ..46..
5.271.m: As the yuga advances, women and men grow in number, / but just as they advance, they decline in stature along with [other] creatures.

5.271.s: dvādaśame caiva kanyā syādbhartṛsaṃyutā ..47..
5.271.d: द्वादशमे चैव कन्या स्याद्भर्तृसंयुता ..47..
5.271.m: And in the twelfth year a girl is joined with a husband;

5.271.s:
tataḥ ṣoḍaśame varṣe narāḥ palitayauvanāḥ ..
śaucācāraparityaktā nijakāryaparāstathā .. 48 ..
5.271.d:
ततः षोडशमे वर्षे नराः पलितयौवनाः ..
शौचाचारपरित्यक्ता निजकार्यपरास्तथा .. 48 ..
5.271.m: then in the sixteenth year men have grey hair in their youth, / devoid of purity and conduct, and devoted only to their selfish ends.

5.271.s:
bhaviṣyaṃti yugasyāṃte narāḥ aṃguṣṭhamātrakāḥ ..
gṛhaṃ ca te'tha kurvaṃti bilairākhusamudbhavaiḥ .. 49 ..
tathā prāvaraṇaṃ teṣāṃ kṛmivastraṃ bhaviṣyati ..
ekavarṇā bhaviṣyaṃti varṇāḥ sarve tataḥ paraḥ ..
mlechībhūtā durācārā dharmakṛtyavidūṣakāḥ ..6.272.5...
5.271.d:
भविष्यंति युगस्यांते नराः अंगुष्ठमात्रकाः ..
गृहं च तेऽथ कुर्वंति बिलैराखुसमुद्भवैः .. 49 ..
तथा प्रावरणं तेषां कृमिवस्त्रं भविष्यति ..
एकवर्णा भविष्यंति वर्णाः सर्वे ततः परः ..
म्लेछीभूता दुराचारा धर्मकृत्यविदूषकाः ..6.272.5...
5.271.m:
At the end of the yuga, men will be only thumb-sized, / and they will make their dwellings in holes dug by rats.
Likewise, their garment will be made of worm-cloth. / After that, all the classes will become one class, / turned into barbarians, evil in conduct, and despisers of righteous duties.

5.271.s:
evaṃ jāte tato loke brāhmaṇo haripiṃgalaḥ ..
kalkigotrasamutpannastānsarvā nsūdayettataḥ ..91..
paścātkṛtayugaṃ bhāvi bhūyo'pi dvijasattamāḥ ..52..
evaṃ yugasahasreṇa saṃprāptena tataḥ param ..
brahmaṇo divasaṃ bhāvi rātriścaiva tataḥ param .. 53 ..
tataścānena mānena ṣaṣṭyā yuktaistribhiḥ śataiḥ ..
brahmaṇo vatsaraṃ bhāvi keśavasya ca taddinam .. 54 ..
ātmīye jīvite brahma yāvadvarṣaśataṃ sthitaḥ ..
keśavo'pi svamānena varṣāṇāṃ jīvite śatam .. 55 ..
varṣeṇa vāsudevasya dinaṃ māheśvaraṃ bhavet ..
nijamānena sopyatra yāva dvarṣaśataṃ sthitaḥ .. 56 ..
tataḥ śaktisvarūpaḥ syātso'kṣayī kīrtyate yataḥ ..
sadāśivasya niḥśvāsaḥ śaivaṃ varṣaśataṃ bhavet ..
ucchvāsastu punastasya śaktirūpeṇa saṃsthitaḥ .. 57 ..
5.271.d:
एवं जाते ततो लोके ब्राह्मणो हरिपिंगलः ..
कल्किगोत्रसमुत्पन्नस्तान्सर्वा न्सूदयेत्ततः ..91..
पश्चात्कृतयुगं भावि भूयोऽपि द्विजसत्तमाः ..52..
एवं युगसहस्रेण संप्राप्तेन ततः परम् ..
ब्रह्मणो दिवसं भावि रात्रिश्चैव ततः परम् .. 53 ..
ततश्चानेन मानेन षष्ट्या युक्तैस्त्रिभिः शतैः ..
ब्रह्मणो वत्सरं भावि केशवस्य च तद्दिनम् .. 54 ..
आत्मीये जीविते ब्रह्म यावद्वर्षशतं स्थितः ..
केशवोऽपि स्वमानेन वर्षाणां जीविते शतम् .. 55 ..
वर्षेण वासुदेवस्य दिनं माहेश्वरं भवेत् ..
निजमानेन सोप्यत्र याव द्वर्षशतं स्थितः .. 56 ..
ततः शक्तिस्वरूपः स्यात्सोऽक्षयी कीर्त्यते यतः ..
सदाशिवस्य निःश्वासः शैवं वर्षशतं भवेत् ..
उच्छ्वासस्तु पुनस्तस्य शक्तिरूपेण संस्थितः .. 57 ..
5.271.m:
When the world has become thus, a brahmin with tawny-yellow hair, / born in the lineage of Kalki, will then destroy them all.
Afterward, the Kṛtayuga will occur once more, O best of brahmins.
When a thousand yugas have elapsed in this way, / a day of Brahmā occurs thereafter, and after that his night.
Then, by this measure of three hundred and sixty [such days and nights], / a year of Brahmā occurs; and that is a day of Keśava.
So long as Brahmā lives his hundred years of his own lifespan, / Keśava too lives for a hundred years by his own reckoning.
A year of Vāsudeva becomes a day of the Great Lord (Maheśvara); / by his own reckoning he too remains here for a hundred years.
Then he takes the nature of Śakti, for he is declared to be imperishable. / An out-breath of Sadāśiva is a hundred years of Śiva, / and his in-breath again abides as Śakti.

5.271.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
etadvaḥ sarvamākhyātaṃ śivaśaktisamudbhavam ..
yāvadāyuḥ pramāṇaṃ ca mānuṣāḍhyaṃ ca yadbhavet .. .. 58 ..
bhavadbhiḥ śāṃkaraṃ pṛṣṭo dvijā asmi dinaṃ purā ..
mayā punastu sarveṣāṃ martyādīnāṃ tu kīrtitam .. 59 ..
5.271.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
एतद्वः सर्वमाख्यातं शिवशक्तिसमुद्भवम् ..
यावदायुः प्रमाणं च मानुषाढ्यं च यद्भवेत् .. .. 58 ..
भवद्भिः शांकरं पृष्टो द्विजा अस्मि दिनं पुरा ..
मया पुनस्तु सर्वेषां मर्त्यादीनां तु कीर्तितम् .. 59 ..
5.271.m:
Sūta said: / All this originating from Śiva and Śakti has been related to you: / the measure of life, and what pertains to human beings.
Formerly, O brahmins, I was asked by you about the day of Śaṃkara, / and in turn I have declared to you the [spans of] mortals and the rest.

5.271.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekā śītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye yugasvarūpavarṇanaṃnāma dvisaptatyuttaradviśatatamoadhyāyaḥ .. 272 ..
5.271.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एका शीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखण्डे हाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये युगस्वरूपवर्णनंनाम द्विसप्तत्युत्तरद्विशततमोअध्यायः .. 272 ..
5.271.m: Thus ends the two hundred seventy-second chapter, entitled "Description of the Nature of the Yugas," in the Māhātmya of Hāṭakeśvara Sacred Field, in the Nāgarakhaṇḍa, the sixth [section], in the eighty-one-thousand-verse collection of the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa.

5.272.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
eteṣāṃ tu sahasreṇa bhavedgrāhyaṃ dinaṃ dvijāḥ ..
caturdaśa sahasrākṣā jāyaṃte tatra vāsare .. 1 ..
5.272.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
एतेषां तु सहस्रेण भवेद्ग्राह्यं दिनं द्विजाः ..
चतुर्दश सहस्राक्षा जायंते तत्र वासरे .. 1 ..
5.272.m: Sūta said: / By a thousand of these, O twice-born ones, a day is to be comprehended. / In that day, fourteen thousand-eyed Indras are born.

5.272.s:
saptamastu sahasrākṣaḥ sāṃprataṃ vartate'tra yaḥ ..
ekasaptatisaṃvartacaturdaśadine vidheḥ .. 2 ..
5.272.d:
सप्तमस्तु सहस्राक्षः सांप्रतं वर्ततेऽत्र यः ..
एकसप्ततिसंवर्तचतुर्दशदिने विधेः .. 2 ..
5.272.m: The thousand-eyed Indra who exists here at present is the seventh, / during the seventy-one cosmic cycles [which form one] fourteenth of a day of Brahmā.

5.272.s:
yugānāṃ kurute rājyaṃ manavaśca tathā pare ..
svāyaṃbhuvaprabhṛtayo yathā śakrāstathā sthitāḥ .. .. 3 ..
5.272.d:
युगानां कुरुते राज्यं मनवश्च तथा परे ..
स्वायंभुवप्रभृतयो यथा शक्रास्तथा स्थिताः .. .. 3 ..
5.272.m: He exercises rule over the yugas, and so do the other Manus; / beginning with Svāyambhuva, they remain just as the Indras do.

5.272.s:
jāyanto nāma śakro'yaṃ sāṃprataṃ vartate tu yaḥ ..
vaivasvato manuścaiva aṣṭāviṃśatpramāṇakaḥ .. 4 ..
5.272.d:
जायन्तो नाम शक्रोऽयं सांप्रतं वर्तते तु यः ..
वैवस्वतो मनुश्चैव अष्टाविंशत्प्रमाणकः .. 4 ..
5.272.m: This Indra who exists at present is named Jāyanta, / and the Manu is Vaivasvata, measuring the twenty-eighth [cycle].

5.272.s:
caturyugasya saṃjāto gatesmiñcheṣamātrake ..
bhaviṣyati baliḥ śakro vāsudevaprasādataḥ .. 5 ..
5.272.d:
चतुर्युगस्य संजातो गतेस्मिञ्छेषमात्रके ..
भविष्यति बलिः शक्रो वासुदेवप्रसादतः .. 5 ..
5.272.m: When this four-yuga cycle has elapsed and only the remainder is left, / Bali will become Indra by the grace of Vāsudeva.

5.272.s: tena tasya pratijñātaṃ rājyaṃ caivāṣṭame manau .. 6 ..
5.272.d: तेन तस्य प्रतिज्ञातं राज्यं चैवाष्टमे मनौ .. 6 ..
5.272.m: By him kingship was promised to him in the eighth Manu.

5.272.s:
evaṃ sarve surāścānye trayastriṃśatpramāṇataḥ ...
koṭayaḥ prabhaviṣyaṃti yathā caiva tathā purā .. 7 ..
5.272.d:
एवं सर्वे सुराश्चान्ये त्रयस्त्रिंशत्प्रमाणतः ...
कोटयः प्रभविष्यंति यथा चैव तथा पुरा .. 7 ..
5.272.m: Thus all other gods, measuring thirty-three / crores, will come into being just as in the past.

5.272.s:
yo'yaṃ brahmā sthito viprāḥ sāṃprataṃ sṛṣṭikārakaḥ ..
tasyānena pramāṇena jātaṃ saṃvatsarāṣṭakam .. .. 8 ..
5.272.d:
योऽयं ब्रह्मा स्थितो विप्राः सांप्रतं सृष्टिकारकः ..
तस्यानेन प्रमाणेन जातं संवत्सराष्टकम् .. .. 8 ..
5.272.m: This Brahmā who stands here at present as the creator, O brahmins, / by this measure, eight years have elapsed for him,

5.272.d:
षण्मासाश्च दिनार्धं च प्रथमं शुक्लपूर्वकम्..
सौरसावनचंद्रार्क्षैर्मानैरेभिश्चतुर्विधैः .. 9 ..
5.272.m: and six months, and half a day, the first [half] beginning with the bright fortnight. / By these four types of measure—solar, civil, lunar, and sidereal—

5.272.s:
kalau niryāti sarveṣāṃ bhūtānāṃ kṣitimaṇḍale ..
paṃcaṣaṣṭyā'dhikaiścaiva dinānāṃ ca śataistribhiḥ ..
bhavetsaṃvatsaraṃ sauraṃ pañconaistaiśca sāvanam .. 6.273.10 ..
5.272.d:
कलौ निर्याति सर्वेषां भूतानां क्षितिमण्डले ..
पंचषष्ट्याऽधिकैश्चैव दिनानां च शतैस्त्रिभिः ..
भवेत्संवत्सरं सौरं पञ्चोनैस्तैश्च सावनम् .. 6.273.10 ..
5.272.m: [the span of life] slips away for all living beings on the circle of the earth in the Kali [age]. / With three hundred days plus sixty-five, / there is a solar year, and by those [days] diminished by five, a civil year.

5.272.s:
cāṃdra ekādaśonastu triṃśaddhīna uḍūdbhavaḥ ..
śītātapau tathā vṛṣṭiḥ sauramānena jāyate .. 11 ..
5.272.d:
चांद्र एकादशोनस्तु त्रिंशद्धीन उडूद्भवः ..
शीतातपौ तथा वृष्टिः सौरमानेन जायते .. 11 ..
5.272.m: The lunar is diminished by eleven, and that originating from the stars is diminished by thirty. / Cold, heat, and rain occur according to the solar measure.

5.272.s:
vṛkṣāṇāṃ phalaniṣpattiḥ sasyānāṃ ca tathā parā .
agniṣṭomādayo yajñā vartaṃte ye dharātale .. 12 ..
5.272.d:
वृक्षाणां फलनिष्पत्तिः सस्यानां च तथा परा .
अग्निष्टोमादयो यज्ञा वर्तंते ये धरातले .. 12 ..
5.272.m: The ripening of fruits of trees and the highest ripening of crops, / as well as the Agniṣṭoma and other sacrifices that exist on the face of the earth,

5.272.s:
utsāhāśca vivāhāśca sāvanena bhavaṃti ca ..
kusīdādyāśca ye kecidvyavahārāśca vṛttijāḥ .. 13 ..
5.272.d:
उत्साहाश्च विवाहाश्च सावनेन भवंति च ..
कुसीदाद्याश्च ये केचिद्व्यवहाराश्च वृत्तिजाः .. 13 ..
5.272.m: and festivities and marriages take place according to the civil measure. / Lending at interest and whatever other business transactions arise from livelihoods,

5.272.s:
adhimāsaprayuktena te syuścāṃdreṇa nirmitāḥ ..
nākṣatreṇa tu mānena sidhyaṃte grahacārikāḥ .. 14 ..
5.272.d:
अधिमासप्रयुक्तेन ते स्युश्चांद्रेण निर्मिताः ..
नाक्षत्रेण तु मानेन सिध्यंते ग्रहचारिकाः .. 14 ..
5.272.m: these are determined by the lunar measure connected with intercalary months. / But the courses of the planets are calculated by the sidereal measure.

5.272.s:
nānyatkiṃciddharāpṛṣṭha etanmānacatuṣṭayāt ..
etena tu pramāṇena devadaityāśca mānavāḥ .. 15 ..
5.272.d:
नान्यत्किंचिद्धरापृष्ठ एतन्मानचतुष्टयात् ..
एतेन तु प्रमाणेन देवदैत्याश्च मानवाः .. 15 ..
5.272.m: There is nothing on the surface of the earth apart from this quartet of measures. / By this measure the gods, Daityas, and mortals

5.272.s:
varttaṃte brāhmaṇaśreṣṭhāḥ śrutireṣā purātanī ..
etadyugapramāṇaṃ tu yaḥ paṭhedbhaktisaṃyutaḥ .. 16 ..
5.272.d:
वर्त्तंते ब्राह्मणश्रेष्ठाः श्रुतिरेषा पुरातनी ..
एतद्युगप्रमाणं तु यः पठेद्भक्तिसंयुतः .. 16 ..
5.272.m: exist, O best of brahmins; such is the ancient revelation. / Whoever recites this measure of the yugas with devotion

5.272.s:
eteṣāmeva liṃgānāṃ saptānāṃ brāhmaṇottamāḥ ..
nāpamṛtyu bhayaṃ tasya kathaṃcitsaṃbhaviṣyati .. 17 ..
5.272.d:
एतेषामेव लिंगानां सप्तानां ब्राह्मणोत्तमाः ..
नापमृत्यु भयं तस्य कथंचित्संभविष्यति .. 17 ..
5.272.m: concerning these very seven liṅgas, O best of brahmins, / no fear of untimely death will ever befall him.

5.272.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye yugapramāṇavarṇanaṃnāma trisaptatyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 273
5.272.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखण्डे हाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये युगप्रमाणवर्णनंनाम त्रिसप्तत्युत्तरद्विशततमोऽध्यायः .. 273
5.272.m: Thus ends the two hundred seventy-third chapter, entitled "Description of the Measure of the Yugas," in the Māhātmya of Hāṭakeśvara Sacred Field, in the Nāgarakhaṇḍa, the sixth [section], in the eighty-one-thousand-verse collection of the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa.

5.273.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
tathānyadapi tatrāsti durvāsaḥsthāpitaṃ purā ..
talliṃgaṃ devadevasya trinetrasya mahātmanaḥ .. 1 ..
5.273.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
तथान्यदपि तत्रास्ति दुर्वासःस्थापितं पुरा ..
तल्लिंगं देवदेवस्य त्रिनेत्रस्य महात्मनः .. 1 ..
5.273.m: Sūta said: / Likewise, there is another [liṅga] there, installed in ancient times by Durvāsas, / that liṅga of the great-souled god of gods, the three-eyed Lord.

5.273.s:
caitramāsi naro yastu tamārādhayate dvijāḥ ..
nṛtyagītapravādyaiśca trikālaṃ vihitakṣaṇaḥ ..
sa nūnaṃ tatprasādena gandharvādhipatirbhavet 1. 2 ..
5.273.d:
चैत्रमासि नरो यस्तु तमाराधयते द्विजाः ..
नृत्यगीतप्रवाद्यैश्च त्रिकालं विहितक्षणः ..
स नूनं तत्प्रसादेन गन्धर्वाधिपतिर्भवेत् 1. 2 ..
5.273.m: Whatever person worships it in the month of Caitra, O twice-born ones, / holding a festival at the three junctures of the day with dance, song, and musical instruments, / he will surely become a lord of Gandharvas by his grace.

5.273.s:
.. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
durvāsā nāmakaścāyaṃ kenāyaṃ sthāpito haraḥ ..
kasminkāle mahābhāga sarvaṃ no vistarādvada .. 3 ..
5.273.d:
.. ऋषय ऊचुः .. ..
दुर्वासा नामकश्चायं केनायं स्थापितो हरः ..
कस्मिन्काले महाभाग सर्वं नो विस्तराद्वद .. 3 ..
5.273.m: The seers said: / Who was this one named Durvāsas, and by whom was this Hara installed? / At what time, O highly fortunate one? Tell us everything in detail.

5.273.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
āsītpurā niṃbaśuco vaidiśe ca purottame .. 4 ..
5.273.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
आसीत्पुरा निंबशुचो वैदिशे च पुरोत्तमे .. 4 ..
5.273.m: Sūta said: / Formerly there was one named Nimbasuc in the excellent city of Vaidiśa.

5.273.s:
sa ca pūjayate liṃgaṃ kiṃcinmaṭhapatiḥ sthitaḥ ..
sa yatkiṃcidavāpnoti vastrādyaṃ ca tathā param .. 5 ..
5.273.d:
स च पूजयते लिंगं किंचिन्मठपतिः स्थितः ..
स यत्किंचिदवाप्नोति वस्त्राद्यं च तथा परम् .. 5 ..
5.273.m: He was the head of a monastery who worshipped a certain liṅga. / Whatever cloth and other things he obtained

5.273.s:
māheśvarasya lokasya vikrīṇīte tatastataḥ ..
tato gṛhṇāti nityaṃ sa hema mūlyena tasya ca .. 6 ..
5.273.d:
माहेश्वरस्य लोकस्य विक्रीणीते ततस्ततः ..
ततो गृह्णाति नित्यं स हेम मूल्येन तस्य च .. 6 ..
5.273.m: from people devoted to Śiva, he sold here and there. / Then he continually took gold in exchange for the price thereof.

5.273.s:
na karoti vyayaṃ tasya kevalaṃ saṃcaye rataḥ ..
tataḥ kālena mahatā maṃjūṣā'sya nirargalā ..
jātā hemamayī viprāḥ kārpaṇyaniratasya ca .. 7 ..
5.273.d:
न करोति व्ययं तस्य केवलं संचये रतः ..
ततः कालेन महता मंजूषाऽस्य निरर्गला ..
जाता हेममयी विप्राः कार्पण्यनिरतस्य च .. 7 ..
5.273.m: He spent none of it, intent only on accumulation. / Then after a great time, O brahmins, the unlocked chest / of that miserly man became filled with gold.

5.273.s:
atha saṃsthāpya bhūmadhye maṃjūṣāṃ tāṃ prapūritām ..
karoti vyavahāraṃ sa kakṣāṃ tāṃ naiva muṃcati .. 8 ..
5.273.d:
अथ संस्थाप्य भूमध्ये मंजूषां तां प्रपूरिताम् ..
करोति व्यवहारं स कक्षां तां नैव मुंचति .. 8 ..
5.273.m: Then, having placed that full chest inside the ground, / he carried on his affairs and never left that corner.

5.273.s:
kadāciddevapūjāyāṃ so'pi brāhmaṇasattamāḥ ..
viśvāsaṃ naiva niryāti kasyacicca kathaṃcana .. 9 ..
5.273.d:
कदाचिद्देवपूजायां सोऽपि ब्राह्मणसत्तमाः ..
विश्वासं नैव निर्याति कस्यचिच्च कथंचन .. 9 ..
5.273.m: Even when worshipping the god, O best of brahmins, / he would never place his trust in anyone at all.

5.273.s:
kasyacittvatha kālasya paravittāpahārakaḥ ..
alakṣadbrāhmaṇastacca duḥśīlākhyo vyaciṃtayat .. 6.274.10 ..
5.273.d:
कस्यचित्त्वथ कालस्य परवित्तापहारकः ..
अलक्षद्ब्राह्मणस्तच्च दुःशीलाख्यो व्यचिंतयत् .. 6.274.10 ..
5.273.m: Now after some time, a stealer of others' wealth, / a brahmin named Duḥśīla, noticed this and thought:

5.273.s:
tataḥ śiṣyo bhaviṣyāmi viśvāsārthaṃ durātmanaḥ ..
sudīnaiḥ kṛpaṇairvākyaiścāṭukāraiḥ pṛthagvidhaiḥ .. 11 ..
5.273.d:
ततः शिष्यो भविष्यामि विश्वासार्थं दुरात्मनः ..
सुदीनैः कृपणैर्वाक्यैश्चाटुकारैः पृथग्विधैः .. 11 ..
5.273.m: "I will become a disciple of this wicked-souled man to gain his trust / with very humble, wretched words and various kinds of flattery.

5.273.s:
ālasyaṃ ca divānaktaṃ sādhayiṣyāmyasaṃśayam ..
anyasminnahani prāpte dṛṣṭvā taṃ maṭhamadhyagam .. 12 ..
5.273.d:
आलस्यं च दिवानक्तं साधयिष्याम्यसंशयम् ..
अन्यस्मिन्नहनि प्राप्ते दृष्ट्वा तं मठमध्यगम् .. 12 ..
5.273.m: Day and night, without doubt, I will overcome his hesitation." / When another day came, seeing him seated inside the monastery,

5.273.s:
tataḥ samīpamagamaddaṃḍākāraṃ praṇamya ca ..
abravītprāṃjalirbhūtvā vinayāvanataḥ sthitaḥ .. 13 ..
5.273.d:
ततः समीपमगमद्दंडाकारं प्रणम्य च ..
अब्रवीत्प्रांजलिर्भूत्वा विनयावनतः स्थितः .. 13 ..
5.273.m: he approached, bowed down prostrating like a staff, / and, standing bent with modesty with folded hands, said:

5.273.s: bhagavaṃste prabhāvo'dya tapasā vai mayā śrutaḥ .. 14 ..
5.273.d: भगवंस्ते प्रभावोऽद्य तपसा वै मया श्रुतः .. 14 ..
5.273.m: "O venerable one, today I have heard of your power due to austerity,

5.273.s:
yadanyastāpaso nāsti īdṛśo'tra dharātale ..
tenāhaṃ dūrataḥ prāpto vairāgyeṇa samanvitaḥ .. 15 ..
5.273.d:
यदन्यस्तापसो नास्ति ईदृशोऽत्र धरातले ..
तेनाहं दूरतः प्राप्तो वैराग्येण समन्वितः .. 15 ..
5.273.m: that there is no other ascetic like you here on the face of the earth. / Therefore, filled with detachment, I have come from afar,

5.273.s:
saṃsārāsāratāṃ jñātvā janmamṛtyujarātmikām..
arthātsvapnapratīkāśaṃ yauvanaṃ ca nṛṇā miha .. 16 ..
5.273.d:
संसारासारतां ज्ञात्वा जन्ममृत्युजरात्मिकाम्..
अर्थात्स्वप्नप्रतीकाशं यौवनं च नृणा मिह .. 16 ..
5.273.m: having recognized the worthlessness of saṃsāra, which consists of birth, death, and old age, / and that wealth is like a dream, and that the youth of men here

5.273.s:
yadvatparvatasaṃjātā nadī ca kṣaṇabhaṃgurā ..
putrāḥ kalatrāṇi ca vā ye cānye bāṃdhavādayaḥ .. 17 ..
5.273.d:
यद्वत्पर्वतसंजाता नदी च क्षणभंगुरा ..
पुत्राः कलत्राणि च वा ये चान्ये बांधवादयः .. 17 ..
5.273.m: is like a mountain river, fleeting in an instant. / Sons, wives, and whatever other kinsmen there are,

5.273.s:
te sarve ca parijñeyā yathā pāpa samāgamāḥ ..
tatsaṃsārasamudrasya tāraṇārthaṃ bravīhi me .. 18 ..
5.273.d:
ते सर्वे च परिज्ञेया यथा पाप समागमाः ..
तत्संसारसमुद्रस्य तारणार्थं ब्रवीहि मे .. 18 ..
5.273.m: all of them are to be understood as encounters born of sin. / Therefore tell me, for the crossing of the ocean of saṃsāra,

5.273.s:
upāyaṃ kaṃcidadyaiva upadeśe vyavasthitam ..
tarāmi yena saṃsāraṃ prasādāttava suvrata .. 19 ..
5.273.d:
उपायं कंचिदद्यैव उपदेशे व्यवस्थितम् ..
तरामि येन संसारं प्रसादात्तव सुव्रत .. 19 ..
5.273.m: some means established in spiritual instruction this very day, / by which, by your grace, O man of good vows, I may cross over saṃsāra."

5.273.s:
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā romāṃcita tanūruhaḥ ..
jñātvā māheśvaraḥ ko'yaṃ ciṃtāvānsamupasthitaḥ .. 6.274.20 ..
5.273.d:
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा रोमांचित तनूरुहः ..
ज्ञात्वा माहेश्वरः कोऽयं चिंतावान्समुपस्थितः .. 6.274.20 ..
5.273.m: Hearing his words, with the hair of his body standing on end, / recognizing that some devotee of Śiva had approached with concern, [the abbot said:]

5.273.s:
yathā bravīṣi dhanyo'si yasya te matirīdṛśī ..
tāruṇye vartamānasya sukumārasya caiva hi .. 21 .
5.273.d:
यथा ब्रवीषि धन्योऽसि यस्य ते मतिरीदृशी ..
तारुण्ये वर्तमानस्य सुकुमारस्य चैव हि .. 21 .
5.273.m: "As you say, fortunate are you whose mind is of such a kind, / while still in your youth and tender indeed.

5.273.s:
tāruṇye vartamāno yaḥ śāṃtaḥ so'tra nigadyate ..
dhātuṣu kṣīyamāṇeṣu śamaḥ kasya na jāyate .. 22 ..
5.273.d:
तारुण्ये वर्तमानो यः शांतः सोऽत्र निगद्यते ..
धातुषु क्षीयमाणेषु शमः कस्य न जायते .. 22 ..
5.273.m: He who is tranquil while still in youth is praised here; / when the bodily humors are waning, in whom does calm not arise?

5.273.s:
yadyevaṃ suviraktiḥ syātsaṃsāropari saṃsthitā ..
samārādhaya deveśaṃ śaṃkaraṃ śaśiśekharam .. 23 ..
5.273.d:
यद्येवं सुविरक्तिः स्यात्संसारोपरि संस्थिता ..
समाराधय देवेशं शंकरं शशिशेखरम् .. 23 ..
5.273.m: If you have such intense detachment regarding saṃsāra, / then worship Śaṃkara, the lord of gods, who bears the crescent moon on his crest."

5.273.s:
nānyathā ghorajāpyena tīryate bhavasāgaraḥ ..
mayā samyakparijñātametacchāstrasamāgamāt .. 24 ..
5.273.d:
नान्यथा घोरजाप्येन तीर्यते भवसागरः ..
मया सम्यक्परिज्ञातमेतच्छास्त्रसमागमात् .. 24 ..
5.273.m: The ocean of worldly existence cannot be crossed otherwise than by recitation of the terrifying [mantra]. / This has been fully understood by me through access to the scriptures.

5.273.s:
śūdro vā yadi vā vipro mlecho vā pāpakṛnnaraḥ ..
śivadīkṣāsamopetaḥ puṣpamekaṃ tu yo nyasait [. 25 ..
5.273.d:
शूद्रो वा यदि वा विप्रो म्लेछो वा पापकृन्नरः ..
शिवदीक्षासमोपेतः पुष्पमेकं तु यो न्यसैत् [. 25 ..
5.273.m: Whether a śūdra, a brahmin, an outcaste, or a sinful man, / endowed with Śiva's initiation, whoever places a single flower,

5.273.s:
ṣaḍakṣareṇa maṃtreṇa liṃgasyopari bhaktitaḥ ..
sa tāṃ gatimavāpnoti yāṃyāṃ yāṃtīha yajvinaḥ .. 56 ..
yo dadāti prabhaktyā ca śivadīkṣānvitāya ca ..
vastropānahakaupīnaṃ sa yajñaiḥ kiṃ kariṣyati .. 27 ..
tacchrutvā caraṇau tasya duḥśīlo'sau tadā''dade ..
vinyasya svaśira stābhyāṃ tatovākyamuvāca ha .. 28 ..
śivadīkṣāpramāṇena prasādaṃ kuru me prabho ..
śuśrūṣāṃ yena te nityaṃ prakaromi samāhitaḥ .. 29 ..
tato'sau tāpaso viprāściṃtayāmāsa cetami ..
dakṣo'yaṃ dṛśyate ko'pi pumāṃścaiva samāgataḥ .. 6.274.30 ..
mamāsti nāparaḥ śiṣyastasmādenaṃ karomyaham ..
tato'bravītkare gṛhya yadyevaṃ vatsa me samam ..
samayaṃ kuru yena tvāṃ dīkṣayāmyadya caiva hi .. 31 ..
tvayā kuṭīrakaṃ kāryaṃ maṭhasyāsya vidūrataḥ ..
praveśo naiva kāryastu mamātrāstaṃ gate ravau .. 32 ..
5.273.d:
षडक्षरेण मंत्रेण लिंगस्योपरि भक्तितः ..
स तां गतिमवाप्नोति यांयां यांतीह यज्विनः .. 56 ..
यो ददाति प्रभक्त्या च शिवदीक्षान्विताय च ..
वस्त्रोपानहकौपीनं स यज्ञैः किं करिष्यति .. 27 ..
तच्छ्रुत्वा चरणौ तस्य दुःशीलोऽसौ तदा'ऽददे ..
विन्यस्य स्वशिर स्ताभ्यां ततोवाक्यमुवाच ह .. 28 ..
शिवदीक्षाप्रमाणेन प्रसादं कुरु मे प्रभो ..
शुश्रूषां येन ते नित्यं प्रकरोमि समाहितः .. 29 ..
ततोऽसौ तापसो विप्राश्चिंतयामास चेतमि ..
दक्षोऽयं दृश्यते कोऽपि पुमांश्चैव समागतः .. 6.274.30 ..
ममास्ति नापरः शिष्यस्तस्मादेनं करोम्यहम् ..
ततोऽब्रवीत्करे गृह्य यद्येवं वत्स मे समम् ..
समयं कुरु येन त्वां दीक्षयाम्यद्य चैव हि .. 31 ..
त्वया कुटीरकं कार्यं मठस्यास्य विदूरतः ..
प्रवेशो नैव कार्यस्तु ममात्रास्तं गते रवौ .. 32 ..
5.273.m:
With devotion upon the liṅga using the six-syllable mantra, / attains the very destination that sacrificers reach here.
He who offers with deep devotion to one endowed with Śiva's initiation / clothes, sandals, and a loincloth—what need has he of sacrifices?
Hearing that, that Duḥśīla then clasped his feet. / Placing his head upon them, he spoke these words:
“Bestow your favor upon me, lord, by the authority of Śiva's initiation, / so that, composed in mind, I may constantly render service to you.”
Then that ascetic, O brahmins, thought in his mind: / “This person who has arrived appears to be capable.
I have no other disciple, therefore I shall accept him.” / Then, taking him by the hand, he said: “If so, my child, / make an agreement with me, whereby I shall indeed initiate you this very day.
You must make a small hut far away from this monastery. / You must certainly not enter my presence here once the sun has set.”

5.273.s:
.. duḥśīla uvāca .. ..
tavādeśaḥ pramāṇaṃ me kevalaṃ tāpasottama ..
kiṃ maṭhena kariṣyāmi viśeṣādrā trisaṃgame .. 33 ..
yaḥ śiṣyo guruvākyaṃ tu na karoti yathoditam ..
tasya vrataṃ ca tadvyarthaṃ narakaṃ ca tataḥ param .. 34 ..
tacchrutvā tuṣṭimāpannaḥ śivadīkṣāṃ tato dadau ..
tasmai vinayayuktāya tadā niṃbaśuco muniḥ .. 35 ..
tataḥprabhṛti so'tīva tasya śuśrūṣaṇe rataḥ...
raṃjayāmāsa taccittaṃ paricaryāparāyaṇaḥ .. 36 ..
manasā cintayānastu tanmātrārthaṃ dinedine ..
na cchidraṃ vīkṣate kiṃcidvīkṣamāṇo'pi yatnataḥ .. 37 ..
śaivo'pi ca sa kakṣyāṃ tāṃ tāṃ mātrāṃ hemasaṃbhavām ..
kathaṃcinmokṣate bhūmau bhojye devārcane'pi na..38 ..
tato'sau cintayāmāsa duḥśīlo nijacetasi ..
maṭhe tāvatpraveśo'sti naiva rātrau kathaṃcana .. 39 ..
5.273.d:
.. दुःशील उवाच .. ..
तवादेशः प्रमाणं मे केवलं तापसोत्तम ..
किं मठेन करिष्यामि विशेषाद्रा त्रिसंगमे .. 33 ..
यः शिष्यो गुरुवाक्यं तु न करोति यथोदितम् ..
तस्य व्रतं च तद्व्यर्थं नरकं च ततः परम् .. 34 ..
तच्छ्रुत्वा तुष्टिमापन्नः शिवदीक्षां ततो ददौ ..
तस्मै विनययुक्ताय तदा निंबशुचो मुनिः .. 35 ..
ततःप्रभृति सोऽतीव तस्य शुश्रूषणे रतः...
रंजयामास तच्चित्तं परिचर्यापरायणः .. 36 ..
मनसा चिन्तयानस्तु तन्मात्रार्थं दिनेदिने ..
न च्छिद्रं वीक्षते किंचिद्वीक्षमाणोऽपि यत्नतः .. 37 ..
शैवोऽपि च स कक्ष्यां तां तां मात्रां हेमसंभवाम् ..
कथंचिन्मोक्षते भूमौ भोज्ये देवार्चनेऽपि न..38 ..
ततोऽसौ चिन्तयामास दुःशीलो निजचेतसि ..
मठे तावत्प्रवेशोऽस्ति नैव रात्रौ कथंचन .. 39 ..
5.273.m:
Duḥśīla said: / “Your command alone is my standard, O best of ascetics. / What would I do in the monastery, especially when night arrives?
The disciple who does not carry out the guru's word as spoken, / his vow is useless, and after that he goes to hell.”
Hearing that, the sage Nimbaśuci was pleased, and then / bestowed Śiva's initiation upon him who was endowed with humility.
From then on, he was exceedingly devoted to his service; / intent on serving, he gladdened his heart.
Thinking in his mind day after day solely of that vessel, / though watching carefully, he saw no vulnerability at all.
And that Śaiva devotee never let that gold-producing vessel / from his armpit touch the ground, even while eating or worshipping the deity.
Then Duḥśīla thought in his own mind: / “There is no entry into the monastery at night under any circumstances.

5.273.s:
sūryāstamānavelāyāṃ yatprayacchati tatkṣaṇāt ..
parighaṃ sudṛḍhaṃ pāpastatkaromi ca kiṃ punaḥ .. 6.274.40 ..
maṭho'yaṃ suśilābaddho naiva khātaṃ prajāyate ..
tuṃgatvānna praveśaḥ syādupāyairvividhaiḥ paraiḥ .. 41 ..
tatkiṃ viṣaṃ prayacchāmi śastrairvyāpādayāmi kim ..
divāpi paśumāreṇa paṃcatvaṃ vā nayāmi kim .. 42 ..
evaṃ cintayatastasya prāvṛṭkāla upasthitaḥ ..
śrāvaṇasyāsite pakṣe karkaṭasthe divākare .. 43 ..
prāpto maheśvarastasya ko'pi tatra dhanī drutam ..
tenoktaṃ praṇipatyoccaiḥ kariṣyāmi pavitrakam .. 44 ..
caturddaśyāmahaṃ svāminyadyādeśo bhavettava ..
yadyāgacchasi me grāmaṃ prasādena sama nvitaḥ .. 45 ..
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
tacchrutvā tuṣṭimāpannastato niṃbaśuco muniḥ ..
tatheti caivamuktvā taṃ preṣayāmāsa tatkṣaṇāt .. 46 ..
5.273.d:
सूर्यास्तमानवेलायां यत्प्रयच्छति तत्क्षणात् ..
परिघं सुदृढं पापस्तत्करोमि च किं पुनः .. 6.274.40 ..
मठोऽयं सुशिलाबद्धो नैव खातं प्रजायते ..
तुंगत्वान्न प्रवेशः स्यादुपायैर्विविधैः परैः .. 41 ..
तत्किं विषं प्रयच्छामि शस्त्रैर्व्यापादयामि किम् ..
दिवापि पशुमारेण पंचत्वं वा नयामि किम् .. 42 ..
एवं चिन्तयतस्तस्य प्रावृट्काल उपस्थितः ..
श्रावणस्यासिते पक्षे कर्कटस्थे दिवाकरे .. 43 ..
प्राप्तो महेश्वरस्तस्य कोऽपि तत्र धनी द्रुतम् ..
तेनोक्तं प्रणिपत्योच्चैः करिष्यामि पवित्रकम् .. 44 ..
चतुर्द्दश्यामहं स्वामिन्यद्यादेशो भवेत्तव ..
यद्यागच्छसि मे ग्रामं प्रसादेन सम न्वितः .. 45 ..
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
तच्छ्रुत्वा तुष्टिमापन्नस्ततो निंबशुचो मुनिः ..
तथेति चैवमुक्त्वा तं प्रेषयामास तत्क्षणात् .. 46 ..
5.273.m:
At sunset, that villain immediately puts up / a very firm bolt; so what can I do?
This monastery is built with solid stone, so no trench can be dug; / because of its height, entry cannot be achieved by various other means.
So shall I give him poison? Shall I kill him with weapons? / Or even by day, shall I bring about his death by slaughtering him like an animal?”
As he was thinking thus, the rainy season arrived / in the dark fortnight of Śrāvaṇa, when the sun was in Cancer.
A certain wealthy devotee of Maheśvara quickly arrived there before him. / Bowing low, he said aloud: “I shall perform the Pavītraka festival
On the fourteenth day, master, if your command permits— / if you come to my village, accompanied by grace.”
Sūta said: / Hearing that, the sage Nimbaśuci was pleased. / Saying ‘So be it,’ he sent him away at once:

5.273.s:
āgamiṣyāmyahaṃ kāle svaśiṣyeṇa samanvitaḥ ..
kariṣyāmi paraṃ śreyastava vatsa na saṃśayaḥ .. 47 ..
atha kāle tu saṃprāpte cintayitvā prabhātikam ..
prabhātasamaye prāpte sa śaivaḥ prasthitastadā ..
duḥśīlena samāyuktaḥ saṃprahṛṣṭatanūruhaḥ .. 48 ..
tato vai gacchamānasya tasya mārge vyavasthitā ..
puṇyā nadī suvikhyātā muralā sāgaraṃgamā .. 49 ..
sa tāṃ dṛṣṭvā'bravīdvākyaṃ vatsa śiṣya karomyaham ..
bhavatā saha devārcāṃ muralāyāṃ sthiro bhava .. 6.274.50 ..
bāḍhamityeva sa proktvā saṃsthito'syāstaṭe śubhe ..
so'pi niṃbaśucastasya raṃjitaḥ sarvadā guṇaiḥ .. 51 ..
suśiṣyaṃ taṃ parijñāya viśvāsaṃ paramaṃ gataḥ..
sthagitāṃ tāṃ samādāya hemamātrāsamudbhavām .. 52 ..
jāgeśvarasamopetāṃ sa kanthāṃ vyākṣipatkṣitau ..
purīṣotsargakāryeṇa tatastokāṃtaraṃ gataḥ .. 53 ..
5.273.d:
आगमिष्याम्यहं काले स्वशिष्येण समन्वितः ..
करिष्यामि परं श्रेयस्तव वत्स न संशयः .. 47 ..
अथ काले तु संप्राप्ते चिन्तयित्वा प्रभातिकम् ..
प्रभातसमये प्राप्ते स शैवः प्रस्थितस्तदा ..
दुःशीलेन समायुक्तः संप्रहृष्टतनूरुहः .. 48 ..
ततो वै गच्छमानस्य तस्य मार्गे व्यवस्थिता ..
पुण्या नदी सुविख्याता मुरला सागरंगमा .. 49 ..
स तां दृष्ट्वाऽब्रवीद्वाक्यं वत्स शिष्य करोम्यहम् ..
भवता सह देवार्चां मुरलायां स्थिरो भव .. 6.274.50 ..
बाढमित्येव स प्रोक्त्वा संस्थितोऽस्यास्तटे शुभे ..
सोऽपि निंबशुचस्तस्य रंजितः सर्वदा गुणैः .. 51 ..
सुशिष्यं तं परिज्ञाय विश्वासं परमं गतः..
स्थगितां तां समादाय हेममात्रासमुद्भवाम् .. 52 ..
जागेश्वरसमोपेतां स कन्थां व्याक्षिपत्क्षितौ ..
पुरीषोत्सर्गकार्येण ततस्तोकांतरं गतः .. 53 ..
5.273.m:
“I will come at the proper time, accompanied by my disciple. / I shall ensure your supreme spiritual welfare, my child, there is no doubt.”
Then, when the time had arrived, having considered the morning rites, / and dawn having come, that Śaiva devotee departed, / accompanied by Duḥśīla, the hair of his body bristling with joy.
Then, as he was traveling, there lay along the path / the sacred, celebrated river Muralā, which goes to the ocean.
Seeing it, he said: “My child, disciple, / I shall worship the deity together with you at the Muralā; remain here.”
Saying ‘Certainly,’ he remained on its auspicious bank. / Nimbaśuci too, always delighted by his good qualities,
Recognized him as a good disciple and felt complete trust. / Taking off the concealed [garment] arising from the gold vessel,
He placed that patched garment containing Jāgeśvara upon the ground, / and went a short distance away for the purpose of answering nature's call.

5.273.s:
yāvaccādarśanaṃ prāpto vetasaiḥ parivāritaḥ ..
tāvanmātrāṃ samādāya duḥśīlaḥ prasthito drutam ..
uttarāṃ diśamāśritya prahṛṣṭenāṃtarātmanā .. 54 .. .
athāsau cāgato yāvadduḥśīlaṃ naiva paśyati ..
kevalaṃ dṛśyate kanthā jāgeśvarasamanvitā .. 55 ..
tataḥ śīghrataraṃ śaucaṃ kiñcitkṛtvā sudurmanāḥ ..
vinaivācamanaṃ prāptaḥ sā kanthā yatra tiṣṭhati ..56 ..
5.273.d:
यावच्चादर्शनं प्राप्तो वेतसैः परिवारितः ..
तावन्मात्रां समादाय दुःशीलः प्रस्थितो द्रुतम् ..
उत्तरां दिशमाश्रित्य प्रहृष्टेनांतरात्मना .. 54 .. .
अथासौ चागतो यावद्दुःशीलं नैव पश्यति ..
केवलं दृश्यते कन्था जागेश्वरसमन्विता .. 55 ..
ततः शीघ्रतरं शौचं किञ्चित्कृत्वा सुदुर्मनाः ..
विनैवाचमनं प्राप्तः सा कन्था यत्र तिष्ठति ..56 ..
5.273.m:
As soon as he was out of sight, surrounded by canes, / Duḥśīla quickly took the vessel and departed, / heading toward the northern direction, his inner soul rejoicing.
Now, when [the sage] returned, he did not see Duḥśīla at all; / only the patched garment accompanied by Jāgeśvara was seen.
Then, doing a hasty cleansing, deeply distressed, / without even doing the ritual rinsing of the mouth, he reached the place where that patched garment lay.

5.273.s:
yāvanmātrāvihīnāṃ ca tato jñātvā ca tāṃ hṛtām ..
tena śiṣyeṇa mūrcchāḍhyo nipapāta mahītale .. 57 ..
5.273.d:
यावन्मात्राविहीनां च ततो ज्ञात्वा च तां हृताम् ..
तेन शिष्येण मूर्च्छाढ्यो निपपात महीतले .. 57 ..
5.273.m: Finding it devoid of the vessel, and knowing it had been stolen / by that disciple, he fell unconscious to the ground.

5.273.s:
tataśca cetanāṃ prāpya kṛcchrāccotthāya tatkṣaṇāt ..
śilāyāṃ tāḍayāmāsa nijāṃgāni śirastathā .. 58 ..
5.273.d:
ततश्च चेतनां प्राप्य कृच्छ्राच्चोत्थाय तत्क्षणात् ..
शिलायां ताडयामास निजांगानि शिरस्तथा .. 58 ..
5.273.m: Regaining consciousness and getting up with difficulty at once, / he beat his limbs and his head against a rock:

5.273.s:
hā hato'smi vinaṣṭo'smi muṣṭastena durātmanā ..
kiṃ karomi kva gacchāmi kathaṃ taṃ vīkṣayāmyaham.. 59 ..
5.273.d:
हा हतोऽस्मि विनष्टोऽस्मि मुष्टस्तेन दुरात्मना ..
किं करोमि क्व गच्छामि कथं तं वीक्षयाम्यहम्.. 59 ..
5.273.m: “Alas, I am undone! I am ruined! I have been robbed by that wretch! / What shall I do? Where shall I go? How can I find him?”

5.273.s:
tatastu padavīṃ vīkṣya tasya tāṃ calito dhruvam ..
vṛddha bhāvātpariśrāṃto vāvṛtya sa maṭhaṃ gataḥ .. 6.274.60 ..
5.273.d:
ततस्तु पदवीं वीक्ष्य तस्य तां चलितो ध्रुवम् ..
वृद्ध भावात्परिश्रांतो वावृत्य स मठं गतः .. 6.274.60 ..
5.273.m: Then, seeing his tracks, he certainly set out [after him]; / but exhausted due to old age, he turned back and went to the monastery.

5.273.s:
duḥśīlo'pi samādāya mātrāṃ sthānāṃtaraṃ gataḥ ..
tatastena suvarṇena vyavahārānkaroti saḥ .. 61 ..
5.273.d:
दुःशीलोऽपि समादाय मात्रां स्थानांतरं गतः ..
ततस्तेन सुवर्णेन व्यवहारान्करोति सः .. 61 ..
5.273.m: Duḥśīla too, having taken the vessel, went to another place. / Then, with that gold, he engaged in commercial transactions.

5.273.s:
tato gṛhasthatāṃ prāptaḥ kṛtadāraparigrahaḥ ..
vṛddhabhāvaṃ samāpannaḥ saṃtānena vivarjitaḥ .. 62 ..
5.273.d:
ततो गृहस्थतां प्राप्तः कृतदारपरिग्रहः ..
वृद्धभावं समापन्नः संतानेन विवर्जितः .. 62 ..
5.273.m: Then he attained the householder's life, took a wife, / reached old age, and was devoid of offspring.

5.273.s:
kasyacittvatha kālasya tīrthayātrāparāyaṇaḥ ..
bhāryayā sahito vipraścamatkārapuraṃ gataḥ .. 63 ..
5.273.d:
कस्यचित्त्वथ कालस्य तीर्थयात्रापरायणः ..
भार्यया सहितो विप्रश्चमत्कारपुरं गतः .. 63 ..
5.273.m: After some time, intent on a pilgrimage to sacred fords, / that brahmin went to Camatkārapura accompanied by his wife.

5.273.s:
snātvā tīrtheṣu sarveṣu devatāyataneṣu ca ..
bhramamāṇena saṃdṛṣṭo durvāsā nāma sanmuniḥ .. 64 ..
5.273.d:
स्नात्वा तीर्थेषु सर्वेषु देवतायतनेषु च ..
भ्रममाणेन संदृष्टो दुर्वासा नाम सन्मुनिः .. 64 ..
5.273.m: Having bathed in all the sacred fords and temples of deities, / as he was wandering, he saw the noble sage named Durvāsas,

5.273.s:
nijadevasya sadbhaktyā nṛtyagītaparāyaṇaḥ ..
taṃ ca dṛṣṭvā namaskṛtya vākyametaduvāca saḥ .. 65 ..
5.273.d:
निजदेवस्य सद्भक्त्या नृत्यगीतपरायणः ..
तं च दृष्ट्वा नमस्कृत्य वाक्यमेतदुवाच सः .. 65 ..
5.273.m: Devoted to dancing and singing with sincere devotion to his own deity. / Seeing him and bowing down, he spoke these words:

5.273.s:
kenaitatsthāpitaṃ liṃgaṃ nirmalaṃ śaṃkarodbhavam ..
kiṃ tvaṃ nṛtyasi gītaṃ ca puro'sya prakaroṣi ca ..
munīnāṃ yujyate naiva yadetattava ceṣṭitam..66..
5.273.d:
केनैतत्स्थापितं लिंगं निर्मलं शंकरोद्भवम् ..
किं त्वं नृत्यसि गीतं च पुरोऽस्य प्रकरोषि च ..
मुनीनां युज्यते नैव यदेतत्तव चेष्टितम्..66..
5.273.m: "By whom was this spotless liṅga arising from Śaṃkara established? / Why do you dance and sing before it? / This conduct of yours does not at all befit sages." [66]

5.273.s:
.. durvāsā uvāca .. ..
mayaitatsthāpitaṃ liṃgaṃ devadevasya śūlinaḥ..
nṛtyagītapriyo yasmāddevadevo maheśvaraḥ .. 67 ..
5.273.d:
.. दुर्वासा उवाच .. ..
मयैतत्स्थापितं लिंगं देवदेवस्य शूलिनः..
नृत्यगीतप्रियो यस्माद्देवदेवो महेश्वरः .. 67 ..
5.273.m: Durvāsas said: / "By me was this liṅga of the god of gods, the trident-bearer, established, / because the god of gods, Maheśvara, is fond of dancing and singing. [67]

5.273.s: na me'sti vibhavaḥ kaścidyena bhogaṃ karomyaham..68..
5.273.d: न मेऽस्ति विभवः कश्चिद्येन भोगं करोम्यहम्..68..
5.273.m: I possess no wealth by which I might perform worship with offerings." [68]

5.273.s:
etasminnaṃtare prāptaścirbhaṭirnāma yogavit ..
tena pṛṣṭaḥ sa durvāsā vedāṃtikamidaṃ vacaḥ ..69.. cirbhaṭi
5.273.d:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे प्राप्तश्चिर्भटिर्नाम योगवित् ..
तेन पृष्टः स दुर्वासा वेदांतिकमिदं वचः ..69.. चिर्भटि
5.273.m: In the meantime, one named Cirbhaṭi, a knower of yoga, arrived; / by him was Durvāsas asked this word belonging to the Vedānta: [69]

5.273.s:
asūryā nāma te lokā aṃdhena tamasā vṛtāḥ ..
tāṃste pretyā'bhigacchaṃti ye kecātmahano janāḥ .. .. 6.274.70 ..
5.273.d:
असूर्या नाम ते लोका अंधेन तमसा वृताः ..
तांस्ते प्रेत्याऽभिगच्छंति ये केचात्महनो जनाः .. .. 6.274.70 ..
5.273.m: "Sunless indeed are those worlds, enveloped in blinding darkness; / to them after death go whoever are slayers of the self." [70]

5.273.s:
upaviśya tatastena tasya dattastu nirṇayaḥ ..
duḥśīlenāpi tatsarva vijñātaṃ tasya saṃstutam .. 71 ..
5.273.d:
उपविश्य ततस्तेन तस्य दत्तस्तु निर्णयः ..
दुःशीलेनापि तत्सर्व विज्ञातं तस्य संस्तुतम् .. 71 ..
5.273.m: Sitting down, the decision was then given to him by [Durvāsas]; / and all that which was recited by him was understood by Duḥśīla. [71]

5.273.s:
tato viśeṣato jātā bhaktistasya haraṃ prati ..
taṃ praṇamya tataścoccairvākyametaduvāca ha .. 72 ..
5.273.d:
ततो विशेषतो जाता भक्तिस्तस्य हरं प्रति ..
तं प्रणम्य ततश्चोच्चैर्वाक्यमेतदुवाच ह .. 72 ..
5.273.m: Then devotion toward Hara arose especially in him; / then, having bowed down to him, he spoke these words aloud: [72]

5.273.s:
bhagavan brāhmaṇo'smīti jātyā caiva na karmaṇā ..
na kasyacinmayā dattaṃ kadācinnaiva bhojanam ..
kevalaṃ devaviprāṇāṃ vaṃcayitvā dhanaṃ hṛtam ..
vyasanenābhibhūtena dyūtaveśyodbhavena ca .. 74 ..
5.273.d:
भगवन् ब्राह्मणोऽस्मीति जात्या चैव न कर्मणा ..
न कस्यचिन्मया दत्तं कदाचिन्नैव भोजनम् ..
केवलं देवविप्राणां वंचयित्वा धनं हृतम् ..
व्यसनेनाभिभूतेन द्यूतवेश्योद्भवेन च .. 74 ..
5.273.m: "O venerable one, I am a brahmin only by birth and not by deed! / Food was never given by me at any time to anyone; / I only robbed the wealth of gods and brahmins after deceiving them, / overcome by vice arising from gambling and courtesans. [74]

5.273.s:
tathā ca brāhmaṇenāpi mayā śaivo guruḥ kṛtaḥ ..
vaṃcitaśca tathānekaiścāṭubhirvihṛtaṃ dhanam .. 75 ..
5.273.d:
तथा च ब्राह्मणेनापि मया शैवो गुरुः कृतः ..
वंचितश्च तथानेकैश्चाटुभिर्विहृतं धनम् .. 75 ..
5.273.m: And likewise, though a brahmin, a Śaiva guru was made by me; / and he was deceived, and his wealth was carried off by numerous flatteries. [75]

5.273.s:
tasya saktaṃ dhanaṃ bhūyaḥ sādhumārgeṇa cāhṛtam ..
sa cāpi ca gururmahyaṃ paralokamihāgataḥ .. .. 76 ..
5.273.d:
तस्य सक्तं धनं भूयः साधुमार्गेण चाहृतम् ..
स चापि च गुरुर्मह्यं परलोकमिहागतः .. .. 76 ..
5.273.m: The wealth attached to him was taken away again through the pretext of being virtuous; / and that guru of mine has here departed to the other world. [76]

5.273.s:
paścāttāpena tenaiva pradahyāmi divāniśam ..
puraścaraṇadānena tatprasādaṃ kuruṣva me .. 77 ..
5.273.d:
पश्चात्तापेन तेनैव प्रदह्यामि दिवानिशम् ..
पुरश्चरणदानेन तत्प्रसादं कुरुष्व मे .. 77 ..
5.273.m: Day and night I burn with that very remorse; / by giving [instruction for] preparatory rites, bestow that favor upon me! [77]

5.273.s:
asti me vipulaṃ vittaṃ na saṃtānaṃ munīśvara ..
tanme vada mune śreyastadvittasya yathā bhavet ..
iha loke pare caiva yena sarvaṃ karomyaham .. 78 ..
5.273.d:
अस्ति मे विपुलं वित्तं न संतानं मुनीश्वर ..
तन्मे वद मुने श्रेयस्तद्वित्तस्य यथा भवेत् ..
इह लोके परे चैव येन सर्वं करोम्यहम् .. 78 ..
5.273.m: I have abundant wealth, but no offspring, O lord of sages; / therefore tell me, O sage, how that wealth may result in spiritual welfare / in this world and in the next, so that I may perform everything." [78]

5.273.s:
.. durvāsā uvāca .. ..
kṛtvā pāpasahasrāṇi paścāddharmaparo bhavet ..
yaḥ pumānso'tikṛcchreṇa taretsaṃsārasāgaram .. 79 ..
5.273.d:
.. दुर्वासा उवाच .. ..
कृत्वा पापसहस्राणि पश्चाद्धर्मपरो भवेत् ..
यः पुमान्सोऽतिकृच्छ्रेण तरेत्संसारसागरम् .. 79 ..
5.273.m: Durvāsas said: / "Having committed thousands of sins, if a man should later become intent on dharma, / he may cross the ocean of transmigration only with great difficulty. [79]

5.273.s:
dinenāpi gururyo'sau tvayā śaivo vinirmitaḥ .
adharmeṇāpi saṃjātaḥ sa gurustena saṃśayaḥ .. 6.274.80 ..
5.273.d:
दिनेनापि गुरुर्योऽसौ त्वया शैवो विनिर्मितः .
अधर्मेणापि संजातः स गुरुस्तेन संशयः .. 6.274.80 ..
5.273.m: That Śaiva guru who was adopted by you even for a day— / that guru was acquired through adharma, and there is doubt about it. [80]

5.273.s:
brāhmaṇo brahmacārī syādgrahasthastadanaṃtaram ..
vānaprastho yatiścaiva tata ścaiva kuṭīcaraḥ .. 81 ..
5.273.d:
ब्राह्मणो ब्रह्मचारी स्याद्ग्रहस्थस्तदनंतरम् ..
वानप्रस्थो यतिश्चैव तत श्चैव कुटीचरः .. 81 ..
5.273.m: A brahmin should be a celibate student, and after that a householder, / a forest-dweller, and a renunciant, and after that a kuṭīcara; [81]

5.273.s:
bahūdakastato haṃsaḥ paramaśca tato bhavet ..
tataśca muktimāyāti mārgamenaṃ samāśritaḥ .. 82 ..
5.273.d:
बहूदकस्ततो हंसः परमश्च ततो भवेत् ..
ततश्च मुक्तिमायाति मार्गमेनं समाश्रितः .. 82 ..
5.273.m: then a bahūdaka, then a haṃsa, and then he should become a supreme [ascetic]; / and resorting to this path, he then attains liberation. [82]

5.273.s:
tvayā punaḥ kumārgeṇa yadvrataṃ brāhmaṇena ca [.
śaivamārgaṃ samāsthāya tanmahāpātakaṃ kṛtam .. 83 ..
5.273.d:
त्वया पुनः कुमार्गेण यद्व्रतं ब्राह्मणेन च [.
शैवमार्गं समास्थाय तन्महापातकं कृतम् .. 83 ..
5.273.m: You, however, as a brahmin taking up a Śaiva path by a wrong course— / that vow you undertook was a great sin committed by you. [83]

5.273.s:
.. duḥśīla uvāca .. ..
sarveṣveva hi vedeṣu rudraḥ saṃkīrtyate prabhuḥ ..
tatkiṃ doṣastvayā proktastasya dīkṣāsamudbhavaḥ .. 84 ..
5.273.d:
.. दुःशील उवाच .. ..
सर्वेष्वेव हि वेदेषु रुद्रः संकीर्त्यते प्रभुः ..
तत्किं दोषस्त्वया प्रोक्तस्तस्य दीक्षासमुद्भवः .. 84 ..
5.273.m: Duḥśīla said: / "Indeed, in all the Vedas the lord Rudra is celebrated; / then why is a fault declared by you as arising from initiation into his [cult]?" [84]

5.273.s:
.. durvāsā uvāca .. ..
satyametattvayā khyātaṃ vede rudraḥ prakīrtitaḥ ..
bahudhā vāsudevo'pi brahmā caiva viśeṣataḥ .. 85 ..
5.273.d:
.. दुर्वासा उवाच .. ..
सत्यमेतत्त्वया ख्यातं वेदे रुद्रः प्रकीर्तितः ..
बहुधा वासुदेवोऽपि ब्रह्मा चैव विशेषतः .. 85 ..
5.273.m: Durvāsas said: / "This spoken by you is true: Rudra is proclaimed in the Veda; / Vāsudeva also in many ways, and especially Brahmā. [85]

5.273.s:
paraṃ viprasya yā dīkṣā vratavaṃdhasamudbhavā ..
gāyatrī paramā jāpye gururvrataparo hi saḥ ..
vaiṣṇavīṃ cātha śaivīṃ ca yo'nyāṃ dīkṣāṃ samācaret .. 86 ..
5.273.d:
परं विप्रस्य या दीक्षा व्रतवंधसमुद्भवा ..
गायत्री परमा जाप्ये गुरुर्व्रतपरो हि सः ..
वैष्णवीं चाथ शैवीं च योऽन्यां दीक्षां समाचरेत् .. 86 ..
5.273.m: Yet the initiation of a brahmin arises from the investiture with the sacred thread; / the supreme Gāyatrī is to be muttered, for he is a guru devoted to that vow. / But whoever undertakes another initiation, whether Vaiṣṇava or Śaiva, [86]

5.273.s:
brāhmaṇo na bhavetso'tra yadyapi syātṣaḍaṃgavit ..
aparaṃ liṃgabhedaste saṃjātaḥ kapaṭādiṣu .. 87 ..
5.273.d:
ब्राह्मणो न भवेत्सोऽत्र यद्यपि स्यात्षडंगवित् ..
अपरं लिंगभेदस्ते संजातः कपटादिषु .. 87 ..
5.273.m: he cannot be a brahmin here, even if he were a knower of the six auxiliary sciences; / moreover, an alteration of sectarian marks occurred for you through deceit and the like. [87]

5.273.s:
vratatyāgānna saṃdehastatra te nāsti kiṃcana ..
prāyaścittaṃ mayā samyaksmṛtimārgeṇa ciṃtitam.. 88 ..
5.273.d:
व्रतत्यागान्न संदेहस्तत्र ते नास्ति किंचन ..
प्रायश्चित्तं मया सम्यक्स्मृतिमार्गेण चिंतितम्.. 88 ..
5.273.m: There is no doubt that there is nothing left for you on account of abandoning your vow; / an expiation has been properly considered by me in accordance with the path of the Smṛti." [88]

5.273.s:
.. duḥśīla uvāca .. ..
satāṃ saptapadīṃ maitrīṃ pravadaṃti manīṣiṇaḥ ..
mitratāṃ tu puraskṛtya kiṃcidvakṣyāmi tacchṛṇu .. 89 ..
5.273.d:
.. दुःशील उवाच .. ..
सतां सप्तपदीं मैत्रीं प्रवदंति मनीषिणः ..
मित्रतां तु पुरस्कृत्य किंचिद्वक्ष्यामि तच्छृणु .. 89 ..
5.273.m: Duḥśīla said: / "Wise men declare friendship of the virtuous to consist of seven steps; / prioritizing friendship, I shall say something; listen to it: [89]

5.273.s:
asti me vipulaṃ vittaṃ yadi tena prasiddhyati ..
tadvadasva mahābhāga yena sarvaṃ karomyaham .. .. 6.274.90 ..
5.273.d:
अस्ति मे विपुलं वित्तं यदि तेन प्रसिद्ध्यति ..
तद्वदस्व महाभाग येन सर्वं करोम्यहम् .. .. 6.274.90 ..
5.273.m: I have abundant wealth; if by it success may be accomplished, / then tell me that, O highly fortunate one, by which I may do everything." [90]

5.273.s:
.. durvāsā uvāca .. ..
eka eva hyupāyo'sti tava pātakanāśane ..
taṃ cetkaroṣi me vākyādviśuddhaḥ saṃbhaviṣyasi .. 91 ..
5.273.d:
.. दुर्वासा उवाच .. ..
एक एव ह्युपायोऽस्ति तव पातकनाशने ..
तं चेत्करोषि मे वाक्याद्विशुद्धः संभविष्यसि .. 91 ..
5.273.m: Durvāsas said: / "There is indeed only one means for destroying your sins; / if you do it according to my word, you will become purified. [91]

5.273.s:
tapaḥ kṛte praśaṃsaṃti tretāyāṃ jñānameva ca ..
dvāpare tīrthayātrāṃ ca dānameva kalau yuge .. 92 ..
5.273.d:
तपः कृते प्रशंसंति त्रेतायां ज्ञानमेव च ..
द्वापरे तीर्थयात्रां च दानमेव कलौ युगे .. 92 ..
5.273.m: They praise austerity in the Kṛta age, and knowledge in the Tretā, / pilgrimage to sacred fords in the Dvāpara, and only giving in the Kali age. [92]

5.273.s:
sāṃprataṃ kalikālo'yaṃ vartate dāruṇākṛtiḥ ..
tasmātkṛṣṇājinaṃ dehi sarvapāpaviśuddhaye .. 93 ..
5.273.d:
सांप्रतं कलिकालोऽयं वर्तते दारुणाकृतिः ..
तस्मात्कृष्णाजिनं देहि सर्वपापविशुद्धये .. 93 ..
5.273.m: At present this Kali age exists, of terrible aspect; / therefore give a black antelope skin for purification from all sins. [93]

5.273.s:
tathā ca te ghṛṇā'pyasti guruvittasamudbhavā ..
tadarthaṃ kuru tannāmnā śaṃkarasya niveśanam.. 94 ..
5.273.d:
तथा च ते घृणाऽप्यस्ति गुरुवित्तसमुद्भवा ..
तदर्थं कुरु तन्नाम्ना शंकरस्य निवेशनम्.. 94 ..
5.273.m: And likewise, there is aversion in you arising from the guru's wealth; / for that purpose, build an abode of Śaṃkara in his name, [94]

5.273.s:
yena tasmādapi tvaṃ hi ānṛṇyaṃ yāsi tatkṣaṇāt ..
anyatrāpi ca tadvittaṃ yatkiṃcicca prapadyate .. 95 ..
5.273.d:
येन तस्मादपि त्वं हि आनृण्यं यासि तत्क्षणात् ..
अन्यत्रापि च तद्वित्तं यत्किंचिच्च प्रपद्यते .. 95 ..
5.273.m: so that you will immediately attain freedom from debt even on that account; / and whatever other wealth of that kind is acquired, [95]

5.273.s:
brāhmaṇebhyo viśiṣṭebhyo nityaṃ dehi samāhitaḥ ..
tilapātraṃ sadā dehi sahiraṇyaṃ viśeṣataḥ .. 96 ..
5.273.d:
ब्राह्मणेभ्यो विशिष्टेभ्यो नित्यं देहि समाहितः ..
तिलपात्रं सदा देहि सहिरण्यं विशेषतः .. 96 ..
5.273.m: give it constantly with collected mind to distinguished brahmins; / always give a vessel filled with sesame seeds, especially with gold, [96]

5.273.s:
yena te sakalaṃ pāpaṃ dehānnāśaṃ pragacchati ..
aparaṃ caitramāse'haṃ sadā''gacchāmi bhaktitaḥ .. 97 ..
5.273.d:
येन ते सकलं पापं देहान्नाशं प्रगच्छति ..
अपरं चैत्रमासेऽहं सदा'ऽगच्छामि भक्तितः .. 97 ..
5.273.m: so that all your sin will depart from your body into destruction. / Furthermore, in the month of Caitra I always come with devotion [97]

5.273.s:
kalpagrāmātsudūrācca prāsāde'tra svayaṃ kṛte ..
punaryāmi ca tatraiva vratametaddhi me sthitam .. 98 ..
5.273.d:
कल्पग्रामात्सुदूराच्च प्रासादेऽत्र स्वयं कृते ..
पुनर्यामि च तत्रैव व्रतमेतद्धि मे स्थितम् .. 98 ..
5.273.m: from far-off Kalpagrāma to this temple built by myself, / and then I go back there; for this is established as my vow. [98]

5.273.s:
tasmācciṃtyastvayāhyeṣa prāsādo yo mayā kṛtaḥ ..
ciṃtanīyaṃ sadaiveha snānādibhiranekaśaḥ .. 99 ..
5.273.d:
तस्माच्चिंत्यस्त्वयाह्येष प्रासादो यो मया कृतः ..
चिंतनीयं सदैवेह स्नानादिभिरनेकशः .. 99 ..
5.273.m: Therefore, this temple which was built by me should be cared for by you; / it should always be attended to here in various ways with ritual ablution and the like." [99]

5.273.s:
.. duḥśīla uvāca .. ..
kariṣyāmi vacaste'haṃ yathā vadasi sanmune .. 6.274.100 .. .. ..
5.273.d:
.. दुःशील उवाच .. ..
करिष्यामि वचस्तेऽहं यथा वदसि सन्मुने .. 6.274.100 .. .. ..
5.273.m: Duḥśīla said: / "I shall perform your word, as you say, O good sage." [100]

5.273.s:
.. durvāsā uvāca .. ..
sarvapāpaviśuddhyarthaṃ datte kṛṣṇājine dvijaḥ ..
prayaccha tilapātrāṇi guptapāpasya śuddhaye .. 101 ..
5.273.d:
.. दुर्वासा उवाच .. ..
सर्वपापविशुद्ध्यर्थं दत्ते कृष्णाजिने द्विजः ..
प्रयच्छ तिलपात्राणि गुप्तपापस्य शुद्धये .. 101 ..
5.273.m: Durvāsas said: / "For purification from all sins, when the black antelope skin is given, O twice-born, / give vessels filled with sesame seeds for purification from hidden sin." [101]

5.273.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā dattaṃ tena mahātmanā ..
tataḥ kṛṣṇājinaṃ bhaktyā brāhmaṇāyāhitāgnaye .. 102 ..
5.273.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा दत्तं तेन महात्मना ..
ततः कृष्णाजिनं भक्त्या ब्राह्मणायाहिताग्नये .. 102 ..
5.273.m: Sūta said: / Hearing that speech of his, a black antelope skin / was then given with devotion by that great-souled one to a brahmin who maintains sacred fires. [102]

5.273.s:
durvāsasaḥ samā deśādyathoktavidhinā dvijāḥ .
yacchatastilapātrāṇi tasya nityaṃ prabhaktitaḥ .. 103 ..
5.273.d:
दुर्वाससः समा देशाद्यथोक्तविधिना द्विजाः .
यच्छतस्तिलपात्राणि तस्य नित्यं प्रभक्तितः .. 103 ..
5.273.m: By command of Durvāsas, according to the prescribed rule, O twice-born ones, / to him who was constantly giving vessels filled with sesame seeds with great devotion, [103]

5.273.s:
gatapāpasya dīkṣāṃ ca dadau nirvāṇasaṃbhavām ..
tathāsau gatapāpasya dīkṣāṃ dattvā yathāvidhi .. 104 ..
5.273.d:
गतपापस्य दीक्षां च ददौ निर्वाणसंभवाम् ..
तथासौ गतपापस्य दीक्षां दत्त्वा यथाविधि .. 104 ..
5.273.m: and whose sins were gone, [Durvāsas] imparted initiation leading to final release. / Thus having imparted initiation according to rule to him whose sins were gone, [104]

5.273.s: tataḥ provāca madhuraṃ dehi me gurudakṣiṇām .. 105 ..
5.273.d: ततः प्रोवाच मधुरं देहि मे गुरुदक्षिणाम् .. 105 ..
5.273.m: he then spoke sweetly: "Give me the guru's fee." [105]

5.273.s:
.. duḥśīla uvāca .. ..
yācasva tvaṃ prabho śīghraṃ yāṃ te yacchāmi dakṣiṇām ..
tāṃ pradāsyāmi cecchaktirvittaśāṭhyavivarjitām.. 106 ..
5.273.d:
.. दुःशील उवाच .. ..
याचस्व त्वं प्रभो शीघ्रं यां ते यच्छामि दक्षिणाम् ..
तां प्रदास्यामि चेच्छक्तिर्वित्तशाठ्यविवर्जिताम्.. 106 ..
5.273.m: Duḥśīla said: / "Ask quickly, O lord, for whichever fee I am to give you; / if there is capacity, I will give it free from deceit regarding wealth." [106]

5.273.s:
.. durvāsā uvāca .. ..
kalpagrāmaṃ gamiṣyāmi sāṃprataṃ vartate kaliḥ ..
nāhamatrāgamiṣyāmi yāvannaiva kṛtaṃ bhavet .. 107 ..
5.273.d:
.. दुर्वासा उवाच .. ..
कल्पग्रामं गमिष्यामि सांप्रतं वर्तते कलिः ..
नाहमत्रागमिष्यामि यावन्नैव कृतं भवेत् .. 107 ..
5.273.m:
Durvāsas said:
“I shall go to Kalpagrāma; now the Kali [age] is prevailing.
I shall not return here until it is completed.

5.273.s:
ardhaniṣpādito hyeṣa prāsādo yo mayā kṛtaḥ ..
paripūrtiṃ tvayā neya eṣā me gurudakṣiṇā .. 108 ..
5.273.d:
अर्धनिष्पादितो ह्येष प्रासादो यो मया कृतः ..
परिपूर्तिं त्वया नेय एषा मे गुरुदक्षिणा .. 108 ..
5.273.m:
Indeed, this temple that has been built by me is only half-completed.
You must bring it to completion; this is the fee for your guru.

5.273.s:
nṛtyagītādikaṃ yacca tathā kāryaṃ svaśaktitaḥ ..
purato'sya balirdeyastathānyatkusumādikam .. 109 ..
5.273.d:
नृत्यगीतादिकं यच्च तथा कार्यं स्वशक्तितः ..
पुरतोऽस्य बलिर्देयस्तथान्यत्कुसुमादिकम् .. 109 ..
5.273.m:
And whatever pertains to dance, singing, and so forth must likewise be performed according to your ability.
An offering must be presented before it, as well as flowers and other items.”

5.273.s:
evamuktvā gataḥ so'tha kalpagrāmaṃ munīśvaraḥ ..
duḥśīlo'pi tathā cakre yattena samudāhṛtam .. 6.274.110 ..
5.273.d:
एवमुक्त्वा गतः सोऽथ कल्पग्रामं मुनीश्वरः ..
दुःशीलोऽपि तथा चक्रे यत्तेन समुदाहृतम् .. 6.274.110 ..
5.273.m:
Having spoken thus, that lord of sages then departed for Kalpagrāma.
Duḥśīla too did just as had been told to him.

5.273.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
evaṃ tasya prabhaktasya tatkāryāṇi prakurvataḥ ..
tannāmnā kīrtyate so'tha duḥśīla iti saṃjñitaḥ .. 111 ..
5.273.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
एवं तस्य प्रभक्तस्य तत्कार्याणि प्रकुर्वतः ..
तन्नाम्ना कीर्त्यते सोऽथ दुःशील इति संज्ञितः .. 111 ..
5.273.m:
Sūta said:
As he, being deeply devoted, was performing those tasks,
he [the deity] then came to be named after his name, called ‘Duḥśīla’.

5.273.s:
caitramāse ca yo nityaṃ taṃ ca devaṃ prapaśyati ..
kṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā sa pāpena vārṣikeṇa pramucyate .. 112 ..
5.273.d:
चैत्रमासे च यो नित्यं तं च देवं प्रपश्यति ..
क्षणं कृत्वा स पापेन वार्षिकेण प्रमुच्यते .. 112 ..
5.273.m:
And whoever constantly looks upon that god in the month of Caitra,
having spent a moment [there], is freed from the sin of an entire year.

5.273.s:
yaḥ punaḥ snapanaṃ tasya sarvaṃ caiva karoti ca ..
triṃśadvarṣodbhavaṃ pāpaṃ tasya gātrātpraṇaśyati .. 113 ..
5.273.d:
यः पुनः स्नपनं तस्य सर्वं चैव करोति च ..
त्रिंशद्वर्षोद्भवं पापं तस्य गात्रात्प्रणश्यति .. 113 ..
5.273.m:
Moreover, whoever performs all the ceremonial bath for him,
the sin born of thirty years is destroyed from his body.

5.273.s:
yaḥ punarnṛtyagītādyaṃ kurute ca tadagrataḥ ..
ājanmamaraṇātpāpātso'pi muktimavāpnuyāt ..114 ..
5.273.d:
यः पुनर्नृत्यगीताद्यं कुरुते च तदग्रतः ..
आजन्ममरणात्पापात्सोऽपि मुक्तिमवाप्नुयात् ..114 ..
5.273.m:
Furthermore, whoever performs dance, singing, and so forth in front of him
also attains liberation from sin from birth unto death.

5.273.s:
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye durvāsaḥsthāpita
śivaliṃgasya duḥśīleśvarasaṃjñāprāptikāraṇavṛttāntavarṇanaṃ nāma catuḥsaptatyuttara dviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 274 .. .. cha ..
5.273.d:
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखण्डे हाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये दुर्वासःस्थापित
शिवलिंगस्य दुःशीलेश्वरसंज्ञाप्राप्तिकारणवृत्तान्तवर्णनं नाम चतुःसप्तत्युत्तर द्विशततमोऽध्यायः .. 274 .. .. छ ..
5.273.m: Thus ends the two hundred and seventy-fourth chapter, entitled “The Account of the Reason for Attaining the Name Duḥśīleśvara for the Śivaliṅga Installed by Durvāsas,” in the Māhātmya of the Sacred Field of Hāṭakeśvara, in the Nāgarakhaṇḍa, the sixth [section], in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand [verses].

5.274.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
duḥśīlo'pi ca tatkṛtvā gurornāmnā śivālayam ..
nimbeśvara iti khyātaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ diśamāśritam .. 1 ..
5.274.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
दुःशीलोऽपि च तत्कृत्वा गुरोर्नाम्ना शिवालयम् ..
निम्बेश्वर इति ख्यातं दक्षिणां दिशमाश्रितम् .. 1 ..
5.274.m:
Sūta said:
Duḥśīla too, having done that, [built] an abode of Śiva in the name of his guru,
known as Nimbeśvara, situated in the southern direction.

5.274.s:
cakāra parayā bhaktyā tatpādābjamanusmaran ..
tathā tasya tu bhāryā yā nāmnā śākaṃbharī smṛtā .. 2 ..
5.274.d:
चकार परया भक्त्या तत्पादाब्जमनुस्मरन् ..
तथा तस्य तु भार्या या नाम्ना शाकंभरी स्मृता .. 2 ..
5.274.m:
He built it with supreme devotion, remembering his lotus-like feet.
Likewise, his wife, who was known by the name Śākaṃbharī,

5.274.s:
svanāmāṃkā tatra durgā tathā saṃsthāpitā tayā ..
tatastu taddhanaṃ tābhyāṃ kiciccheṣaṃ vyavasthitam .. 3 ..
5.274.d:
स्वनामांका तत्र दुर्गा तथा संस्थापिता तया ..
ततस्तु तद्धनं ताभ्यां किचिच्छेषं व्यवस्थितम् .. 3 ..
5.274.m:
installed Durgā there bearing her own name.
Then whatever little remained of their wealth

5.274.s:
pūjārthaṃ devatābhyāṃ ca brāhmaṇebhyaḥ samarpitam ..
bhikṣābhujau tato jātau dampatī tau tataḥ param .. 4 ..
5.274.d:
पूजार्थं देवताभ्यां च ब्राह्मणेभ्यः समर्पितम् ..
भिक्षाभुजौ ततो जातौ दम्पती तौ ततः परम् .. 4 ..
5.274.m:
was dedicated to the brahmins for the worship of the two deities.
Thereafter, that couple lived on begged food.
After some time, Duḥśīla met his death.

5.274.s:
śākaṃbharyapi tatkāyaṃ gṛhītvā havyavāhanam ..
praviṣṭā nṛpaśārdūla nirvikalpena cetasā .. 6 ..
5.274.d:
शाकंभर्यपि तत्कायं गृहीत्वा हव्यवाहनम् ..
प्रविष्टा नृपशार्दूल निर्विकल्पेन चेतसा .. 6 ..
5.274.m:
Śākaṃbharī too, taking his body, entered the sacrificial fire,
O tiger among kings, with an unwavering mind.

5.274.s:
tato vimānamāruhya varāpsaraḥsusevitam ..
gatau tau dvāvapi svargaṃ saṃprahṛṣṭatanūruhau .. 7 ..
5.274.d:
ततो विमानमारुह्य वराप्सरःसुसेवितम् ..
गतौ तौ द्वावपि स्वर्गं संप्रहृष्टतनूरुहौ .. 7 ..
5.274.m:
Then, having mounted an aerial chariot well-attended by excellent apsarases,
the two of them, their body-hairs thrilling with joy, went to heaven.

5.274.s:
etaṃ duḥśīlajaṃ yastu paṭhedākhyānamuttamam ..
sa sarvairmucyate pāpairajñānavihitairnṛpa .. 8 ..
5.274.d:
एतं दुःशीलजं यस्तु पठेदाख्यानमुत्तमम् ..
स सर्वैर्मुच्यते पापैरज्ञानविहितैर्नृप .. 8 ..
5.274.m:
Whoever reads this excellent narrative concerning Duḥśīla,
O king, is freed from all sins committed through ignorance.

5.274.s: iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye nimbeśvaraśākaṃbharyutpattimāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma pañcasaptatyuttaradviśatatamodbhayāyaḥ .. 275 ..
5.274.d: इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखण्डे हाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये निम्बेश्वरशाकंभर्युत्पत्तिमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम पञ्चसप्तत्युत्तरद्विशततमोद्भयायः .. 275 ..
5.274.m: Thus ends the two hundred and seventy-fifth chapter, entitled “The Description of the Origin and Māhātmya of Nimbeśvara and Śākaṃbharī,” in the Māhātmya of the Sacred Field of Hāṭakeśvara, in the Nāgarakhaṇḍa, the sixth [section], in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand [verses].

5.275.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
tathānye'pi vasantīha rudrā ekādaśaiva tu ..
sañjātā brāhmaṇaśreṣṭhā munīnāṃ hitakāmyayā .. 1 ..
5.275.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
तथान्येऽपि वसन्तीह रुद्रा एकादशैव तु ..
सञ्जाता ब्राह्मणश्रेष्ठा मुनीनां हितकाम्यया .. 1 ..
5.275.m:
Sūta said:
Likewise, eleven Rudras dwell here,
who were born out of a desire for the welfare of the sages, O best of brahmins.

5.275.s:
yairdṛṣṭaiḥ pūjitai rvāpi stutairvātha namaskṛtaiḥ ..
vipāpmā jāyate martyaḥ sarvadoṣavivarjitaḥ .. 2 ..
5.275.d:
यैर्दृष्टैः पूजितै र्वापि स्तुतैर्वाथ नमस्कृतैः ..
विपाप्मा जायते मर्त्यः सर्वदोषविवर्जितः .. 2 ..
5.275.m:
By seeing them, or by worshiping them, by praising them, or by bowing down to them,
a mortal becomes free from sin and devoid of all defects.

5.275.s:
.. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
eka eva śruto rudro na dvitīyaḥ kathaṃcana ..
gaurī bhāryāpriyā yasya skandaḥ putraḥ prakīrtitaḥ .. 3 ..
5.275.d:
.. ऋषय ऊचुः .. ..
एक एव श्रुतो रुद्रो न द्वितीयः कथंचन ..
गौरी भार्याप्रिया यस्य स्कन्दः पुत्रः प्रकीर्तितः .. 3 ..
5.275.m:
The seers said:
Only one Rudra has been heard of, no second one by any means,
whose beloved wife is Gaurī and whose son is proclaimed to be Skanda.

5.275.s:
tenaikaṃ vidmahe rudraṃ nānyamīśaṃ kathaṃcana ..
tasmādbrūhi mahābhāga sarvānetānsuvistarāt .. 4 ..
5.275.d:
तेनैकं विद्महे रुद्रं नान्यमीशं कथंचन ..
तस्माद्ब्रूहि महाभाग सर्वानेतान्सुविस्तरात् .. 4 ..
5.275.m:
Therefore we know of one Rudra, no other lord whatsoever.
Therefore, O highly fortunate one, speak of all these in full detail.

5.275.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
satyametanmahābhāgā yadbhavadbhirudāhṛtam ..
eka eva sthito rudro na dvitīyaḥ kathaṃcana .. 5 ..
5.275.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
सत्यमेतन्महाभागा यद्भवद्भिरुदाहृतम् ..
एक एव स्थितो रुद्रो न द्वितीयः कथंचन .. 5 ..
5.275.m:
Sūta said:
This which was stated by you, O highly fortunate ones, is true:
Rudra exists as only one, not a second one by any means.

5.275.s:
paraṃ yathā ca sañjātā rudrā ekādaśātra bhoḥ ..
tathāhaṃ kīrtayiṣyāmi śṛṇudhvaṃ susamāhitāḥ .. 6 ..
5.275.d:
परं यथा च सञ्जाता रुद्रा एकादशात्र भोः ..
तथाहं कीर्तयिष्यामि शृणुध्वं सुसमाहिताः .. 6 ..
5.275.m:
Yet how the eleven Rudras came to be here, O [sages],
that I shall proclaim; listen with one-pointed attention.

5.275.s:
vārāṇasyāṃ purā saṃsthā munayaḥ śaṃsitavratāḥ ..
hāṭakeśvaradevasya darśanārthaṃ samutsukāḥ .. 7 ..
5.275.d:
वाराणस्यां पुरा संस्था मुनयः शंसितव्रताः ..
हाटकेश्वरदेवस्य दर्शनार्थं समुत्सुकाः .. 7 ..
5.275.m:
Formerly, sages of praised vows dwelling in Vārāṇasī
were eager for the darśana of the god Hāṭakeśvara.

5.275.s:
prasthitāḥ samayaṃ kṛtvā spardhamānāḥ parasparam ..
ahaṃpūrvamahaṃ pūrvaṃ vīkṣayiṣyāmi taṃ vibhum .. 8 ..
5.275.d:
प्रस्थिताः समयं कृत्वा स्पर्धमानाः परस्परम् ..
अहंपूर्वमहं पूर्वं वीक्षयिष्यामि तं विभुम् .. 8 ..
5.275.m:
Having made an agreement, vying with one another,
they set out [saying]: “I will see that lord first! I will see [him] first!”

5.275.s:
sarveṣāmagrato bhūtvā pātāle hāṭakeśvaram ..
yaścādau tatra gatvā ca nekṣayiṣyati taṃ haram ..
sarveṣāṃ śramajaṃ pāpaṃ tasyaikasya bhaviṣyati .. 9 ..
5.275.d:
सर्वेषामग्रतो भूत्वा पाताले हाटकेश्वरम् ..
यश्चादौ तत्र गत्वा च नेक्षयिष्यति तं हरम् ..
सर्वेषां श्रमजं पापं तस्यैकस्य भविष्यति .. 9 ..

5.275.s:
evamuktvā tataḥ sarve vārāṇasyāṃ tataḥ param ..
prasthitā dhāvamānāśca vegena mahatā tataḥ .. 6.276.10 ..
5.275.d:
एवमुक्त्वा ततः सर्वे वाराणस्यां ततः परम् ..
प्रस्थिता धावमानाश्च वेगेन महता ततः .. 6.276.10 ..
5.275.m:
Having spoken thus, all of them thereupon set out from Vārāṇasī,
running with great speed.

5.275.s:
etasminnantare devo hāṭakeśvarasaṃjñitaḥ ..
jñātvā teṣāmabhiprāyaṃ mithaḥ sparddhāsamudbhavam ..
ātmano darśanārthāya bahubhaktipuraskṛtam .. 11 ..
5.275.d:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे देवो हाटकेश्वरसंज्ञितः ..
ज्ञात्वा तेषामभिप्रायं मिथः स्पर्द्धासमुद्भवम् ..
आत्मनो दर्शनार्थाय बहुभक्तिपुरस्कृतम् .. 11 ..

5.275.s:
laghunā rakṣyamāṇena sarveṣāṃ ca mahātmanām ..
nāgaraṃdhreṇa niṣkramya pātālāccaiva tatkṣaṇāt .. 12 ..
5.275.d:
लघुना रक्ष्यमाणेन सर्वेषां च महात्मनाम् ..
नागरंध्रेण निष्क्रम्य पातालाच्चैव तत्क्षणात् .. 12 ..
5.275.m:
emerging from Pātāla that very moment through the serpent-opening
protected by the short [path], for all those great-souled ones,

5.275.s:
ekādaśaprakāraṃ sa kṛtvā rūpaṃ manoharam ..
triśūlabhṛttrinetraṃ ca kapardena vibhūṣitam .. 13 ..
5.275.d:
एकादशप्रकारं स कृत्वा रूपं मनोहरम् ..
त्रिशूलभृत्त्रिनेत्रं च कपर्देन विभूषितम् .. 13 ..
5.275.m:
assumed an elevenfold, captivating form,
bearing a trident, possessing three eyes, and adorned with matted locks,

5.275.s:
