śaśikhaṃḍadharaṃ caiva ruṇḍamālāpradhārakam ..
samaṃ caiva sthitasteṣāṃ darśane śaṃkaraḥ prabhuḥ .. 183 ..
tataste vai samālokya purasthaṃ vṛṣabhadhvajam ..
jānubhyāṃ dharaṇīṃ gatvā stutiṃ cakrustatastataḥ .. 15 ..
eko jānāti devo'yaṃ mama saṃdarśanaṃ gataḥ ..
devadevo mahādevaḥ prathamaṃ bhaktavatsalaḥ .. 16 ..
anyo jānāti me pūrvaṃ jātaste tāpasottamaḥ ..
stutiṃ cakruśca vipreṃdrā jānubhyāmavaniṃ gatāḥ ..17.. ..
.. tāpasā ūcuḥ .. ..
namo devādhidevāya sarvadevamayāya ca ..
namaḥ śāṃtāya sūkṣmāya namaścāṃdhakabhedine .. 18 ..
namo'stu sarvarudrebhyo ye divaṃ saṃśritāḥ sadā ..
jīvāpayaṃti jagatīṃ vāyubhiśca pṛthagvidhaiḥ .. 19 ..
namo'stu sarvarudrebhyo ye sthitā vāruṇīṃ diśam ..
rakṣaṃti sarvalokāṃśca piśācānāṃ durātmanām .. 6.276.20 ..
5.275.d:
शशिखंडधरं चैव रुण्डमालाप्रधारकम् ..
समं चैव स्थितस्तेषां दर्शने शंकरः प्रभुः .. 183 ..
ततस्ते वै समालोक्य पुरस्थं वृषभध्वजम् ..
जानुभ्यां धरणीं गत्वा स्तुतिं चक्रुस्ततस्ततः .. 15 ..
एको जानाति देवोऽयं मम संदर्शनं गतः ..
देवदेवो महादेवः प्रथमं भक्तवत्सलः .. 16 ..
अन्यो जानाति मे पूर्वं जातस्ते तापसोत्तमः ..
स्तुतिं चक्रुश्च विप्रेंद्रा जानुभ्यामवनिं गताः ..17.. ..
.. तापसा ऊचुः .. ..
नमो देवाधिदेवाय सर्वदेवमयाय च ..
नमः शांताय सूक्ष्माय नमश्चांधकभेदिने .. 18 ..
नमोऽस्तु सर्वरुद्रेभ्यो ये दिवं संश्रिताः सदा ..
जीवापयंति जगतीं वायुभिश्च पृथग्विधैः .. 19 ..
नमोऽस्तु सर्वरुद्रेभ्यो ये स्थिता वारुणीं दिशम् ..
रक्षंति सर्वलोकांश्च पिशाचानां दुरात्मनाम् .. 6.276.20 ..
5.275.m:
bearing the crescent moon, and wearing a garland of skulls;
and Lord Śaṃkara stood before them simultaneously for darśana.
Then, seeing him whose banner bears a bull standing before them,
they fell to the earth on their knees and offered praise on all sides.
One thinks: “This god, the god of gods, Mahādeva,
who is fond of his devotees, has come first into my sight.”
Another thinks: “He has appeared to me first, O best of ascetics!”
And falling to the ground on their knees, the eminent brahmins offered praise.
The ascetics said:
“Salutations to the supreme God of gods, who consists of all gods!
Salutations to the peaceful one, to the subtle one, and salutations to the slayer of Andhaka!
Salutations be to all the Rudras who have always resorted to heaven,
and who sustain the world through various kinds of winds!
Salutations be to all the Rudras who abide in the western direction,
and who protect all the worlds from wicked piśācas!

5.275.s:
namo'stu sarvarudrebhyo diśamūrdhvaṃ samāśritāḥ ..
rakṣaṃti sakalāṃllokānbhūtārnāṃ jaṃbhakādbhayāt .. 21 ..
namo'stu sarvarudrebhyo ye'dha ūrdhvaṃ samāśritāḥ ..
rakṣaṃti sakalāṃllokānkūṣmāṃḍānāṃ bhayātsadā .. 22 ..
asaṃkhyātāḥ sahasrāṇi ye rudrā bhūmimāśritāḥ ..
namastebhyo'pi sarvebhyasteṣāṃ rakṣaṃti ye rujaḥ .. 23 ..
evaṃ stutāstu te rudrā ekādaśatapasvibhiḥ ..
ekādaśāpi tānprocurbhaktinamrāṃstu tāpasān .. 24 ..
.. rudrā ūcuḥ .. ..
ekādaśaprakāro'haṃ tuṣṭo vastāpasottamāḥ ..
bahubhaktyatirekeṇa vriyatāṃ ca yathepsitam ..25..
.. tāpasā ūcuḥ .. ..
yadi tuṣṭosi no deva yadi yacchasi vāṃchitam ..
ekādaśaprakāraistu sadā stheyamihaiva tu .. 26 ..
hāṭakeśvaraje kṣetre sarvatīrthamaye śubhe ..
ārādhanaṃ prakurvāṇā vasāmo yena vai vayam .. 27 ..
5.275.d:
नमोऽस्तु सर्वरुद्रेभ्यो दिशमूर्ध्वं समाश्रिताः ..
रक्षंति सकलांल्लोकान्भूतार्नां जंभकाद्भयात् .. 21 ..
नमोऽस्तु सर्वरुद्रेभ्यो येऽध ऊर्ध्वं समाश्रिताः ..
रक्षंति सकलांल्लोकान्कूष्मांडानां भयात्सदा .. 22 ..
असंख्याताः सहस्राणि ये रुद्रा भूमिमाश्रिताः ..
नमस्तेभ्योऽपि सर्वेभ्यस्तेषां रक्षंति ये रुजः .. 23 ..
एवं स्तुतास्तु ते रुद्रा एकादशतपस्विभिः ..
एकादशापि तान्प्रोचुर्भक्तिनम्रांस्तु तापसान् .. 24 ..
.. रुद्रा ऊचुः .. ..
एकादशप्रकारोऽहं तुष्टो वस्तापसोत्तमाः ..
बहुभक्त्यतिरेकेण व्रियतां च यथेप्सितम् ..25..
.. तापसा ऊचुः .. ..
यदि तुष्टोसि नो देव यदि यच्छसि वांछितम् ..
एकादशप्रकारैस्तु सदा स्थेयमिहैव तु .. 26 ..
हाटकेश्वरजे क्षेत्रे सर्वतीर्थमये शुभे ..
आराधनं प्रकुर्वाणा वसामो येन वै वयम् .. 27 ..
5.275.m:
Salutations be to all the Rudras who have taken refuge in the upward direction,
and who protect all the worlds from fear of spirits and jambhakas!
Salutations be to all the Rudras who have taken refuge below and above,
and who always protect all the worlds from the fear of kūṣmāṇḍas!”
The Rudras who are countless thousands and dwell upon the earth, / salutation also to all of them, who protect from diseases! 23
Praised in this way by the eleven ascetics, / the eleven Rudras spoke to those ascetics who were bowed in devotion: 24
The Rudras said: / "I, elevenfold, am pleased with you, O best of ascetics, / on account of your great excess of devotion. Choose a boon as desired!" 25
The ascetics said: / "If you are pleased with us, O God, if you grant our wish, / you should always dwell right here in eleven forms, 26
in the auspicious sacred field born of Hāṭakeśvara, composed of all sacred fords, / so that we may reside here, performing your worship." 27

5.275.s:
.. śrībhagavānuvāca .. ..
ekādaśaprakārā yā mūrtayo nirmitā mayā ..
etābhireva sarvābhiḥ sthāsyāmyatra sadaiva hi .. 28 ..
ādyā tu mama yā mūrtiḥ sā kailāsaṃ samāśritā ..
saṃtiṣṭhati sadaivātra kailāse parvatottame .. 29 ..
etāstu mūrtayo'smākaṃ sthāsyaṃtyatraiva sarvadā ..
sarveṣāmeva lokānāṃ hitāya dvijasattamāḥ .. 6.276.30 ..
nāmabhiśca krameṇaiva yuṣmadīyaiḥ svayaṃ dvijāḥ ..
viśvāmitrahrade snātvā etā mūrtīrmamātra vai ..
pūjayiṣyaṃti ye martyāste yāsyaṃti parāṃ gatim .. 31 ..
kiṃ vācā bahunoktena bhūyobhūyo dvijottamāḥ ..
yā tāsāṃ kriyate pūjā ekādaśaguṇā bhavet .. 32 ..
evamuktvā trinetrastu tatraivādarśanaṃ gataḥ ..
te'pi tatrāśramaṃ kṛtvā śraddhayā parayā yutāḥ ..
mūrtīśca tāḥ samārādhya saṃprāptāḥ paramaṃ padam .. 33 ..
5.275.d:
.. श्रीभगवानुवाच .. ..
एकादशप्रकारा या मूर्तयो निर्मिता मया ..
एताभिरेव सर्वाभिः स्थास्याम्यत्र सदैव हि .. 28 ..
आद्या तु मम या मूर्तिः सा कैलासं समाश्रिता ..
संतिष्ठति सदैवात्र कैलासे पर्वतोत्तमे .. 29 ..
एतास्तु मूर्तयोऽस्माकं स्थास्यंत्यत्रैव सर्वदा ..
सर्वेषामेव लोकानां हिताय द्विजसत्तमाः .. 6.276.30 ..
नामभिश्च क्रमेणैव युष्मदीयैः स्वयं द्विजाः ..
विश्वामित्रह्रदे स्नात्वा एता मूर्तीर्ममात्र वै ..
पूजयिष्यंति ये मर्त्यास्ते यास्यंति परां गतिम् .. 31 ..
किं वाचा बहुनोक्तेन भूयोभूयो द्विजोत्तमाः ..
या तासां क्रियते पूजा एकादशगुणा भवेत् .. 32 ..
एवमुक्त्वा त्रिनेत्रस्तु तत्रैवादर्शनं गतः ..
तेऽपि तत्राश्रमं कृत्वा श्रद्धया परया युताः ..
मूर्तीश्च ताः समाराध्य संप्राप्ताः परमं पदम् .. 33 ..
5.275.m:
The Blessed Lord said: / "The forms that have been fashioned by me in eleven ways, / with all of these very forms I shall indeed always remain here. 28
My primordial form, however, having resorted to Kailāsa, / always remains right there on Kailāsa, the best of mountains. 29
These forms of ours, however, shall always remain right here / for the benefit of all the worlds, O best of brahmins. 30
And directly under your names in due order, O brahmins: / bathing in the pool of Viśvāmitra, the mortals who worship / these forms of mine right here shall attain the supreme state. 31
What need is there of saying much again and again, O best of brahmins? / The worship that is performed for them shall bear elevenfold fruit. 32
Having spoken thus, the Three-eyed Lord vanished right there. / And they, having established their hermitage there, endowed with supreme faith, / worshiped those forms and attained the supreme abode. 33

5.275.s:
anyo'pi yaḥ pumāṃstāśca ārādhayati śraddhayā ..
sa yāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ yatra devo maheśvaraḥ .. 34 ..
tataḥ prabhṛti te jātā rudrā ekādaśaiva tu ..
saṃkhyayā devadevasya maheśvaravapurdharāḥ .. 35 ..
tejottamāste saṃyuktāstrinetrāḥ śūlapāṇayaḥ ..
etadvaḥ sarvamākhyātaṃ yatpṛṣṭo'smi dvijottamāḥ .. 36 ..
ekādaśaprakārastu yathā jāto maheśvaraḥ ..
caitre māsi site pakṣe caturdaśyāṃ dine sthite .. 37 ..
yastānpūjayate bhaktyā sa yāti paramāṃ gatim ..
adhano dhanamāpnoti hyaputraḥ putravānbhavet .. 38 ..
sarogo rogamuktastu parābhūto ripukṣayam ..
tatsamārādhanādeva kāmānaṃtyamavāpnuyāt .. 39 ..
yaḥ punaḥ śivadīkṣāḍhyo bhasmasnānaparāyaṇaḥ ..
tatsamārādhanaṃ kuryācchṛṇu tasyāpi yatphalam .. 6.276.40 ..
5.275.d:
अन्योऽपि यः पुमांस्ताश्च आराधयति श्रद्धया ..
स याति परमं स्थानं यत्र देवो महेश्वरः .. 34 ..
ततः प्रभृति ते जाता रुद्रा एकादशैव तु ..
संख्यया देवदेवस्य महेश्वरवपुर्धराः .. 35 ..
तेजोत्तमास्ते संयुक्तास्त्रिनेत्राः शूलपाणयः ..
एतद्वः सर्वमाख्यातं यत्पृष्टोऽस्मि द्विजोत्तमाः .. 36 ..
एकादशप्रकारस्तु यथा जातो महेश्वरः ..
चैत्रे मासि सिते पक्षे चतुर्दश्यां दिने स्थिते .. 37 ..
यस्तान्पूजयते भक्त्या स याति परमां गतिम् ..
अधनो धनमाप्नोति ह्यपुत्रः पुत्रवान्भवेत् .. 38 ..
सरोगो रोगमुक्तस्तु पराभूतो रिपुक्षयम् ..
तत्समाराधनादेव कामानंत्यमवाप्नुयात् .. 39 ..
यः पुनः शिवदीक्षाढ्यो भस्मस्नानपरायणः ..
तत्समाराधनं कुर्याच्छृणु तस्यापि यत्फलम् .. 6.276.40 ..
5.275.m:
Any other man also who worships them with faith / goes to the supreme abode where the god Maheśvara resides. 34
From then on, they became the eleven Rudras / in number, bearing the form of Maheśvara, the God of gods. 35
They were endowed with supreme splendor, three-eyed, with tridents in hand. / All this has been narrated to you about which I was asked, O best of brahmins, 36
concerning how Maheśvara became elevenfold. / In the month of Caitra, in the bright fortnight, when the fourteenth day arrives, 37
he who worships them with devotion goes to the supreme state. / One without wealth obtains wealth; indeed, the childless becomes endowed with sons. 38
The diseased becomes free of disease, and the defeated destroys his foes; / from worshiping them alone, he attains endless desired objects. 39
Moreover, he who is endowed with Śaiva initiation and devoted to bathing in ashes / should perform their worship—hear the fruit obtained even by him! 40

5.275.s:
yadanyaḥ prāpnuyānmartyastatpūjāsaṃbhavaṃ phalam ..
ṣaḍakṣareṇa maṃtreṇa puṣpeṇaikena tatphalam .. 41 ..
śivadīkṣādharo yastu śataghnaṃ labhate phalam ..
tasmācchataghnamāpnoti śaivātpāśupataśca yaḥ ..
tasmātkālamukho yaśca mahāvratadharaśca yaḥ .. 42 ..
mūrtīryāstāśca ye bhaktyā vinatāḥ pūjayaṃti ca ..
sarveṣāmeva teṣāṃ tu phalaṃ śataguṇaṃ bhavet .. 43 ..
5.275.d:
यदन्यः प्राप्नुयान्मर्त्यस्तत्पूजासंभवं फलम् ..
षडक्षरेण मंत्रेण पुष्पेणैकेन तत्फलम् .. 41 ..
शिवदीक्षाधरो यस्तु शतघ्नं लभते फलम् ..
तस्माच्छतघ्नमाप्नोति शैवात्पाशुपतश्च यः ..
तस्मात्कालमुखो यश्च महाव्रतधरश्च यः .. 42 ..
मूर्तीर्यास्ताश्च ये भक्त्या विनताः पूजयंति च ..
सर्वेषामेव तेषां तु फलं शतगुणं भवेत् .. 43 ..
5.275.m:
Whatever fruit another mortal would obtain arising from their worship, / that fruit [he attains] with a single flower by the six-syllable mantra. 41
One who bears Śaiva initiation obtains a hundredfold fruit; / a Pāśupata obtains a hundredfold more than that Śaiva; / a Kālamukha and one who observes the Mahāvrata obtain [a hundredfold] more than him. 42
And for all of them who bow and worship those forms with devotion, / the fruit shall be a hundredfold. 43

5.275.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmya ekādaśarudrotpatti varṇanaṃ nāma ṣaṭsaptatyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 276 ..
5.275.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखण्डे हाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्य एकादशरुद्रोत्पत्ति वर्णनं नाम षट्सप्तत्युत्तरद्विशततमोऽध्यायः .. 276 ..
5.275.m: Thus ends the two hundred seventy-sixth chapter, named 'Description of the Origin of the Eleven Rudras', in the Hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmya of the Nāgarakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand [verses]. 276

5.276.s:
.. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
ki nāmāno dvijāste ca vārāṇasyāḥ samāgatāḥ..
ekādaśaprakāro'sau yeṣāṃ rudraḥ prabhaktitaḥ ..
tatsaṃjñāśca samācakṣva vistareṇa mahāmune .. 1 ..
5.276.d:
.. ऋषय ऊचुः .. ..
कि नामानो द्विजास्ते च वाराणस्याः समागताः..
एकादशप्रकारोऽसौ येषां रुद्रः प्रभक्तितः ..
तत्संज्ञाश्च समाचक्ष्व विस्तरेण महामुने .. 1 ..
5.276.m: The seers said: / What were the names of those brahmins who arrived from Vārāṇasī, / for whose profound devotion Rudra became elevenfold? / Tell us their names in detail, O great sage! 1

5.276.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
ekasteṣāṃ mṛgavyādho vikhyāto bhuvanatraye ..
dvitīyaḥ sarvasaṃjñaśca niṃditaśca tṛtīyakaḥ.. 2 ..
5.276.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
एकस्तेषां मृगव्याधो विख्यातो भुवनत्रये ..
द्वितीयः सर्वसंज्ञश्च निंदितश्च तृतीयकः.. 2 ..
5.276.m: Sūta said: / One among them was Mṛgavyādha, renowned in the three worlds; / the second was named Sarva, and the third was Nindita. 2

5.276.s:
mahāyaśāścaturthastu kathyate munisattamāḥ ..
ajaikapāda ityuktaḥ paṃcamo muni sattamāḥ .. 3 ..
5.276.d:
महायशाश्चतुर्थस्तु कथ्यते मुनिसत्तमाः ..
अजैकपाद इत्युक्तः पंचमो मुनि सत्तमाः .. 3 ..
5.276.m: The fourth is declared to be Mahāyaśas, O best of sages; / the fifth is called Ajaikapāda, O best of sages. 3

5.276.s:
ahirbudhnyastathā ṣaṣṭhaḥ pinākī saptamastathā ..
paraṃ tapastathānyastu dahano navamastathā .. 4 ..
5.276.d:
अहिर्बुध्न्यस्तथा षष्ठः पिनाकी सप्तमस्तथा ..
परं तपस्तथान्यस्तु दहनो नवमस्तथा .. 4 ..
5.276.m: Likewise, the sixth was Ahirbudhnya, and the seventh was Pinākin; / the other was Paraṃtapa, and the ninth was Dahana. 4

5.276.s:
īśvaro daśamaḥ proktaḥ kapālī cāṃti mastathā ..
teṣāmetāni nāmāni sthitānyeva hi yāni ca ..
rudrāṇāmapi tānyeva vihitāni hareṇa tu .. 5 ..
5.276.d:
ईश्वरो दशमः प्रोक्तः कपाली चांति मस्तथा ..
तेषामेतानि नामानि स्थितान्येव हि यानि च ..
रुद्राणामपि तान्येव विहितानि हरेण तु .. 5 ..
5.276.m: The tenth is declared to be Īśvara, and the last was Kapālin. / These very names that belonged to them / were also assigned to the Rudras by Hara. 5

5.276.s:
.. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
kāni dānāni śasyāni tadarthaṃ vada no drutam ..
japaścaiva purā proktastvayā kāryo yathaiva ca .. 6 ..
5.276.d:
.. ऋषय ऊचुः .. ..
कानि दानानि शस्यानि तदर्थं वद नो द्रुतम् ..
जपश्चैव पुरा प्रोक्तस्त्वया कार्यो यथैव च .. 6 ..
5.276.m: The seers said: / What gifts are commendable for that purpose? Tell us quickly! / And what recitation of mantras was previously spoken by you that should be performed? 6

5.276.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
taduddiśya pradātavyamekaikasya pṛthakpṛthak ..
pratyakṣāśca mahābhāga dātavyā dhenavaḥ kramāt .. 7 ..
5.276.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
तदुद्दिश्य प्रदातव्यमेकैकस्य पृथक्पृथक् ..
प्रत्यक्षाश्च महाभाग दातव्या धेनवः क्रमात् .. 7 ..
5.276.m: Sūta said: / Dedicated to that, [gifts] should be given separately to each one; / and cows, O fortunate one, are to be given in sequence, directly [or symbolic]: 7

5.276.s:
mṛgavyādhāya pratyakṣā gaurdeyā ca guḍodbhavā ..
kapāline pradātavyā navanītasamudbhavā .. 8 ..
5.276.d:
मृगव्याधाय प्रत्यक्षा गौर्देया च गुडोद्भवा ..
कपालिने प्रदातव्या नवनीतसमुद्भवा .. 8 ..
5.276.m: To Mṛgavyādha, a real cow and one made of jaggery should be given; / to Kapālin, one made of fresh butter should be given; 8

5.276.s:
ajapādāya cājyotthā ahirbudhnyāya hemajā ..
pinākine pradātavyā dhenurlavaṇasambhavā .. 9 ..
5.276.d:
अजपादाय चाज्योत्था अहिर्बुध्न्याय हेमजा ..
पिनाकिने प्रदातव्या धेनुर्लवणसम्भवा .. 9 ..
5.276.m: to Ajapāda, one made of ghee; to Ahirbudhnya, one made of gold; / to Pinākin, a cow made of salt should be given; 9

5.276.s:
paraṃtapāya viprendrāstathaiva rasasa mbhavā ..
annajā dahanāyoktā īśvarāya jalodbhavā .. 6.277.10 ..
5.276.d:
परंतपाय विप्रेन्द्रास्तथैव रसस म्भवा ..
अन्नजा दहनायोक्ता ईश्वराय जलोद्भवा .. 6.277.10 ..
5.276.m: to Paraṃtapa, O lords of brahmins, likewise one made of liquid [syrup]; / to Dahana, one made of food is declared; to Īśvara, one made of water. 10

5.276.s:
etā dadāti yo viprā eteṣāṃ ca mahātmanām ..
cakravartī bhavennūnametadāha pitāmahaḥ .... .. 11 ..
5.276.d:
एता ददाति यो विप्रा एतेषां च महात्मनाम् ..
चक्रवर्ती भवेन्नूनमेतदाह पितामहः .... .. 11 ..
5.276.m: He who gives these to these great souls, O brahmins, / shall surely become a universal monarch; so said the Grandfather. 11

5.276.s:
anyatrāpi pradattāśca kiṃ punarbhavasaṃnidhau ..
tasmātsarvaprayatnena etā deyāḥ prayatnataḥ .. 12 ..
5.276.d:
अन्यत्रापि प्रदत्ताश्च किं पुनर्भवसंनिधौ ..
तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन एता देयाः प्रयत्नतः .. 12 ..
5.276.m: If given elsewhere [it bears fruit], how much more so in the presence of Bhava? / Therefore, with all effort, these should be given diligently. 12

5.276.s:
dhenavo yo na śaktaḥ syādekā deyā prayatnataḥ ..
sarveṣāmeva rudrāṇāṃ bhartṛyajñavaco yathā .. 13 ..
5.276.d:
धेनवो यो न शक्तः स्यादेका देया प्रयत्नतः ..
सर्वेषामेव रुद्राणां भर्तृयज्ञवचो यथा .. 13 ..
5.276.m: He who is unable [to give all] should give one cow diligently / to all the Rudras, according to the words of Bhartṛyajña. 13

5.276.s: iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye ekādaśarudrasamīpe dānamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma saptasaptatyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 277 ..
5.276.d: इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखण्डे हाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये एकादशरुद्रसमीपे दानमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम सप्तसप्तत्युत्तरद्विशततमोऽध्यायः .. 277 ..
5.276.m: Thus ends the two hundred seventy-seventh chapter, named 'Description of the Māhātmya of Gifts in the Presence of the Eleven Rudras', in the Hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmya of the Nāgarakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand [verses]. 277
